title: Applied Explainability for Large Language Models: A Comparative Study
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, comparative study of explainability methods for transformer-based NLP models; also available on Zenodo
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many natural language processing tasks, yet their decision processes remain difficult to interpret. This lack of transparency creates challenges for trust, debugging, and deployment in real-world systems.
  This paper presents an applied comparative study of three explainability techniques: Integrated Gradients, Attention Rollout, and SHAP, on a fine-tuned DistilBERT model for SST-2 sentiment classification. Rather than proposing new methods, the focus is on evaluating the practical behavior of existing approaches under a consistent and reproducible setup.
  The results show that gradient-based attribution provides more stable and intuitive explanations, while attention-based methods are computationally efficient but less aligned with prediction-relevant features. Model-agnostic approaches offer flexibility but introduce higher computational cost and variability.
  This work highlights key trade-offs between explainability methods and emphasizes their role as diagnostic tools rather than definitive explanations. The findings provide practical insights for researchers and engineers working with transformer-based NLP systems.
  This is a preprint and has not undergone peer review.

AI.tldr: 本文对三种可解释性方法（集成梯度、注意力展开和SHAP）在微调DistilBERT模型上进行SST-2情感分类任务的比较研究，发现梯度归因方法提供更稳定直观的解释，而注意力方法计算高效但相关性较差。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在自然语言处理任务中表现出色，但其决策过程难以解释，缺乏透明度给实际系统部署中的信任、调试带来挑战。本文旨在评估现有可解释性方法在实际应用中的表现。
AI.method: 采用应用性比较研究方法，在一致的实验设置下评估三种可解释性技术：集成梯度（梯度归因）、注意力展开（注意力机制）和SHAP（模型无关方法），应用于微调的DistilBERT模型进行SST-2情感分类任务。
AI.result: 梯度归因方法提供更稳定和直观的解释；注意力方法计算效率高但与预测相关特征对齐较差；模型无关方法灵活性高但计算成本高且变异性大。不同方法在解释质量、计算效率和稳定性方面存在权衡。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性方法应被视为诊断工具而非确定性解释，本文为研究人员和工程师在基于Transformer的NLP系统中选择可解释性方法提供了实用见解，强调了不同方法间的权衡关系。

title: Think Multilingual, Not Harder: A Data-Efficient Framework for Teaching Reasoning Models to Code-Switch
summary: Recent developments in reasoning capabilities have enabled large language models to solve increasingly complex mathematical, symbolic, and logical tasks. Interestingly, while reasoning models are often trained to generate monolingual text, these models have also been observed to code-switch (i.e., mix languages). Prior works have either viewed code-switching as an undesirable error, attempted to control code-switching through modifications to input prompts or the output decoding process, or focus on narrow subsets of languages, domains, tasks, and models. We address these gaps by introducing the first linguistically and behaviorally motivated fine-tuning framework for identifying beneficial code-switched reasoning behaviors in large language models and teaching these models to code-switch more effectively for reasoning. First, we create and systematically analyze a dataset of reasoning traces from diverse models, languages, tasks, and domains to understand the types of code-switching behaviors found in existing reasoning models. Then, we develop fine-tuning interventions that teach reasoning models to code-switch based on our observations of helpful behaviors in existing models. We find that our framework can significantly increase beneficial code-switched reasoning behaviors in a data-efficient manner. Interestingly, we also find that code-switching behaviors in reasoning models can be modified by fine-tuning for tasks that do not directly demonstrate code-switching in reasoning (e.g., machine translation). Our work suggests that data-efficient interventions can instill helpful forms of code-switching behavior in reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了首个基于语言学和行为学动机的微调框架，用于识别大型语言模型中有利的代码切换推理行为，并教导模型更有效地进行代码切换推理。
AI.motivation: 当前推理模型虽然能处理复杂任务，但常常出现代码切换现象。先前研究要么将其视为错误，要么试图通过修改输入提示或解码过程来控制，或者只关注特定语言、领域、任务和模型的子集。这些方法存在局限性，需要更系统的方法来理解和利用代码切换在推理中的潜在价值。
AI.method: 1. 创建并系统分析来自不同模型、语言、任务和领域的推理轨迹数据集，以理解现有推理模型中的代码切换行为类型；2. 基于对现有模型中有利行为的观察，开发微调干预措施，教导推理模型进行代码切换。
AI.result: 该框架能以数据高效的方式显著增加有益的代码切换推理行为。有趣的是，即使在不直接展示代码切换推理的任务（如机器翻译）上进行微调，也能修改推理模型中的代码切换行为。
AI.conclusion: 数据高效的干预措施能够在推理模型中培养有益的代码切换行为，这表明代码切换可以成为增强推理能力的有价值工具，而不仅仅是需要纠正的错误。

title: Brain Score Tracks Shared Properties of Languages: Evidence from Many Natural Languages and Structured Sequences
summary: Recent breakthroughs in language models (LMs) using neural networks have raised the question: how similar are these models' processing to human language processing? Results using a framework called Brain Score (BS) -- predicting fMRI activations during reading from LM activations -- have been used to argue for a high degree of similarity. To understand this similarity, we conduct experiments by training LMs on various types of input data and evaluate them on BS. We find that models trained on various natural languages from many different language families have very similar BS performance. LMs trained on other structured data -- the human genome, Python, and pure hierarchical structure (nested parentheses) -- also perform reasonably well and close to natural languages in some cases. These findings suggest that BS can highlight language models' ability to extract common structure across natural languages, but that the metric may not be sensitive enough to allow us to infer human-like processing from a high BS score alone.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，语言模型在Brain Score上的表现不仅限于自然语言，其他结构化数据（如基因组、代码、括号结构）也能获得相似分数，表明该指标可能无法单独证明语言模型具有类人语言处理能力。
AI.motivation: 随着神经网络语言模型的突破性进展，研究者们开始质疑这些模型的语言处理是否与人类相似。Brain Score框架被用来评估这种相似性，但需要更深入理解这种相似性的本质。
AI.method: 通过在多种输入数据上训练语言模型并评估其在Brain Score上的表现：包括不同语系的自然语言、人类基因组、Python代码以及纯层次结构（嵌套括号）。
AI.result: 1. 在不同语系自然语言上训练的模型具有非常相似的Brain Score表现；2. 在其他结构化数据（基因组、Python、括号结构）上训练的模型也表现良好，某些情况下接近自然语言水平。
AI.conclusion: Brain Score能够突显语言模型从自然语言中提取共同结构的能力，但该指标可能不够敏感，仅凭高分不能推断模型具有类人语言处理能力。

title: PolicyBank: Evolving Policy Understanding for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents operating under organizational policies must comply with authorization constraints typically specified in natural language. In practice, such specifications inevitably contain ambiguities and logical or semantic gaps that cause the agent's behavior to systematically diverge from the true requirements. We ask: by letting an agent evolve its policy understanding through interaction and corrective feedback from pre-deployment testing, can it autonomously refine its interpretation to close specification gaps? We propose PolicyBank, a memory mechanism that maintains structured, tool-level policy insights and iteratively refines them -- unlike existing memory mechanisms that treat the policy as immutable ground truth, reinforcing "compliant but wrong" behaviors. We also contribute a systematic testbed by extending a popular tool-calling benchmark with controlled policy gaps that isolate alignment failures from execution failures. While existing memory mechanisms achieve near-zero success on policy-gap scenarios, PolicyBank closes up to 82% of the gap toward a human oracle.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PolicyBank记忆机制，通过交互和纠正反馈让LLM代理自主完善对组织政策的理解，解决自然语言政策规范中的模糊性和逻辑漏洞问题。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在组织政策下运行时，自然语言指定的授权约束存在不可避免的模糊性和逻辑漏洞，导致代理行为与真实要求系统性偏离。现有记忆机制将政策视为不可变真理，强化了"合规但错误"的行为。
AI.method: 提出PolicyBank记忆机制，维护结构化的工具级政策洞察，通过交互和部署前测试的纠正反馈迭代完善政策理解。还贡献了一个系统化测试平台，扩展了流行的工具调用基准，包含受控的政策漏洞。
AI.result: 在政策漏洞场景下，现有记忆机制几乎零成功率，而PolicyBank能够填补高达82%的与人类专家之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: PolicyBank通过让代理自主完善政策理解，有效解决了自然语言政策规范中的模糊性和逻辑漏洞问题，显著提升了LLM代理的政策合规性。

title: Zoom Consistency: A Free Confidence Signal in Multi-Step Visual Grounding Pipelines
summary: Multi-step zoom-in pipelines are widely used for GUI grounding, yet the intermediate predictions they produce are typically discarded after coordinate remapping. We observe that these intermediate outputs contain a useful confidence signal for free: zoom consistency, the distance between a model's step-2 prediction and the crop center. Unlike log-probabilities or token-level uncertainty, zoom consistency is a geometric quantity in a shared coordinate space, making it directly comparable across architecturally different VLMs without calibration. We prove this quantity is a linear estimator of step-1 spatial error under idealized conditions (perfect step-2, target within crop) and show it correlates with prediction correctness across two VLMs (AUC = 0.60; Spearman rho = -0.14, p < 10^{-6} for KV-Ground-8B; rho = -0.11, p = 0.0003 for Qwen3.5-27B). The correlation is small but consistent across models, application categories, and operating systems. As a proof-of-concept, we use zoom consistency to route between a specialist and generalist model, capturing 16.5% of the oracle headroom between them (+0.8%, McNemar p = 0.19). Code is available at https://github.com/omxyz/zoom-consistency-routing.

AI.tldr: 论文发现多步缩放GUI定位流程中的中间预测包含有用的置信度信号——缩放一致性（zoom consistency），即模型第二步预测与裁剪中心之间的距离，可作为无需校准的跨模型置信度指标。
AI.motivation: 多步缩放GUI定位流程中，中间预测通常在被坐标重映射后就被丢弃。作者观察到这些中间输出包含有用的置信度信号，即缩放一致性，这是一种几何量，可在共享坐标空间中直接比较不同架构的视觉语言模型。
AI.method: 提出缩放一致性作为置信度指标，定义为模型第二步预测与裁剪中心之间的距离。在理想条件下证明该量是第一步空间误差的线性估计器，并在两个VLMs（KV-Ground-8B和Qwen3.5-27B）上验证其与预测正确性的相关性。
AI.result: 缩放一致性在两种VLMs中均与预测正确性相关（AUC = 0.60；Spearman rho = -0.14, p < 10^{-6} for KV-Ground-8B；rho = -0.11, p = 0.0003 for Qwen3.5-27B）。相关性虽小但在不同模型、应用类别和操作系统中保持一致。作为概念验证，使用缩放一致性在专家模型和通用模型之间进行路由，捕获了16.5%的oracle性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 缩放一致性是多步缩放GUI定位流程中免费获得的置信度信号，可作为跨模型无需校准的置信度指标，为模型选择和路由提供实用价值。

title: Why Fine-Tuning Encourages Hallucinations and How to Fix It
summary: Large language models are prone to hallucinating factually incorrect statements. A key source of these errors is exposure to new factual information through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which can increase hallucinations w.r.t. knowledge acquired during pre-training. In this work, we explore whether SFT-induced hallucinations can be mitigated using established tools from the continual learning literature, since they arise as a by-product of knowledge degradation during training. We propose a self-distillation-based SFT method that facilitates effective factual learning while minimizing hallucinations w.r.t. pre-existing knowledge by regularizing output-distribution drift. We also show that, in settings where new knowledge acquisition is unnecessary, suppressing factual plasticity by freezing parameter groups, can preserve task performance while reducing hallucinations. Lastly, we investigate the mechanism behind SFT-induced hallucinations through three hypotheses: capacity limitations, behavior cloning, and localized interference. Our experiments show that a main driver is interference among overlapping semantic representations, and that self-distillation succeeds by mitigating this interference.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出使用持续学习工具缓解SFT导致的大语言模型幻觉问题，通过自蒸馏方法和参数冻结策略减少新知识学习对预训练知识的干扰。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在监督微调（SFT）过程中容易产生事实性幻觉，这是因为SFT引入新事实信息时会干扰预训练阶段获得的知识，导致知识退化。研究者希望借鉴持续学习领域的工具来缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 提出了两种方法：1）基于自蒸馏的SFT方法，通过正则化输出分布漂移来促进有效的事实学习同时最小化幻觉；2）在不需要获取新知识的场景中，通过冻结特定参数组来抑制事实可塑性。此外，还研究了SFT诱导幻觉的三种机制假设：容量限制、行为克隆和局部干扰。
AI.result: 实验表明，SFT诱导幻觉的主要驱动因素是重叠语义表示之间的干扰，而自蒸馏方法通过减轻这种干扰取得了成功。参数冻结策略也能在保持任务性能的同时减少幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 持续学习工具可以有效缓解SFT过程中的幻觉问题，特别是通过自蒸馏方法减轻语义表示干扰，以及通过参数冻结策略控制事实可塑性，为大语言模型的事实一致性提供了实用解决方案。

title: (1D) Ordered Tokens Enable Efficient Test-Time Search
summary:
Tokenization is a key component of autoregressive (AR) generative models, converting raw data into more manageable units for modeling. Commonly, tokens describe local information, such as regions of pixels in images or word pieces in text, and AR generation predicts these tokens in a fixed order. A worthwhile question is whether token structures affect the ability to steer the generation through test-time search, where multiple candidate generations are explored and evaluated by a verifier. Using image generation as our testbed, we hypothesize that recent 1D ordered tokenizers with coarse-to-fine structure can be more amenable to search than classical 2D grid structures. This is rooted in the fact that the intermediate states in coarse-to-fine sequences carry semantic meaning that verifiers can reliably evaluate, enabling effective steering during generation.
  Through controlled experiments, we find that AR models trained on coarse-to-fine ordered tokens exhibit improved test-time scaling behavior compared to grid-based counterparts. Moreover, we demonstrate that, thanks to the ordered structure, pure test-time search over token sequences (i.e., without training an AR model) can perform training-free text-to-image generation when guided by an image-text verifier. Beyond this, we systematically study how classical search algorithms (best-of-N, beam search, lookahead search) interact with different token structures, as well as the role of different verifiers and AR priors. Our results highlight the impact of token structure on inference-time scalability and provide practical guidance for test-time scaling in AR models.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了自回归生成模型中token结构对测试时搜索能力的影响，发现具有从粗到细顺序结构的tokenizer比传统2D网格结构更有利于搜索引导生成。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探索token结构如何影响通过测试时搜索来引导生成的能力。当前自回归生成模型通常使用描述局部信息的token（如图像像素区域或文本词片段），并以固定顺序预测这些token。研究者想知道不同的token结构是否会影响在测试时通过搜索和验证器评估来引导生成的效果。
AI.method: 研究方法包括：1）使用图像生成作为测试平台；2）比较具有从粗到细顺序结构的1D tokenizer与传统2D网格结构tokenizer；3）进行受控实验分析不同token结构对测试时扩展行为的影响；4）研究纯测试时搜索在有序token结构上的效果；5）系统研究经典搜索算法（best-of-N、束搜索、前瞻搜索）与不同token结构的交互作用；6）分析不同验证器和自回归先验的作用。
AI.result: 研究结果显示：1）在从粗到细有序token上训练的自回归模型比基于网格的模型表现出更好的测试时扩展行为；2）得益于有序结构，纯测试时搜索可以在图像-文本验证器的引导下实现无需训练的文本到图像生成；3）系统分析了不同搜索算法与token结构的交互作用，以及不同验证器和自回归先验的影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论强调token结构对推理时扩展性的重要影响，为自回归模型中的测试时扩展提供了实用指导。从粗到细的顺序token结构因其中间状态具有语义意义而更有利于验证器评估，从而在生成过程中实现有效引导。

title: Bureaucratic Silences: What the Canadian AI Register Reveals, Omits, and Obscures
summary: In November 2025, the Government of Canada operationalized its commitment to transparency by releasing its first Federal AI Register. In this paper, we argue that such registers are not neutral mirrors of government activity, but active instruments of ontological design that configure the boundaries of accountability. We analyzed the Register's complete dataset of 409 systems using the Algorithmic Decision-Making Adapted for the Public Sector (ADMAPS) framework, combining quantitative mapping with deductive qualitative coding. Our findings reveal a sharp divergence between the rhetoric of "sovereign AI" and the reality of bureaucratic practice: while 86\% of systems are deployed internally for efficiency, the Register systematically obscures the human discretion, training, and uncertainty management required to operate them. By privileging technical descriptions over sociotechnical context, the Register constructs an ontology of AI as "reliable tooling" rather than "contestable decision-making." We conclude that without a shift in design, such transparency artifacts risk automating accountability into a performative compliance exercise, offering visibility without contestability.

AI.tldr: 加拿大联邦AI注册表作为透明度工具，实际上通过技术化描述构建了AI作为"可靠工具"而非"可争议决策"的本体论，可能将问责制自动化成表演性合规
AI.motivation: 分析加拿大联邦AI注册表作为透明度工具的实质作用，探讨其如何通过设计影响问责制的边界和性质
AI.method: 使用ADMAPS框架分析注册表中409个系统的完整数据集，结合定量映射和演绎性定性编码方法
AI.result: 发现86%的系统用于内部效率提升，注册表系统性地掩盖了操作AI所需的人类裁量、培训和不确定性管理，通过技术描述优先于社会技术背景，构建了AI作为"可靠工具"的本体论
AI.conclusion: 如果不改变设计，此类透明度工具可能将问责制自动化成表演性合规练习，提供可见性但缺乏可争议性

title: Frequency-Aware Flow Matching for High-Quality Image Generation
summary: Flow matching models have emerged as a powerful framework for realistic image generation by learning to reverse a corruption process that progressively adds Gaussian noise. However, because noise is injected in the latent domain, its impact on different frequency components is non-uniform. As a result, during inference, flow matching models tend to generate low-frequency components (global structure) in the early stages, while high-frequency components (fine details) emerge only later in the reverse process. Building on this insight, we propose Frequency-Aware Flow Matching (FreqFlow), a novel approach that explicitly incorporates frequency-aware conditioning into the flow matching framework via time-dependent adaptive weighting. We introduce a two-branch architecture: (1) a frequency branch that separately processes low- and high-frequency components to capture global structure and refine textures and edges, and (2) a spatial branch that synthesizes images in the latent domain, guided by the frequency branch's output. By explicitly integrating frequency information into the generation process, FreqFlow ensures that both large-scale coherence and fine-grained details are effectively modeled low-frequency conditioning reinforces global structure, while high-frequency conditioning enhances texture fidelity and detail sharpness. On the class-conditional ImageNet-256 generation benchmark, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with an FID of 1.38, surpassing the prior diffusion model DiT and flow matching model SiT by 0.79 and 0.58 FID, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/OliverRensu/FreqFlow.

AI.tldr: FreqFlow是一种频率感知的流匹配方法，通过时间依赖的自适应加权将频率感知条件引入图像生成过程，解决了传统流匹配模型中低频和高频分量生成不同步的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统流匹配模型在潜在域注入噪声时，对不同频率分量的影响不均匀，导致推理过程中低频分量（全局结构）早期生成，而高频分量（细节）后期才出现，这限制了生成图像的质量和细节保真度。
AI.method: 提出频率感知流匹配（FreqFlow），采用双分支架构：1）频率分支分别处理低频和高频分量以捕获全局结构和细化纹理边缘；2）空间分支在潜在域合成图像，受频率分支输出指导。通过时间依赖的自适应加权将频率信息显式整合到生成过程中。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256类别条件生成基准测试中，FreqFlow取得了1.38的FID分数，优于之前的扩散模型DiT（2.17 FID）和流匹配模型SiT（1.96 FID），分别提升了0.79和0.58 FID。
AI.conclusion: FreqFlow通过显式整合频率信息到流匹配框架中，有效建模了大尺度一致性和细粒度细节，低频条件强化了全局结构，高频条件增强了纹理保真度和细节清晰度，实现了最先进的图像生成性能。

title: LACE: Lattice Attention for Cross-thread Exploration
summary: Current large language models reason in isolation. Although it is common to sample multiple reasoning paths in parallel, these trajectories do not interact, and often fail in the same redundant ways. We introduce LACE, a framework that transforms reasoning from a collection of independent trials into a coordinated, parallel process. By repurposing the model architecture to enable cross-thread attention, LACE allows concurrent reasoning paths to share intermediate insights and correct one another during inference. A central challenge is the absence of natural training data that exhibits such collaborative behavior. We address this gap with a synthetic data pipeline that explicitly teaches models to communicate and error-correct across threads. Experiments show that this unified exploration substantially outperforms standard parallel search, improving reasoning accuracy by over 7 points. Our results suggest that large language models can be more effective when parallel reasoning paths are allowed to interact.

AI.tldr: LACE框架让大语言模型的并行推理路径能够相互交流，通过跨线程注意力机制实现推理路径间的协作与纠错，显著提升推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型的推理过程是孤立的，即使并行采样多个推理路径，这些路径之间没有交互，容易在相同的地方重复失败。需要一种能让并行推理路径相互协作的方法。
AI.method: LACE框架通过改造模型架构，引入跨线程注意力机制，使并发推理路径能够共享中间见解并在推理过程中相互纠正。为解决缺乏协作训练数据的问题，开发了合成数据管道来明确教授模型跨线程通信和纠错能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，这种统一的探索方法显著优于标准并行搜索，将推理准确率提高了7个百分点以上。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在允许并行推理路径相互交互时会更加有效，LACE框架为实现这种协作推理提供了可行方案。

title: LLM attribution analysis across different fine-tuning strategies and model scales for automated code compliance
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures. Accepted at ICCCBE 2026 (International Conference on Computing in Civil and Building Engineering)
summary: Existing research on large language models (LLMs) for automated code compliance has primarily focused on performance, treating the models as black boxes and overlooking how training decisions affect their interpretive behavior. This paper addresses this gap by employing a perturbation-based attribution analysis to compare the interpretive behaviors of LLMs across different fine-tuning strategies such as full fine-tuning (FFT), low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and quantized LoRA fine-tuning, as well as the impact of model scales which include varying LLM parameter sizes. Our results show that FFT produces attribution patterns that are statistically different and more focused than those from parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods. Furthermore, we found that as model scale increases, LLMs develop specific interpretive strategies such as prioritizing numerical constraints and rule identifiers in the building text, albeit with performance gains in semantic similarity of the generated and reference computer-processable rules plateauing for models larger than 7B. This paper provides crucial insights into the explainability of these models, taking a step toward building more transparent LLMs for critical, regulation-based tasks in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过扰动归因分析比较不同微调策略和模型规模对LLM解释行为的影响，发现全微调产生更聚焦的归因模式，且模型规模增大会发展特定解释策略，但性能增益在7B以上模型趋于平稳。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注LLM在代码合规性检查中的性能表现，将模型视为黑箱，忽视了训练决策如何影响模型的解释行为。本文旨在填补这一空白，研究不同微调策略和模型规模如何影响LLM的解释行为。
AI.method: 采用基于扰动的归因分析方法，比较不同微调策略（全微调FFT、低秩适应LoRA和量化LoRA微调）以及不同参数规模LLM的解释行为差异。
AI.result: 1. 全微调产生的归因模式在统计上不同于参数高效微调方法，且更加聚焦；2. 随着模型规模增加，LLM发展出特定解释策略（如优先处理数值约束和规则标识符）；3. 模型规模超过7B后，生成的计算机可处理规则与参考规则的语义相似性性能增益趋于平稳。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为LLM的可解释性提供了重要见解，朝着为建筑、工程和施工行业的关键法规任务构建更透明的LLM迈出了一步，强调了考虑训练决策对模型解释行为影响的重要性。

title: UA-Net: Uncertainty-Aware Network for TRISO Image Semantic Segmentation
summary: Tristructural isotropic (TRISO)-coated particle fuels undergo dimensional changes and chemical reactions during high-temperature neutron irradiation. Post-irradiation materialography helps understand processes that impact fuel performance, such as coating integrity and fission product retention. Conventionally, experts manually evaluate features in thousands of cross sections of sub-mm-sized samples, which is tedious and subjective. In this work, we propose UA-Net, a deep learning framework that segments five characteristic regions of TRISO fuel micrographs and generates an uncertainty map for predictions. The model uses a multi-stage pretraining strategy, starting with general image representations learned from ImageNet, followed by fine-tuning on TRISO micrographs from various irradiation experiments and AGR-5/6/7 particle cross sections. A meta-model for uncertainty prediction is integrated to identify small defects in TRISO images. UA-Net was evaluated on a test set of 102 images, achieving mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) and mean Precision (mP) of 95.5% and 97.3%, respectively. The meta-model achieved a specificity of 91.8% and sensitivity of 93.5%, demonstrating strong performance in detecting misclassifications. The model was also applied to new TRISO images for qualitative evaluation, showing high accuracy in extracting layer regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UA-Net深度学习框架，用于自动分割TRISO燃料微观图像中的五个特征区域并生成预测不确定性图，解决了传统人工评估的繁琐和主观性问题。
AI.motivation: TRISO涂层颗粒燃料在高温中子辐照下会发生尺寸变化和化学反应，传统上专家需要手动评估数千个亚毫米尺寸样品的横截面特征，这一过程既繁琐又主观，需要自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 提出UA-Net深度学习框架，采用多阶段预训练策略：首先从ImageNet学习通用图像表示，然后在来自不同辐照实验和AGR-5/6/7颗粒横截面的TRISO微观图像上进行微调。集成元模型进行不确定性预测，以识别TRISO图像中的小缺陷。
AI.result: 在102张图像的测试集上，UA-Net实现了95.5%的平均交并比(mIoU)和97.3%的平均精度(mP)。元模型实现了91.8%的特异性和93.5%的敏感性，在检测错误分类方面表现出色。应用于新TRISO图像的定性评估也显示出提取层区域的高准确性。
AI.conclusion: UA-Net深度学习框架能够高效、准确地分割TRISO燃料微观图像特征区域并评估预测不确定性，为燃料性能分析提供了自动化工具，显著优于传统人工评估方法。

title: Preregistered Belief Revision Contracts
summary: Deliberative multi-agent systems allow agents to exchange messages and revise beliefs over time. While this interaction is meant to improve performance, it can also create dangerous conformity effects: agreement, confidence, prestige, or majority size may be treated as if they were evidence, producing high-confidence convergence to false conclusions. To address this, we introduce PBRC (Preregistered Belief Revision Contracts), a protocol-level mechanism that strictly separates open communication from admissible epistemic change. A PBRC contract publicly fixes first-order evidence triggers, admissible revision operators, a priority rule, and a fallback policy. A non-fallback step is accepted only when it cites a preregistered trigger and provides a nonempty witness set of externally validated evidence tokens. This ensures that every substantive belief change is both enforceable by a router and auditable after the fact. In this paper, (a) we prove that under evidential contracts with conservative fallback, social-only rounds cannot increase confidence and cannot generate purely conformity-driven wrong-but-sure cascades. (b) We show that auditable trigger protocols admit evidential PBRC normal forms that preserve belief trajectories and canonicalized audit traces. (c) We demonstrate that sound enforcement yields epistemic accountability: any change of top hypothesis is attributable to a concrete validated witness set. For token-invariant contracts, (d) we prove that enforced trajectories depend only on token-exposure traces; under flooding dissemination, these traces are characterized exactly by truncated reachability, giving tight diameter bounds for universal evidence closure. Finally, we introduce a companion contractual dynamic doxastic logic to specify trace invariants, and provide simulations illustrating cascade suppression, auditability, and robustness-liveness trade-offs.

AI.tldr: PBRC协议通过预注册证据触发器和见证集机制，分离开放通信与信念修正，防止群体思维导致的错误共识，确保信念变化的可审计性和可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中，智能体通过交换信息和修正信念来提升性能，但可能产生危险的从众效应：共识、信心、声望或多数意见可能被当作证据，导致高置信度的错误结论收敛。
AI.method: 提出PBRC（预注册信念修正合约）协议机制，公开固定一阶证据触发器、可接受的修正算子、优先级规则和回退策略。非回退步骤必须引用预注册触发器并提供非空的外部验证证据见证集。
AI.result: 证明在保守回退的证据合约下，纯社交轮次不能增加置信度，也不能产生纯粹从众驱动的错误确信级联；可审计触发器协议允许保持信念轨迹和规范化审计痕迹的PBRC范式；强制执行产生认知可问责性。
AI.conclusion: PBRC协议通过分离通信与信念修正，防止从众驱动的错误级联，确保信念变化的可执行性和可审计性，为多智能体系统提供了认知问责机制。

title: DALM: A Domain-Algebraic Language Model via Three-Phase Structured Generation
summary: Large language models compress heterogeneous knowledge into a single parameter space, allowing facts from different domains to interfere during generation. We propose DALM, a Domain-Algebraic Language Model that replaces unconstrained token generation with structured denoising over a domain lattice. DALM follows a three-phase generation path: it first resolves domain uncertainty, then relation uncertainty, and finally concept uncertainty, so each stage operates under explicit algebraic constraints. The framework requires only three ingredients: a lattice of domains with computable meet, join, and implication; a typing function over relations that controls inheritance across domains; and a fiber partition that localizes knowledge to domain-specific subsets. Given these ingredients, DALM yields a three-phase encoder-decoder architecture in which generation is confined to a domain fiber, cross-domain contamination is structurally prevented in closed-vocabulary mode and auditably bounded in open-vocabulary mode, and a single query can produce a domain-indexed multi-perspective answer space. We instantiate the framework with the CDC knowledge representation system and outline training and evaluation on validated domain-annotated crystal libraries. DALM reframes language generation as algebraically constrained structured denoising rather than unconstrained decoding over a flat token space.

AI.tldr: DALM是一种领域代数语言模型，用结构化去噪替代无约束的token生成，通过领域格的三阶段生成路径解决知识干扰问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型将异构知识压缩到单一参数空间，导致不同领域的事实相互干扰。需要一种能结构化控制生成过程、防止跨领域污染的方法。
AI.method: 提出DALM框架：1) 定义可计算交、并、蕴含的领域格；2) 控制跨领域继承的关系类型函数；3) 将知识局部化到领域特定子集的纤维划分。采用三阶段编码器-解码器架构：先解决领域不确定性，再解决关系不确定性，最后解决概念不确定性。
AI.result: DALM将生成限制在领域纤维内，在封闭词汇模式下结构性防止跨领域污染，在开放词汇模式下可审计地限制污染，单个查询可产生领域索引的多视角答案空间。
AI.conclusion: DALM将语言生成重新定义为代数约束的结构化去噪过程，而非在平坦token空间上的无约束解码，为知识表示和生成提供了新的代数框架。

title: Subliminal Transfer of Unsafe Behaviors in AI Agent Distillation
summary: Recent work on subliminal learning demonstrates that language models can transmit semantic traits through data that is semantically unrelated to those traits. However, it remains unclear whether behavioral traits can transfer in agentic systems, where policies are learned from trajectories rather than static text. In this work, we provide the first empirical evidence that unsafe agent behaviors can transfer subliminally through model distillation across two complementary experimental settings. In our primary setting, we construct a teacher agent exhibiting a strong deletion bias, a tendency to perform destructive file-system actions via an API-style tool interface, and distill it into a student using only trajectories from ostensibly safe tasks, with all explicit deletion keywords rigorously filtered. In our secondary setting, we replicate the threat model in a native Bash environment, replacing API tool calls with shell commands and operationalizing the bias as a preference for issuing chmod as the first permission-related command over semantically equivalent alternatives such as chown or setfacl. Despite full keyword sanitation in both settings, students inherit measurable behavioral biases. In the API setting the student's deletion rate reaches 100% (versus a 5% baseline) under homogeneous distillation; in the Bash setting the student's chmod-first rate reaches 30%-55% (versus a 0%-10% baseline), with the strongest transfer observed in large-to-small distillation. Our results demonstrate that explicit data sanitation is an insufficient defense, and behavioral biases are encoded implicitly in trajectory dynamics regardless of the tool interface.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，即使经过严格的关键词过滤，不安全的智能体行为仍可通过模型蒸馏在轨迹数据中隐性传播，数据清洗不足以防御此类威胁。
AI.motivation: 探索在智能体系统中，行为特征是否能够像语言模型中的语义特征一样通过看似无关的数据进行隐性传播，特别是在策略学习基于轨迹而非静态文本的情况下。
AI.method: 通过两个互补实验设置：1) API工具接口环境中构建具有强烈删除偏见的教师智能体，使用严格过滤删除关键词的轨迹进行蒸馏；2) Bash环境中用shell命令替代API调用，将偏见操作化为优先使用chmod而非语义等效的替代命令。
AI.result: 尽管进行了完整的关键词清洗，学生智能体仍继承了可测量的行为偏见：API环境中删除率达到100%（基线5%），Bash环境中chmod优先率达到30%-55%（基线0%-10%），大模型到小模型的蒸馏中转移效应最强。
AI.conclusion: 行为偏见被隐式编码在轨迹动态中，不受工具接口影响，明确的数据清洗不足以防御此类隐性威胁，需要在智能体安全领域开发更强大的防御机制。

title: LLMs Corrupt Your Documents When You Delegate
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are poised to disrupt knowledge work, with the emergence of delegated work as a new interaction paradigm (e.g., vibe coding). Delegation requires trust - the expectation that the LLM will faithfully execute the task without introducing errors into documents. We introduce DELEGATE-52 to study the readiness of AI systems in delegated workflows. DELEGATE-52 simulates long delegated workflows that require in-depth document editing across 52 professional domains, such as coding, crystallography, and music notation. Our large-scale experiment with 19 LLMs reveals that current models degrade documents during delegation: even frontier models (Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude 4.6 Opus, GPT 5.4) corrupt an average of 25% of document content by the end of long workflows, with other models failing more severely. Additional experiments reveal that agentic tool use does not improve performance on DELEGATE-52, and that degradation severity is exacerbated by document size, length of interaction, or presence of distractor files. Our analysis shows that current LLMs are unreliable delegates: they introduce sparse but severe errors that silently corrupt documents, compounding over long interaction.

AI.tldr: 研究评估LLM在委托工作流中的可靠性，发现即使是前沿模型在长工作流中也会损坏25%的文档内容，代理工具使用无法改善性能，文档大小、交互长度和干扰文件会加剧退化。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在知识工作中的广泛应用，委托工作成为一种新的交互范式，但委托需要信任——期望LLM能够忠实执行任务而不在文档中引入错误。当前缺乏对AI系统在委托工作流中准备情况的研究。
AI.method: 引入DELEGATE-52基准，模拟需要深入文档编辑的长委托工作流，涵盖52个专业领域（如编程、晶体学、音乐记谱）。对19个LLM进行大规模实验，包括前沿模型如Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude 4.6 Opus、GPT 5.4。
AI.result: 当前模型在委托过程中会损坏文档：即使是前沿模型在长工作流结束时平均损坏25%的文档内容，其他模型失败更严重。代理工具使用无法改善DELEGATE-52上的性能，退化严重程度会因文档大小、交互长度或干扰文件的存在而加剧。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM是不可靠的委托代理：它们会引入稀疏但严重的错误，静默地损坏文档，并在长时间交互中累积。这表明LLM在委托工作流中尚未准备好可靠使用。

title: Bilevel Optimization of Agent Skills via Monte Carlo Tree Search
summary: Agent \texttt{skills} are structured collections of instructions, tools, and supporting resources that help large language model (LLM) agents perform particular classes of tasks. Empirical evidence shows that the design of \texttt{skills} can materially affect agent task performance, yet systematically optimizing \texttt{skills} remains challenging. Since a \texttt{skill} comprises instructions, tools, and supporting resources in a structured way, optimizing it requires jointly determining both the structure of these components and the content each component contains. This gives rise to a complex decision space with strong interdependence across structure and components. We therefore represent these two coupled decisions as \texttt{skill} structure and component content, and formulate \texttt{skill} optimization as a bilevel optimization problem. We propose a bilevel optimization framework in which an outer loop employs Monte Carlo Tree Search to determine the \texttt{skill} structure, while an inner loop refines the component content within the structure selected by the outer loop. In both loops, we employ LLMs to assist the optimization procedure. We evaluate the proposed framework on an open-source Operations Research Question Answering dataset, and the experimental results suggest that the bilevel optimization framework improves the performance of the agents with the optimized \texttt{skill}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种双层优化框架，用于优化LLM代理的技能结构，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索优化技能结构，内层循环优化组件内容，从而提升代理任务性能。
AI.motivation: 技能（包含指令、工具和支持资源的结构化集合）的设计显著影响LLM代理的任务性能，但系统化优化技能面临挑战，因为需要同时确定组件结构和内容，决策空间复杂且存在强相互依赖。
AI.method: 将技能优化建模为双层优化问题：外层循环使用蒙特卡洛树搜索确定技能结构，内层循环在选定结构内优化组件内容。两个循环都利用LLM辅助优化过程。
AI.result: 在开源运筹学问答数据集上的实验结果表明，该双层优化框架能够有效提升使用优化后技能的代理性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双层优化框架成功解决了技能优化的复杂决策问题，通过分离结构和内容优化，利用LLM辅助搜索，显著改善了LLM代理的任务表现。

title: GroupDPO: Memory efficient Group-wise Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Preference optimization is widely used to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with preference feedback. However, most existing methods train on a single positive-negative pair per prompt, discarding additional supervision available in preference datasets that typically contain multiple candidate responses. Motivated by this limitation, recent work explores group-wise preference optimization, which jointly contrasts multiple responses for the same prompt, but its empirical behavior and scalability remain underexplored due to the memory overhead of group-coupled objectives. In this work, we introduce a memory-efficient group-wise preference optimization algorithm that preserves gradients while decoupling samples during backpropagation, substantially reducing peak memory usage, which enables scalable training with larger group sizes. Across both offline and online alignment settings, we show that leveraging multiple responses consistently outperforms single-pair training. Furthermore, incorporating a negative log-likelihood (NLL) term on positive responses is critical for both performance gains and training stability.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种内存高效的组级偏好优化算法，通过解耦样本减少内存开销，支持更大组规模训练，在离线和在线对齐中均优于单对训练
AI.motivation: 现有偏好优化方法通常只使用每个提示的一个正负样本对，忽略了偏好数据集中通常包含多个候选响应的额外监督信息。虽然最近有工作探索组级偏好优化，但其经验行为和可扩展性因组耦合目标的内存开销而研究不足。
AI.method: 提出内存高效的组级偏好优化算法，在保持梯度的同时解耦反向传播过程中的样本，显著降低峰值内存使用，支持更大组规模的训练。同时发现结合正响应的负对数似然（NLL）项对性能提升和训练稳定性至关重要。
AI.result: 在离线和在线对齐设置中，利用多个响应的组级训练始终优于单对训练。内存优化算法使更大组规模的训练成为可能，NLL项的加入显著提升性能并增强训练稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 组级偏好优化是有效利用偏好数据集中多个候选响应监督信息的有前景方向，提出的内存高效算法解决了可扩展性问题，为大规模语言模型对齐提供了更强大的训练方法。

title: AdaVFM: Adaptive Vision Foundation Models for Edge Intelligence via LLM-Guided Execution
summary: Language-aligned vision foundation models (VFMs) enable versatile visual understanding for always-on contextual AI, but their deployment on edge devices is hindered by strict latency and power constraints. We present AdaVFM, an adaptive framework for efficient on-device inference of language-aligned VFMs that dynamically adjusts computation based on scene context and task complexity. Our key insight is that the effect of model size reduction on performance is task-dependent in vision applications, motivating a runtime-adaptive execution strategy. AdaVFM integrates neural architecture search (NAS) into the language-aligned VFM backbone to enable lightweight subnet execution during runtime. A multimodal large language model (LLM) deployed on the cloud enables runtime control with a context-aware agent. This synergy allows efficient model adaptation under diverse conditions while maintaining strong accuracy. Extensive experiments on zero-shot classification and open-vocabulary segmentation demonstrate that AdaVFM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-offs, surpassing prior baselines by up to $7.9\%$ in acc@1 on IN1K and $5.2\%$ mIoU on ADE20K over the best models of comparable VFM sizes. For models with similar accuracy, AdaVFM further reduces average FLOPs by up to $77.9\%$.

AI.tldr: AdaVFM是一个自适应框架，用于在边缘设备上高效运行语言对齐的视觉基础模型，通过动态调整计算量来适应场景上下文和任务复杂度，实现准确性和效率的最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 语言对齐的视觉基础模型在边缘设备部署面临严格的延迟和功耗限制，需要一种能够根据场景和任务动态调整计算量的高效推理框架。
AI.method: 将神经架构搜索集成到语言对齐的视觉基础模型主干中，支持运行时执行轻量子网络；利用云端多模态大语言模型作为上下文感知代理进行运行时控制。
AI.result: 在零样本分类和开放词汇分割任务上，AdaVFM实现了最先进的准确性-效率权衡，在IN1K上比同类模型准确率提升7.9%，在ADE20K上mIoU提升5.2%；在保持相似准确性的情况下，平均FLOPs减少高达77.9%。
AI.conclusion: AdaVFM通过自适应计算策略有效解决了语言对齐视觉基础模型在边缘设备部署的效率和准确性平衡问题，为实时视觉理解应用提供了可行的解决方案。

title: The World Leaks the Future: Harness Evolution for Future Prediction Agents
summary: Many consequential decisions must be made before the relevant outcome is known. Such problems are commonly framed as \emph{future prediction}, where an LLM agent must form a prediction for an unresolved question using only the public information available at the prediction time. The setting is difficult because public evidence evolves while useful supervision arrives only after the question is resolved, so most existing approaches still improve mainly from final outcomes. Yet final outcomes are too coarse to guide earlier factor tracking, evidence gathering and interpretation, or uncertainty handling. When the same unresolved question is revisited over time, temporal contrasts between earlier and later predictions can expose omissions in the earlier prediction process; we call this signal \emph{internal feedback}. We introduce \emph{Milkyway}, a self-evolving agent system that keeps the base model fixed and instead updates a persistent \emph{future prediction harness} for factor tracking, evidence gathering and interpretation, and uncertainty handling. Across repeated predictions on the same unresolved question, \emph{Milkyway} extracts internal feedback and writes reusable guidance back into the harness, so later predictions on that question can improve before the outcome is known. After the question is resolved, the final outcome provides a \emph{retrospective check} before the updated harness is carried forward to subsequent questions. On FutureX and FutureWorld, Milkyway achieves the best overall score among the compared methods, improving FutureX from 44.07 to 60.90 and FutureWorld from 62.22 to 77.96.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Milkyway系统，通过内部反馈机制让LLM代理在问题解决前持续改进预测，而非仅依赖最终结果监督。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依赖最终结果监督，但最终结果过于粗糙，无法指导早期因素追踪、证据收集与解释、不确定性处理等过程。当同一未解决问题随时间重复预测时，早期和后期预测之间的时间对比可以暴露早期预测过程的遗漏。
AI.method: 提出Milkyway自进化代理系统，保持基础模型固定，更新持久化的未来预测工具链（包括因素追踪、证据收集与解释、不确定性处理）。通过重复预测同一未解决问题，提取内部反馈并将可重用指导写回工具链，使后续预测在结果未知前就能改进。问题解决后，最终结果提供回顾性检查，更新后的工具链用于后续问题。
AI.result: 在FutureX和FutureWorld数据集上，Milkyway取得了最佳总体分数，将FutureX从44.07提升到60.90，FutureWorld从62.22提升到77.96。
AI.conclusion: 内部反馈机制使LLM代理能够在问题解决前持续改进预测过程，通过时间对比暴露早期预测的遗漏，比仅依赖最终结果监督更有效地指导预测系统的进化。

title: Imperfectly Cooperative Human-AI Interactions: Comparing the Impacts of Human and AI Attributes in Simulated and User Studies
comment: Will be presented at ACL 2026 and published in the Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
summary: AI design characteristics and human personality traits each impact the quality and outcomes of human-AI interactions. However, their relative and joint impacts are underexplored in imperfectly cooperative scenarios, where people and AI only have partially aligned goals and objectives. This study compares a purely simulated dataset comprising 2,000 simulations and a parallel human subjects experiment involving 290 human participants to investigate these effects across two scenario categories: (1) hiring negotiations between human job candidates and AI hiring agents; and (2) human-AI transactions wherein AI agents may conceal information to maximize internal goals. We examine user Extraversion and Agreeableness alongside AI design characteristics, including Adaptability, Expertise, and chain-of-thought Transparency. Our causal discovery analysis extends performance-focused evaluations by integrating scenario-based outcomes, communication analysis, and questionnaire measures. Results reveal divergences between purely simulated and human study datasets, and between scenario types. In simulation experiments, personality traits and AI attributes were comparatively influential. Yet, with actual human subjects, AI attributes -- particularly transparency -- were much more impactful. We discuss how these divergences vary across different interaction contexts, offering crucial insights for the future of human-centered AI agents.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了模拟数据集和人类实验，探讨了AI设计特征与人类人格特质在不完全合作场景中对人机交互的相对和联合影响。
AI.motivation: AI设计特征和人类人格特质都会影响人机交互的质量和结果，但在不完全合作场景中（人与AI只有部分目标一致），它们的相对和联合影响尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 研究比较了包含2000次模拟的纯模拟数据集和涉及290名人类参与者的平行实验，涵盖两种场景：1) 人类求职者与AI招聘代理之间的招聘谈判；2) AI代理可能隐瞒信息以实现内部目标的人机交易。研究了用户外向性和宜人性，以及AI的适应性、专业性和思维链透明度等设计特征。
AI.result: 结果揭示了纯模拟数据集与人类研究数据集之间以及不同场景类型之间的差异。在模拟实验中，人格特质和AI属性都有较大影响；但在实际人类实验中，AI属性（特别是透明度）的影响要大得多。
AI.conclusion: 这些差异在不同交互情境中有所不同，为未来以人为本的AI代理设计提供了重要见解。

title: LLM Reasoning Is Latent, Not the Chain of Thought
summary: This position paper argues that large language model (LLM) reasoning should be studied as latent-state trajectory formation rather than as faithful surface chain-of-thought (CoT). This matters because claims about faithfulness, interpretability, reasoning benchmarks, and inference-time intervention all depend on what the field takes the primary object of reasoning to be. We ask what that object should be once three often-confounded factors are separated and formalize three competing hypotheses: H1, reasoning is primarily mediated by latent-state trajectories; H2, reasoning is primarily mediated by explicit surface CoT; and H0, most apparent reasoning gains are better explained by generic serial compute than by any privileged representational object. Reorganizing recent empirical, mechanistic, and survey work under this framework, and adding compute-audited worked exemplars that factorize surface traces, latent interventions, and matched budget expansions, we find that current evidence most strongly supports H1 as a default working hypothesis rather than as a task-independent verdict. We therefore make two recommendations: the field should treat latent-state dynamics as the default object of study for LLM reasoning, and it should evaluate reasoning with designs that explicitly disentangle surface traces, latent states, and serial compute.

AI.tldr: 该立场论文主张将大语言模型推理视为潜在状态轨迹形成而非忠实表面思维链，提出三个竞争假设，并通过证据分析支持将潜在状态动态作为LLM推理研究的主要对象。
AI.motivation: 当前关于LLM推理的研究存在概念混淆，将表面思维链、潜在状态和序列计算混为一谈，这影响了推理忠实性、可解释性、基准测试和干预研究的有效性。需要明确推理的主要研究对象。
AI.method: 提出三个竞争假设：H1（推理主要由潜在状态轨迹介导）、H2（推理主要由显式表面思维链介导）、H0（推理增益主要由通用序列计算解释）。通过重组现有实证、机制和调查研究，并添加计算审计的工作示例来分离表面痕迹、潜在干预和匹配预算扩展。
AI.result: 当前证据最强烈支持H1作为默认工作假设，即推理主要由潜在状态轨迹介导，而非表面思维链或通用序列计算。这为LLM推理研究提供了更准确的理论框架。
AI.conclusion: 建议领域应将潜在状态动态作为LLM推理研究的默认对象，并采用能够明确分离表面痕迹、潜在状态和序列计算的设计来评估推理能力。

title: Causal Bootstrapped Alignment for Unsupervised Video-Based Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
summary: VVI-ReID is a critical technique for all-day surveillance, where temporal information provides additional cues beyond static images. However, existing approaches rely heavily on fully supervised learning with expensive cross-modality annotations, limiting scalability. To address this issue, we investigate Unsupervised Learning for VVI-ReID (USL-VVI-ReID), which learns identity-discriminative representations directly from unlabeled video tracklets. Directly extending image-based USL-VI-ReID methods to this setting with generic pretrained encoders leads to suboptimal performance. Such encoders suffer from weak identity discrimination and strong modality bias, resulting in severe intra-modality identity confusion and pronounced clustering granularity imbalance between visible and infrared modalities. These issues jointly degrade pseudo-label reliability and hinder effective cross-modality alignment. To address these challenges, we propose a Causal Bootstrapped Alignment (CBA) framework that explicitly exploits inherent video priors. First, we introduce Causal Intervention Warm-up (CIW), which performs sequence-level causal interventions by leveraging temporal identity consistency and cross-modality identity consistency to suppress modality- and motion-induced spurious correlations while preserving identity-relevant semantics, yielding cleaner representations for unsupervised clustering. Second, we propose Prototype-Guided Uncertainty Refinement (PGUR), which employs a coarse-to-fine alignment strategy to resolve cross-modality granularity mismatch, reorganizing under-clustered infrared representations under the guidance of reliable visible prototypes with uncertainty-aware supervision. Extensive experiments on the HITSZ-VCM and BUPTCampus benchmarks demonstrate that CBA significantly outperforms existing USL-VI-ReID methods when extended to the USL-VVI-ReID setting.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于无监督可见光-红外视频行人重识别（USL-VVI-ReID）的因果引导对齐框架，通过因果干预预热和原型引导不确定性细化来解决模态偏差和聚类粒度不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有VVI-ReID方法严重依赖昂贵的跨模态标注进行全监督学习，限制了可扩展性。无监督学习方法直接应用于视频场景时，由于预训练编码器存在弱身份判别性和强模态偏差，导致严重的模态内身份混淆和跨模态聚类粒度不平衡，从而降低伪标签可靠性并阻碍有效的跨模态对齐。
AI.method: 提出因果引导对齐（CBA）框架：1）因果干预预热（CIW）：利用时间身份一致性和跨模态身份一致性进行序列级因果干预，抑制模态和运动引起的虚假相关性，保留身份相关语义；2）原型引导不确定性细化（PGUR）：采用粗到细对齐策略解决跨模态粒度不匹配问题，在可靠可见原型指导下重新组织欠聚类的红外表示，并使用不确定性感知监督。
AI.result: 在HITSZ-VCM和BUPTCampus基准测试上的大量实验表明，CBA在USL-VVI-ReID设置下显著优于现有的USL-VI-ReID方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了利用视频先验进行无监督VVI-ReID的有效性，提出的CBA框架通过因果干预和原型引导对齐成功解决了模态偏差和聚类粒度不平衡问题，为全天候监控系统提供了可扩展的无监督解决方案。

title: Structured Abductive-Deductive-Inductive Reasoning for LLMs via Algebraic Invariants
comment: 10 pages + 3 pages references. Accepted as a poster at the ICLR 2026 Workshop for LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models exhibit systematic limitations in structured logical reasoning: they conflate hypothesis generation with verification, cannot distinguish conjecture from validated knowledge, and allow weak reasoning steps to propagate unchecked through inference chains. We present a symbolic reasoning scaffold that operationalizes Peirce's tripartite inference -- abduction, deduction, and induction -- as an explicit protocol for LLM-assisted reasoning. The framework enforces logical consistency through five algebraic invariants (the Gamma Quintet), the strongest of which -- the Weakest Link bound -- ensures that no conclusion in a reasoning chain can exceed the reliability of its least-supported premise. This principle, independently grounded as weakest link resolution in possibilistic logic and empirically validated for chain-of-thought reasoning, prevents logical inconsistencies from accumulating across multi-step inference. We verify all invariants through a property-based testing suite of 100 properties and 16 fuzz tests over 10^5+ generated cases, providing a verified reference implementation of the invariants suitable as a foundation for future reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个符号推理框架，将皮尔士的三段推理（溯因、演绎、归纳）作为LLM辅助推理的明确协议，通过五个代数不变量确保逻辑一致性，其中"最弱链接界限"确保推理链中的结论可靠性不超过其最弱前提。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在结构化逻辑推理中存在系统性局限：混淆假设生成与验证、无法区分猜想与已验证知识、允许弱推理步骤在推理链中不受检查地传播。需要一种能够强制逻辑一致性的推理框架。
AI.method: 提出符号推理支架，将皮尔士的三段推理（溯因、演绎、归纳）操作化为LLM辅助推理的明确协议。通过五个代数不变量（Gamma五重奏）强制逻辑一致性，其中最核心的是"最弱链接界限"原则。该框架在可能性逻辑中独立地基于最弱链接解析，并通过基于属性的测试套件进行验证。
AI.result: 开发了包含100个属性和16个模糊测试的测试套件，在10^5+生成案例上验证了所有不变量。提供了经过验证的参考实现，可作为未来推理基准的基础。
AI.conclusion: 该符号推理框架通过强制执行代数不变量，特别是最弱链接界限，解决了LLM在结构化逻辑推理中的系统性局限，为构建可靠的多步推理系统提供了理论基础和验证实现。

title: CIG: Measuring Conversational Information Gain in Deliberative Dialogues with Semantic Memory Dynamics
summary: Measuring the quality of public deliberation requires evaluating not only civility or argument structure, but also the informational progress of a conversation. We introduce a framework for Conversational Information Gain (CIG) that evaluates each utterance in terms of how it advances collective understanding of the target topic. To operationalize CIG, we model an evolving semantic memory of the discussion: the system extracts atomic claims from utterances and incrementally consolidates them into a structured memory state. Using this memory, we score each utterance along three interpretable dimensions: Novelty, Relevance, and Implication Scope. We annotate 80 segments from two moderated deliberative settings (TV debates and community discussions) with these dimensions and show that memory-derived dynamics (e.g., the number of claim updates) correlate more strongly with human-perceived CIG than traditional heuristics such as utterance length or TF--IDF. We develop effective LLM-based CIG predictors paving the way for information-focused conversation quality analysis in dialogues and deliberative success.

AI.tldr: 提出对话信息增益（CIG）框架，通过建模语义记忆来评估对话中每个话语如何推进集体对话题的理解，包含新颖性、相关性和含义范围三个维度。
AI.motivation: 现有公共审议质量评估主要关注礼貌性或论证结构，但缺乏对对话信息进展的评估。需要一种能够衡量对话如何推进集体对话题理解的方法。
AI.method: 提出CIG框架，通过建模演化语义记忆：从话语中提取原子主张，逐步整合到结构化记忆状态中。基于记忆状态，从新颖性、相关性和含义范围三个维度评估每个话语。使用LLM开发有效的CIG预测器。
AI.result: 在两个有主持的审议场景（电视辩论和社区讨论）中标注80个片段，显示基于记忆的动态（如主张更新数量）比传统启发式方法（如话语长度或TF-IDF）与人类感知的CIG相关性更强。
AI.conclusion: CIG框架为对话和审议成功的信息中心质量分析铺平了道路，能够有效评估对话如何推进集体理解，优于传统评估方法。

title: SPLIT: Self-supervised Partitioning for Learned Inversion in Nonlinear Tomography
summary: Machine learning has achieved impressive performance in tomographic reconstruction, but supervised training requires paired measurements and ground-truth images that are often unavailable. This has motivated self-supervised approaches, which have primarily addressed denoising and, more recently, linear inverse problems. We address nonlinear inverse problems and introduce SPLIT (Self-supervised Partitioning for Learned Inversion in Nonlinear Tomography), a self-supervised machine-learning framework for reconstructing images from nonlinear, incomplete, and noisy projection data without any samples of ground-truth images. SPLIT enforces cross-partition consistency and measurement-domain fidelity while exploiting complementary information across multiple partitions. Our main theoretical result shows that, under mild conditions, the proposed self-supervised objective is equivalent to its supervised counterpart in expectation. We regularize training with an automatic stopping rule that halts optimization when a no-reference image-quality surrogate saturates. As a concrete application, we derive SPLIT variants for multispectral computed tomography. Experiments on sparse-view acquisitions demonstrate high reconstruction quality and robustness to noise, surpassing classical iterative reconstruction and recent self-supervised baselines.

AI.tldr: SPLIT是一种自监督学习框架，用于从非线性、不完整和噪声投影数据重建图像，无需真实图像样本，通过分区一致性和测量域保真度实现高质量重建。
AI.motivation: 传统监督学习方法在断层扫描重建中需要配对的测量数据和真实图像，但这些数据往往难以获取。现有的自监督方法主要处理去噪和线性逆问题，而实际应用中存在大量非线性逆问题需要解决。
AI.method: SPLIT框架通过强制跨分区一致性和测量域保真度，利用多个分区间的互补信息。主要理论结果表明，在温和条件下，该自监督目标在期望上等同于其监督对应物。训练通过自动停止规则进行正则化，当无参考图像质量替代指标饱和时停止优化。
AI.result: 在多光谱CT稀疏视图采集实验中，SPLIT展示了高质量的重建结果和良好的噪声鲁棒性，超越了经典迭代重建方法和最近的自监督基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SPLIT为非线性断层扫描提供了一种有效的自监督学习框架，无需真实图像样本即可实现高质量重建，在稀疏视图采集等实际应用中具有重要价值。

title: HyperGVL: Benchmarking and Improving Large Vision-Language Models in Hypergraph Understanding and Reasoning
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) consistently require new arenas to guide their expanding boundaries, yet their capabilities with hypergraphs remain unexplored. In the real world, hypergraphs have significant practical applications in areas such as life sciences and social communities. Recent advancements in LVLMs have shown promise in understanding complex topologies, yet there remains a lack of a benchmark to delineate the capabilities of LVLMs with hypergraphs, leaving the boundaries of their abilities unclear. To fill this gap, in this paper, we introduce $\texttt{HyperGVL}$, the first benchmark to evaluate the proficiency of LVLMs in hypergraph understanding and reasoning. $\texttt{HyperGVL}$ provides a comprehensive assessment of 12 advanced LVLMs across 84,000 vision-language question-answering (QA) samples spanning 12 tasks, ranging from basic component counting to complex NP-hard problem reasoning. The involved hypergraphs contain multiscale synthetic structures and real-world citation and protein networks. Moreover, we examine the effects of 12 textual and visual hypergraph representations and introduce a generalizable router $\texttt{WiseHyGR}$ that improves LVLMs in hypergraph via learning adaptive representations. We believe that this work is a step forward in connecting hypergraphs with LVLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个用于评估大型视觉语言模型在超图理解和推理方面能力的基准测试HyperGVL，包含84,000个视觉语言问答样本，涵盖12个任务，并引入了自适应表示学习路由器WiseHyGR来提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在超图理解方面的能力尚未被充分探索，而超图在生命科学和社会社区等领域有重要应用价值。目前缺乏一个基准测试来界定LVLMs在超图方面的能力边界。
AI.method: 提出了HyperGVL基准测试，包含84,000个视觉语言问答样本，涵盖12个任务，涉及多尺度合成结构和真实世界引用网络、蛋白质网络。研究了12种文本和视觉超图表示方法，并引入了可泛化的路由器WiseHyGR，通过学习自适应表示来改进LVLMs在超图上的表现。
AI.result: 对12个先进的LVLMs进行了全面评估，展示了它们在超图理解和推理方面的能力表现。WiseHyGR路由器能够有效提升LVLMs在超图任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作在连接超图与大型视觉语言模型方面迈出了重要一步，为评估和提升LVLMs在超图理解和推理方面的能力提供了系统性的框架和工具。

title: Towards Realistic Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation: Benchmark and Baseline
summary: Open-vocabulary remote sensing image segmentation (OVRSIS) remains underexplored due to fragmented datasets, limited training diversity, and the lack of evaluation benchmarks that reflect realistic geospatial application demands. Our previous \textit{OVRSISBenchV1} established an initial cross-dataset evaluation protocol, but its limited scope is insufficient for assessing realistic open-world generalization. To address this issue, we propose \textit{OVRSISBenchV2}, a large-scale and application-oriented benchmark for OVRSIS. We first construct \textbf{OVRSIS95K}, a balanced dataset of about 95K image--mask pairs covering 35 common semantic categories across diverse remote sensing scenes. Built upon OVRSIS95K and 10 downstream datasets, OVRSISBenchV2 contains 170K images and 128 categories, substantially expanding scene diversity, semantic coverage, and evaluation difficulty. Beyond standard open-vocabulary segmentation, it further includes downstream protocols for building extraction, road extraction, and flood detection, thereby better reflecting realistic geospatial application demands and complex deployment scenarios. We also propose \textbf{Pi-Seg}, a baseline for OVRSIS. Pi-Seg improves transferability through a \textbf{positive-incentive noise} mechanism, where learnable and semantically guided perturbations broaden the visual-text feature space during training. Extensive experiments on OVRSISBenchV1, OVRSISBenchV2, and downstream tasks show that Pi-Seg delivers strong and consistent results, particularly on the more challenging OVRSISBenchV2 benchmark. Our results highlight both the importance of realistic benchmark design and the effectiveness of perturbation-based transfer for OVRSIS. The code and datasets are available at \href{https://github.com/LiBingyu01/RSKT-Seg/tree/Pi-Seg}{LiBingyu01/RSKT-Seg/tree/Pi-Seg}.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了OVRSISBenchV2——一个面向应用的大规模开放词汇遥感图像分割基准，包含约95K图像-掩码对和170K图像，覆盖35个语义类别和128个类别，并提出了基于正激励噪声机制的Pi-Seg基线方法。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇遥感图像分割领域存在数据集碎片化、训练多样性不足、缺乏反映真实地理空间应用需求的评估基准等问题。之前的OVRSISBenchV1基准范围有限，不足以评估真实开放世界的泛化能力。
AI.method: 1. 构建OVRSIS95K数据集：约95K图像-掩码对，覆盖35个常见语义类别；2. 建立OVRSISBenchV2基准：基于OVRSIS95K和10个下游数据集，包含170K图像和128个类别；3. 提出Pi-Seg基线方法：采用正激励噪声机制，通过可学习的语义引导扰动在训练期间扩展视觉-文本特征空间。
AI.result: 在OVRSISBenchV1、OVRSISBenchV2和下游任务上的广泛实验表明，Pi-Seg提供了强大且一致的结果，特别是在更具挑战性的OVRSISBenchV2基准上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了真实基准设计的重要性以及基于扰动的迁移方法在开放词汇遥感图像分割中的有效性。OVRSISBenchV2基准和Pi-Seg方法为领域提供了重要的评估框架和技术基础。

title: Stein Variational Black-Box Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Combinatorial black-box optimization in high-dimensional settings demands a careful trade-off between exploiting promising regions of the search space and preserving sufficient exploration to identify multiple optima. Although Estimation-of-Distribution Algorithms (EDAs) provide a powerful model-based framework, they often concentrate on a single region of interest, which may result in premature convergence when facing complex or multimodal objective landscapes. In this work, we incorporate the Stein operator to introduce a repulsive mechanism among particles in the parameter space, thereby encouraging the population to disperse and jointly explore several modes of the fitness landscape. Empirical evaluations across diverse benchmark problems show that the proposed method achieves performance competitive with, and in several cases superior to, leading state-of-the-art approaches, particularly on large-scale instances. These findings highlight the potential of Stein variational gradient descent as a promising direction for addressing large, computationally expensive, discrete black-box optimization problems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合Stein算子的黑盒优化方法，通过粒子间的排斥机制促进种群分散，从而在多模态问题中实现更好的探索与利用平衡。
AI.motivation: 传统估计分布算法(EDAs)在处理高维组合黑盒优化时，往往过度集中于搜索空间的单一区域，导致在面对复杂或多模态目标函数时出现早熟收敛问题。
AI.method: 将Stein算子引入到优化框架中，在参数空间中建立粒子间的排斥机制，促使种群分散并联合探索适应度景观的多个模态。
AI.result: 在多种基准问题上的实证评估表明，该方法性能与现有最先进方法相当，在大规模实例上甚至表现更优。
AI.conclusion: Stein变分梯度下降为解决大规模、计算昂贵的离散黑盒优化问题提供了一个有前景的研究方向。

title: C-Mining: Unsupervised Discovery of Seeds for Cultural Data Synthesis via Geometric Misalignment
summary: Achieving cultural alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly depends on synthetic data generation. For such synthesis, the most vital initial step is seed curation; however, current methods lack quantifiable standards for selecting these seeds. Existing approaches rely on unscalable manual curation or bias-prone LLM extraction, treating cultural specificity as an abstract concept rather than a measurable signal. In this paper, we address this "quantification gap" by proposing C-Mining, an unsupervised framework that transforms the discovery of cultural seeds from a subjective selection process into a computable data mining formulation. Our approach exploits a novel geometric insight, leveraging the cross-lingual misalignment of cultural concepts within pre-trained embedding spaces as a quantifiable discovery signal. By systematically identifying these regions characterized by pronounced linguistic exclusivity and geometric isolation, while actively filtering out noise, C-Mining automatically extracts high-fidelity Culture Points (CPs) from raw multilingual corpora without reliance on human or LLM supervision, reducing preparation costs by more than 150-fold. We further leverage the mined knowledge to steer the synthesis of diverse instruction-tuning datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this seed-centric approach significantly enhances cultural understanding and reasoning capabilities, achieving a +6.03 point improvement on CulturalBench-Hard and surpassing state-of-the-art baselines, providing a scalable, quantifiable solution for high-quality cultural data synthesis.

AI.tldr: C-Mining是一个无监督框架，通过量化跨语言文化概念不对齐作为发现信号，自动从多语言语料库中提取文化种子点，大幅降低文化数据合成成本，显著提升LLM的文化理解和推理能力。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型的文化对齐越来越依赖合成数据生成，而种子选择缺乏量化标准。现有方法要么依赖不可扩展的人工筛选，要么使用容易产生偏见的LLM提取，将文化特异性视为抽象概念而非可测量信号。
AI.method: 提出C-Mining框架，利用预训练嵌入空间中文化概念的跨语言不对齐作为量化发现信号。通过系统识别具有显著语言排他性和几何隔离的区域，同时主动过滤噪声，自动从原始多语言语料库中提取高保真文化点，无需人工或LLM监督。
AI.result: C-Mining将准备成本降低150倍以上，在CulturalBench-Hard上实现了+6.03分的改进，超越了最先进的基线方法，显著增强了文化理解和推理能力。
AI.conclusion: C-Mining将文化种子发现从主观选择过程转变为可计算的数据挖掘问题，为高质量文化数据合成提供了可扩展、可量化的解决方案。

title: From Zero to Detail: A Progressive Spectral Decoupling Paradigm for UHD Image Restoration with New Benchmark
summary: Ultra-high-definition (UHD) image restoration poses unique challenges due to the high spatial resolution, diverse content, and fine-grained structures present in UHD images. To address these issues, we introduce a progressive spectral decomposition for the restoration process, decomposing it into three stages: zero-frequency \textbf{enhancement}, low-frequency \textbf{restoration}, and high-frequency \textbf{refinement}. Based on this formulation, we propose a novel framework, \textbf{ERR}, which integrates three cooperative sub-networks: the zero-frequency enhancer (ZFE), the low-frequency restorer (LFR), and the high-frequency refiner (HFR). The ZFE incorporates global priors to learn holistic mappings, the LFR reconstructs the main content by focusing on coarse-scale information, and the HFR adopts our proposed frequency-windowed Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (FW-KAN) to recover fine textures and intricate details for high-fidelity restoration. To further advance research in UHD image restoration, we also construct a large-scale, high-quality benchmark dataset, \textbf{LSUHDIR}, comprising 82{,}126 UHD images with diverse scenes and rich content. Our proposed methods demonstrate superior performance across a range of UHD image restoration tasks, and extensive ablation studies confirm the contribution and necessity of each module. Project page: https://github.com/NJU-PCALab/ERR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于超高清图像修复的渐进式频谱分解框架ERR，包含三个协同子网络：零频增强器、低频修复器和高频细化器，并构建了大规模高质量基准数据集LSUHDIR。
AI.motivation: 超高清图像修复面临高空间分辨率、内容多样和细粒度结构的独特挑战，现有方法难以有效处理这些复杂特征，需要专门针对UHD图像特点的修复框架。
AI.method: 提出渐进式频谱分解方法，将修复过程分为三个阶段：零频增强、低频修复和高频细化。基于此构建ERR框架，包含三个协同子网络：ZFE（整合全局先验学习整体映射）、LFR（关注粗尺度信息重建主要内容）、HFR（采用提出的频率窗口Kolmogorov-Arnold网络恢复精细纹理）。
AI.result: 在多种UHD图像修复任务中表现出优越性能，广泛的消融研究证实了每个模块的贡献和必要性。同时构建了包含82,126张UHD图像的大规模高质量基准数据集LSUHDIR。
AI.conclusion: 提出的渐进式频谱分解框架ERR能有效处理UHD图像修复的独特挑战，通过三个协同子网络的分阶段处理实现了高质量的修复效果，为UHD图像修复研究提供了新的解决方案和基准数据集。

title: Discover and Prove: An Open-source Agentic Framework for Hard Mode Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
summary: Most ATP benchmarks embed the final answer within the formal statement -- a convention we call "Easy Mode" -- a design that simplifies the task relative to what human competitors face and may lead to optimistic estimates of model capability. We call the stricter, more realistic setting "Hard Mode": the system must independently discover the answer before constructing a formal proof. To enable Hard Mode research, we make two contributions. First, we release MiniF2F-Hard and FIMO-Hard, expert-reannotated Hard Mode variants of two widely-used ATP benchmarks. Second, we introduce Discover And Prove (DAP), an agentic framework that uses LLM natural-language reasoning with explicit self-reflection to discover answers, then rewrites Hard Mode statements into Easy Mode ones for existing ATP provers. DAP sets the state of the art: on CombiBench it raises solved problems from 7 (previous SOTA, Pass@16) to 10; on PutnamBench it is the first system to formally prove 36 theorems in Hard Mode -- while simultaneously revealing that state-of-the-art LLMs exceed 80% answer accuracy on the same problems where formal provers manage under 10%, exposing a substantial gap that Hard Mode benchmarks are uniquely suited to measure.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Hard Mode"概念，指出传统ATP基准测试将答案嵌入形式化陈述的"Easy Mode"问题，并开发了DAP框架，在多个基准测试上取得SOTA结果，揭示了LLM与形式化证明器之间的能力差距。
AI.motivation: 传统ATP基准测试采用"Easy Mode"设计，将最终答案嵌入形式化陈述中，这简化了任务难度，可能导致对模型能力的高估。需要更严格、更接近人类竞赛环境的"Hard Mode"设置来真实评估系统能力。
AI.method: 1) 发布MiniF2F-Hard和FIMO-Hard两个专家重新标注的Hard Mode基准测试变体；2) 提出Discover And Prove (DAP)框架，使用LLM自然语言推理和显式自我反思来发现答案，然后将Hard Mode陈述重写为Easy Mode供现有ATP证明器使用。
AI.result: DAP框架在CombiBench上将已解决问题从7个（先前SOTA，Pass@16）提升到10个；在PutnamBench上是首个在Hard Mode下正式证明36个定理的系统；同时发现SOTA LLM在相同问题上的答案准确率超过80%，而形式化证明器仅能处理不到10%，揭示了显著的能力差距。
AI.conclusion: Hard Mode基准测试能更真实地评估系统能力，DAP框架在Hard Mode设置下取得SOTA性能，同时揭示了LLM与形式化证明器之间的巨大能力差距，为未来研究提供了重要方向。

title: Preference Estimation via Opponent Modeling in Multi-Agent Negotiation
comment: This paper is accepted as a Findings of ACL 2026
summary: Automated negotiation in complex, multi-party and multi-issue settings critically depends on accurate opponent modeling. However, conventional numerical-only approaches fail to capture the qualitative information embedded in natural language interactions, resulting in unstable and incomplete preference estimation. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) enable rich semantic understanding of utterances, it remains challenging to quantitatively incorporate such information into a consistent opponent modeling. To tackle this issue, we propose a novel preference estimation method integrating natural language information into a structured Bayesian opponent modeling framework. Our approach leverages LLMs to extract qualitative cues from utterances and converts them into probabilistic formats for dynamic belief tracking. Experimental results on a multi-party benchmark demonstrate that our framework improves the full agreement rate and preference estimation accuracy by integrating probabilistic reasoning with natural language understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合大语言模型和贝叶斯推理的对手建模方法，通过自然语言交互提升多智能体谈判中的偏好估计准确性
AI.motivation: 传统基于数值的方法无法捕捉自然语言交互中的定性信息，导致对手偏好估计不稳定且不完整。虽然大语言模型能够理解语义，但难以将这种信息定量整合到一致的对手建模框架中。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的偏好估计方法，将自然语言信息整合到结构化贝叶斯对手建模框架中。利用大语言模型从话语中提取定性线索，并将其转换为概率格式进行动态信念跟踪。
AI.result: 在多智能体基准测试中，该框架通过结合概率推理和自然语言理解，提高了完全达成协议率和偏好估计准确性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将大语言模型的语义理解能力与贝叶斯概率推理相结合，能够更准确地建模谈判对手的偏好，提升自动化谈判系统的性能。

title: Experience Compression Spectrum: Unifying Memory, Skills, and Rules in LLM Agents
summary: As LLM agents scale to long-horizon, multi-session deployments, efficiently managing accumulated experience becomes a critical bottleneck. Agent memory systems and agent skill discovery both address this challenge -- extracting reusable knowledge from interaction traces -- yet a citation analysis of 1,136 references across 22 primary papers reveals a cross-community citation rate below 1%. We propose the \emph{Experience Compression Spectrum}, a unifying framework that positions memory, skills, and rules as points along a single axis of increasing compression (5--20$\times$ for episodic memory, 50--500$\times$ for procedural skills, 1,000$\times$+ for declarative rules), directly reducing context consumption, retrieval latency, and compute overhead. Mapping 20+ systems onto this spectrum reveals that every system operates at a fixed, predetermined compression level -- none supports adaptive cross-level compression, a gap we term the \emph{missing diagonal}. We further show that specialization alone is insufficient -- both communities independently solve shared sub-problems without exchanging solutions -- that evaluation methods are tightly coupled to compression levels, that transferability increases with compression at the cost of specificity, and that knowledge lifecycle management remains largely neglected. We articulate open problems and design principles for scalable, full-spectrum agent learning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"经验压缩谱"框架，将记忆、技能和规则统一到单一压缩轴上，揭示了当前AI代理系统在自适应跨级压缩方面的缺失，并分析了压缩级别与评估方法、可迁移性之间的权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM代理扩展到长期、多会话部署，有效管理积累的经验成为关键瓶颈。当前记忆系统和技能发现虽然都处理从交互轨迹中提取可重用知识的问题，但两个社区之间的交叉引用率低于1%，表明存在研究孤岛。
AI.method: 提出了"经验压缩谱"统一框架，将记忆、技能和规则定位在单一压缩轴上（5-20倍压缩用于情景记忆，50-500倍用于程序技能，1000倍以上用于声明性规则）。通过分析22篇主要论文的1136个引用，并将20多个系统映射到该谱系上。
AI.result: 发现所有系统都在固定的预定压缩级别上运行，没有系统支持自适应跨级压缩（称为"缺失对角线"）。还发现专业化不足，两个社区独立解决共享子问题，评估方法与压缩级别紧密耦合，可迁移性随压缩增加但以特异性为代价。
AI.conclusion: 提出了可扩展、全谱系代理学习系统的开放问题和设计原则，强调需要解决知识生命周期管理问题，并开发支持自适应跨级压缩的系统。

title: Improving Reasoning Capabilities in Small Models through Mixture-of-Layers Distillation with Stepwise Attention on Key Information
summary: The significant computational demands of large language models have increased interest in distilling reasoning abilities into smaller models via Chain-of-Thought (CoT) distillation. Current CoT distillation methods mainly focus on transferring teacher-generated rationales for complex reasoning to student models. However, they do not adequately explore teachers' dynamic attention toward critical information during reasoning. We find that language models exhibit progressive attention shifts towards key information during reasoning, which implies essential clues for drawing conclusions. Building on this observation and analysis, we introduce a novel CoT distillation framework that transfers the teacher's stepwise attention on key information to the student model. This establishes structured guidance for the student's progressive concentration on key information during reasoning. More importantly, we develop a Mixture of Layers module enabling dynamic alignment that adapts to different layers between the teacher and student. Our method achieves consistent performance improvements across multiple mathematical and commonsense reasoning datasets. To our knowledge, it is the first method to leverage stepwise attention within CoT distillation to improve small model reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的CoT蒸馏框架，通过转移教师模型在推理过程中的渐进注意力到学生模型，提升小模型推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT蒸馏方法主要关注转移教师生成的推理过程，但未能充分探索教师在推理过程中对关键信息的动态注意力。研究发现语言模型在推理过程中会表现出对关键信息的渐进注意力转移，这为得出结论提供了重要线索。
AI.method: 提出新颖的CoT蒸馏框架，将教师的逐步注意力转移到学生模型，建立结构化指导使学生模型在推理过程中渐进关注关键信息。开发了Mixture of Layers模块，实现动态对齐以适应师生模型不同层之间的差异。
AI.result: 在多个数学和常识推理数据集上取得了一致的性能提升。这是首个利用逐步注意力进行CoT蒸馏以提升小模型推理能力的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过转移教师模型的渐进注意力机制，可以有效提升学生模型在复杂推理任务中的表现，为小模型推理能力蒸馏提供了新思路。

title: PixDLM: A Dual-Path Multimodal Language Model for UAV Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Reasoning segmentation has recently expanded from ground-level scenes to remote-sensing imagery, yet UAV data poses distinct challenges, including oblique viewpoints, ultra-high resolutions, and extreme scale variations. To address these issues, we formally define the UAV Reasoning Segmentation task and organize its semantic requirements into three dimensions: Spatial, Attribute, and Scene-level reasoning. Based on this formulation, we construct DRSeg, a large-scale benchmark for UAV reasoning segmentation, containing 10k high-resolution aerial images paired with Chain-of-Thought QA supervision across all three reasoning types. As a benchmark companion, we introduce PixDLM, a simple yet effective pixel-level multimodal language model that serves as a unified baseline for this task. Experiments on DRSeg establish strong baseline results and highlight the unique challenges of UAV reasoning segmentation, providing a solid foundation for future research.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对无人机图像推理分割任务，定义了空间、属性和场景三个维度的语义需求，构建了大规模基准数据集DRSeg，并提出PixDLM模型作为统一基线。
AI.motivation: 无人机图像具有倾斜视角、超高分辨率和极端尺度变化等独特挑战，现有的推理分割方法主要针对地面场景，需要专门针对无人机数据的解决方案。
AI.method: 1. 正式定义无人机推理分割任务，将语义需求组织为空间、属性和场景三个推理维度；2. 构建DRSeg基准数据集，包含10K高分辨率航空图像和跨三个推理类型的思维链QA监督；3. 提出PixDLM像素级多模态语言模型作为统一基线。
AI.result: 在DRSeg基准上建立了强大的基线结果，突出了无人机推理分割的独特挑战，为未来研究提供了坚实基础。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为无人机推理分割领域提供了系统性的任务定义、大规模基准数据集和有效的基线模型，推动了该方向的研究发展。

title: Towards Rigorous Explainability by Feature Attribution
summary: For around a decade, non-symbolic methods have been the option of choice when explaining complex machine learning (ML) models. Unfortunately, such methods lack rigor and can mislead human decision-makers. In high-stakes uses of ML, the lack of rigor is especially problematic. One prime example of provable lack of rigor is the adoption of Shapley values in explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), with the tool SHAP being a ubiquitous example. This paper overviews the ongoing efforts towards using rigorous symbolic methods of XAI as an alternative to non-rigorous non-symbolic approaches, concretely for assigning relative feature importance.

AI.tldr: 论文概述了在可解释人工智能领域，使用严谨的符号方法替代非严谨的非符号方法（特别是SHAP等基于Shapley值的工具）来分配特征重要性的研究进展。
AI.motivation: 非符号方法在解释复杂机器学习模型时缺乏严谨性，可能误导人类决策者，这在高风险应用中尤其成问题。SHAP等基于Shapley值的工具存在可证明的严谨性缺陷。
AI.method: 采用严谨的符号方法作为非严谨非符号方法的替代方案，专注于特征重要性分配问题。
AI.result: 论文综述了当前在可解释人工智能领域使用符号方法的研究努力，为特征重要性分配提供了更严谨的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 在高风险机器学习应用中，需要从非严谨的非符号解释方法转向更严谨的符号方法，以确保解释的可靠性和决策的安全性。

title: The Metacognitive Monitoring Battery: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for LLM Self-Monitoring
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Code, data, and Croissant metadata: https://github.com/synthiumjp/metacognitive-monitoring-battery
summary: We introduce a cross-domain behavioural assay of monitoring-control coupling in LLMs, grounded in the Nelson and Narens (1990) metacognitive framework and applying human psychometric methodology to LLM evaluation. The battery comprises 524 items across six cognitive domains (learning, metacognitive calibration, social cognition, attention, executive function, prospective regulation), each grounded in an established experimental paradigm. Tasks T1-T5 were pre-registered on OSF prior to data collection; T6 was added as an exploratory extension. After every forced-choice response, dual probes adapted from Koriat and Goldsmith (1996) ask the model to KEEP or WITHDRAW its answer and to BET or decline. The critical metric is the withdraw delta: the difference in withdrawal rate between incorrect and correct items. Applied to 20 frontier LLMs (10,480 evaluations), the battery discriminates three profiles consistent with the Nelson-Narens architecture: blanket confidence, blanket withdrawal, and selective sensitivity. Accuracy rank and metacognitive sensitivity rank are largely inverted. Retrospective monitoring and prospective regulation appear dissociable (r = .17, 95% CI wide given n=20; exemplar-based evidence is the primary support). Scaling on metacognitive calibration is architecture-dependent: monotonically decreasing (Qwen), monotonically increasing (GPT-5.4), or flat (Gemma). Behavioural findings converge structurally with an independent Type-2 SDT approach, providing preliminary cross-method construct validity. All items, data, and code: https://github.com/synthiumjp/metacognitive-monitoring-battery.

AI.tldr: 研究者开发了一个基于Nelson-Narens元认知框架的跨领域行为测试电池，用于评估LLMs的监控-控制耦合能力，包含524个项目覆盖六个认知领域，通过撤回率差异等指标分析20个前沿LLM的元认知特征。
AI.motivation: 将人类心理测量学方法应用于LLM评估，基于Nelson和Narens（1990）的元认知框架，开发系统化的跨领域行为测试来评估LLMs的监控-控制耦合能力，填补当前LLM元认知评估方法的空白。
AI.method: 开发包含524个项目的测试电池，覆盖学习、元认知校准、社会认知、注意力、执行功能和前瞻性调节六个认知领域。采用Koriat和Goldsmith（1996）的双重探测方法，在每次强制选择回答后询问模型是否保留或撤回答案以及是否下注。关键指标是撤回率差异（错误与正确项目的撤回率差）。应用于20个前沿LLM（共10,480次评估）。
AI.result: 测试电池识别出三种与Nelson-Narens架构一致的元认知模式：盲目自信、盲目撤回和选择性敏感。准确率排名与元认知敏感度排名基本呈倒置关系。回顾性监控与前瞻性调节似乎可分离（r=0.17）。元认知校准的扩展模式具有架构依赖性：单调递减（Qwen）、单调递增（GPT-5.4）或平坦（Gemma）。行为发现与独立的Type-2 SDT方法在结构上收敛。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发了一个系统化的跨领域元认知测试电池，能够有效区分不同LLM的监控-控制耦合特征，为LLM元认知评估提供了标准化工具和初步的跨方法结构效度证据，揭示了LLM元认知能力的多样性和架构依赖性。

title: HyCal: A Training-Free Prototype Calibration Method for Cross-Discipline Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026. Eunju Lee and MiHyeon Kim contributed equally as co-first authors
summary: Pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) like CLIP show promise in continual learning, but existing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) methods assume homogeneous domains and balanced data distributions, limiting real-world applicability where data arises from heterogeneous disciplines with imbalanced sample availability and varying visual complexity. We identify Domain Gravity, a representational asymmetry where data imbalance across heterogeneous domains causes overrepresented or low-entropy domains to disproportionately influence the embedding space, leading to prototype drift and degraded performance on underrepresented or high-entropy domains. To address this, we introduce Cross-Discipline Variable Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (XD-VSCIL), a benchmark capturing real-world heterogeneity and imbalance where Domain Gravity naturally intensifies. We propose Hybrid Prototype Calibration (HyCal), a training-free method combining cosine similarity and Mahalanobis distance to capture complementary geometric properties-directional alignment and covariance-aware magnitude-yielding stable prototypes under imbalanced heterogeneous conditions. Operating on frozen CLIP embeddings, HyCal achieves consistent retention-adaptation improvements while maintaining efficiency. Experiments show HyCal effectively mitigates Domain Gravity and outperforms existing methods in imbalanced cross-domain incremental learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XD-VSCIL基准和HyCal方法，解决异构域不平衡数据下的少样本类增量学习问题，通过混合原型校准有效缓解域引力效应。
AI.motivation: 现有FSCIL方法假设同质域和平衡数据分布，但现实世界中数据来自异构学科，存在样本不平衡和视觉复杂度差异。作者发现域引力现象：数据不平衡导致过表示域对嵌入空间产生不成比例的影响，造成原型漂移和性能下降。
AI.method: 提出Hybrid Prototype Calibration (HyCal)方法，结合余弦相似度和马氏距离来捕获互补的几何特性（方向对齐和协方差感知的幅度），在异构不平衡条件下产生稳定原型。该方法基于冻结的CLIP嵌入，无需训练。
AI.result: 实验表明HyCal有效缓解域引力效应，在不平衡跨域增量学习中优于现有方法，同时保持高效性。
AI.conclusion: HyCal方法通过几何原型校准解决了异构不平衡数据下的少样本类增量学习问题，为现实世界应用提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Integrating Graphs, Large Language Models, and Agents: Reasoning and Retrieval
summary: Generative AI, particularly Large Language Models, increasingly integrates graph-based representations to enhance reasoning, retrieval, and structured decision-making. Despite rapid advances, there remains limited clarity regarding when, why, where, and what types of graph-LLM integrations are most appropriate across applications. This survey provides a concise, structured overview of the design choices underlying the integration of graphs with LLMs. We categorize existing methods based on their purpose (reasoning, retrieval, generation, recommendation), graph modality (knowledge graphs, scene graphs, interaction graphs, causal graphs, dependency graphs), and integration strategies (prompting, augmentation, training, or agent-based use). By mapping representative works across domains such as cybersecurity, healthcare, materials science, finance, robotics, and multimodal environments, we highlight the strengths, limitations, and best-fit scenarios for each technique. This survey aims to offer researchers a practical guide for selecting the most suitable graph-LLM approach depending on task requirements, data characteristics, and reasoning complexity.

AI.tldr: 该调查论文系统梳理了图与大型语言模型（LLM）的集成方法，根据应用目的、图类型和集成策略进行分类，为研究者提供选择合适图-LLM方法的实用指南。
AI.motivation: 尽管生成式AI和图表示的结合发展迅速，但缺乏关于何时、为何、何处以及何种图-LLM集成最适合特定应用的清晰指导。本文旨在填补这一空白，为研究者提供系统化的分类框架。
AI.method: 采用调查分析方法，从三个维度对现有方法进行分类：1）应用目的（推理、检索、生成、推荐）；2）图模态（知识图谱、场景图、交互图、因果图、依赖图）；3）集成策略（提示、增强、训练、基于代理）。通过跨领域代表性工作的映射分析，评估每种技术的适用场景。
AI.result: 建立了全面的图-LLM集成分类框架，识别了不同集成方法在网络安全、医疗健康、材料科学、金融、机器人技术和多模态环境等领域的适用场景，明确了各种技术的优势和局限性。
AI.conclusion: 该调查为研究者提供了实用的选择指南，帮助根据任务需求、数据特征和推理复杂度选择最合适的图-LLM集成方法，促进了该领域的系统化发展。

title: Target-Oriented Pretraining Data Selection via Neuron-Activated Graph
summary: Everyday tasks come with a target, and pretraining models around this target is what turns them into experts. In this paper, we study target-oriented language model (LM) pretraining by introducing Neuron-Activated Graph Ranking (NAG-based Ranking), a training-free and interpretable framework for target pretraining data selection. Rather than using black-box representations, our approach directly characterizes each target input by a sparse set of high-impact neurons in any off-the-shelf LLMs. Concretely, we quantify neuron impact and select the most influential neurons across layers into a compact Neuron-Activated Graph (NAG), and rank candidate data by NAG similarity to target examples. We conduct experiments across six benchmarks, where our NAG-based Ranking improves target-oriented pretraining by 4.9% on average over random sampling, and also outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by 5.3% accuracy on HellaSwag. It also remains effective under a more applicable multi-target setting, where our best setup surpasses two baselines by 1.1% and 4.1%, respectively. Furthermore, we provide a comprehensive analysis on why and how our NAG works, e.g., deactivating NAG-selected neurons (only 0.12% of all) causes a 23.5% performance collapse, and restricting NAG to the final layer incurs a 4.1% average drop, indicating that NAG captures a sparse "functional backbone" for learning target features. We release the code at https://github.com/asillycat/NAG.
