AI.tldr: 提出NAG-based Ranking框架，通过分析LLM中高影响力神经元构建神经元激活图，实现无需训练的目标导向预训练数据选择，提升模型在特定任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 日常任务都有特定目标，围绕目标进行预训练能使模型成为专家。现有方法缺乏可解释性，需要一种无需训练、可解释的目标导向预训练数据选择框架。
AI.method: 提出Neuron-Activated Graph Ranking (NAG-based Ranking)：1)量化神经元影响力，选择各层最具影响力的神经元构建紧凑的神经元激活图(NAG)；2)通过计算候选数据与目标示例的NAG相似度来排名数据。
AI.result: 在六个基准测试中，NAG-based Ranking比随机采样平均提升4.9%，在HellaSwag上比SOTA基线提升5.3%准确率。多目标设置下分别超越两个基线1.1%和4.1%。分析显示：停用NAG选择的神经元(仅占0.12%)会导致23.5%性能崩溃，限制到最后一层会带来4.1%平均下降。
AI.conclusion: NAG-based Ranking是一种有效、可解释的目标导向预训练数据选择方法，通过稀疏的"功能骨干"捕捉目标特征，无需训练即可提升模型在特定任务上的性能。

title: Self-Supervised Angular Deblurring in Photoacoustic Reconstruction via Noisier2Inverse
summary: Photoacoustic tomography (PAT) is an emerging imaging modality that combines the complementary strengths of optical contrast and ultrasonic resolution. A central task is image reconstruction, where measured acoustic signals are used to recover the initial pressure distribution. For ideal point-like or line-like detectors, several efficient and fast reconstruction algorithms exist, including Fourier methods, filtered backprojection, and time reversal. However, when applied to data acquired with finite-size detectors, these methods yield systematically blurred images. Although sharper images can be obtained by compensating for finite-detector effects, supervised learning approaches typically require ground-truth images that may not be available in practice. We propose a self-supervised reconstruction method based on Noisier2Inverse that addresses finite-size detector effects without requiring ground-truth data. Our approach operates directly on noisy measurements and learns to recover high-quality PAT images in a ground-truth-free manner. Its key components are: (i) PAT-specific modeling that recasts the problem as angular deblurring; (ii) a Noisier2Inverse formulation in the polar domain that leverages the known angular point-spread function; and (iii) a novel, statistically grounded early-stopping rule. In experiments, the proposed method consistently outperforms alternative approaches that do not use supervised data and achieves performance close to supervised benchmarks, while remaining practical for real acquisitions with finite-size detectors.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Noisier2Inverse的自监督光声断层扫描重建方法，无需真实图像数据即可处理有限尺寸探测器带来的模糊效应。
AI.motivation: 传统光声断层扫描重建算法针对理想点状或线状探测器设计，当应用于有限尺寸探测器时会产生系统性模糊。虽然可以通过补偿有限探测器效应获得更清晰图像，但监督学习方法需要真实图像数据，而这些数据在实际中可能无法获得。
AI.method: 提出自监督重建方法：1) 将问题重新表述为角度去模糊的光声断层扫描特定建模；2) 在极坐标域中采用Noisier2Inverse公式，利用已知的角度点扩散函数；3) 提出新颖的基于统计的早停规则。
AI.result: 该方法在不使用监督数据的情况下始终优于替代方法，性能接近监督基准，同时在实际有限尺寸探测器采集数据中保持实用性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的自监督方法能够有效处理有限尺寸探测器效应，无需真实图像数据，为实际光声断层扫描重建提供实用解决方案。

title: Weak-Link Optimization for Multi-Agent Reasoning and Collaboration
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to CAAI Transactions on Intelligence Technology
summary: LLM-driven multi-agent frameworks address complex reasoning tasks through multi-role collaboration. However, existing approaches often suffer from reasoning instability, where individual agent errors are amplified through collaboration, undermining overall performance. Current research mainly focuses on enhancing high-capability agents or suppressing unreliable outputs to improve framework effectiveness, while systematic identification and reinforcement of performance-limiting agents receive less attention. To address this gap, we propose WORC, a \underline{w}eak-link \underline{o}ptimization framework for multi-agent \underline{r}easoning and \underline{c}ollaboration, grounded in the weak-link principle. WORC follows a two-stage workflow. In the weak agent localization stage, task features are constructed, and a meta-learning-based weight predictor trained on optimal configurations identified by swarm intelligence algorithms (SIAs) enables zero-shot mapping from these features to agent performance weights, where the agent with the lowest predicted weight is identified as the weak agent. In the weak-link optimization stage, an uncertainty-driven allocation strategy assigns additional reasoning budgets to weak agents, with lower predicted weights leading to larger repeated-sampling quotas to compensate for reliability deficiencies. Experimental results show that WORC achieves an average accuracy of 82.2\% on reasoning benchmarks while improving framework stability and cross-architecture generalization, suggesting that compensating for weak links, rather than reinforcing strengths alone, enhances the robustness of multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: WORC是一个基于弱链接原则的多智能体推理协作优化框架，通过定位性能最差的弱智能体并为其分配更多推理资源来提升整体系统稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的多智能体框架存在推理不稳定性问题，个体智能体错误会通过协作被放大。当前研究主要关注增强高能力智能体或抑制不可靠输出，而对系统性识别和强化性能限制智能体（弱链接）的关注不足。
AI.method: WORC采用两阶段工作流程：1）弱智能体定位阶段：构建任务特征，通过元学习权重预测器（基于群体智能算法识别的最优配置训练）实现从特征到智能体性能权重的零样本映射，预测权重最低的智能体被识别为弱智能体；2）弱链接优化阶段：采用不确定性驱动的分配策略，为弱智能体分配额外推理预算，预测权重越低则重复采样配额越大，以补偿可靠性缺陷。
AI.result: 实验结果显示WORC在推理基准测试中达到82.2%的平均准确率，同时提高了框架稳定性和跨架构泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 补偿弱链接而非仅仅强化优势智能体，能够增强多智能体系统的鲁棒性，表明识别和优化性能限制智能体对提升多智能体协作框架的整体性能至关重要。

title: GTA-2: Benchmarking General Tool Agents from Atomic Tool-Use to Open-Ended Workflows
summary: The development of general-purpose agents requires a shift from executing simple instructions to completing complex, real-world productivity workflows. However, current tool-use benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world requirements, relying on AI-generated queries, dummy tools, and limited system-level coordination. To address this, we propose GTA-2, a hierarchical benchmark for General Tool Agents (GTA) spanning atomic tool use and open-ended workflows. Built on real-world authenticity, it leverages real user queries, deployed tools, and multimodal contexts. (i) GTA-Atomic, inherited from our prior GTA benchmark, evaluates short-horizon, closed-ended tool-use precision. (ii) GTA-Workflow introduces long-horizon, open-ended tasks for realistic end-to-end completion. To evaluate open-ended deliverables, we propose a recursive checkpoint-based evaluation mechanism that decomposes objectives into verifiable sub-goals, enabling unified evaluation of both model capabilities and agent execution frameworks (i.e., execution harnesses). Experiments reveal a pronounced capability cliff: while frontier models already struggle on atomic tasks (below 50%), they largely fail on workflows, with top models achieving only 14.39% success. Further analysis shows that checkpoint-guided feedback improves performance, while advanced frameworks such as Manus and OpenClaw substantially enhance workflow completion, highlighting the importance of execution harness design beyond the underlying model capacity. These findings provide guidance for developing reliable personal and professional assistants. Dataset and code will be available at https://github.com/open-compass/GTA.

AI.tldr: GTA-2是一个分层基准测试，用于评估通用工具代理在原子工具使用和开放工作流中的表现，基于真实用户查询、部署工具和多模态上下文，揭示了前沿模型在原子任务和工作流中都存在显著能力差距。
AI.motivation: 当前工具使用基准测试与真实世界需求存在偏差，依赖于AI生成的查询、虚拟工具和有限的系统级协调，需要开发更符合实际生产力工作流的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出GTA-2分层基准：GTA-Atomic评估短视界、封闭式工具使用精度；GTA-Workflow评估长视界、开放式端到端任务完成。采用基于递归检查点的评估机制，将目标分解为可验证的子目标。
AI.result: 实验显示显著能力悬崖：前沿模型在原子任务上已表现不佳（低于50%），在工作流上基本失败，顶级模型仅达到14.39%成功率。检查点引导反馈能提升性能，高级框架如Manus和OpenClaw能显著改善工作流完成。
AI.conclusion: 执行框架设计比底层模型能力更重要，为开发可靠的个人和专业助手提供了指导。数据集和代码将在GitHub上开源。

title: ReactBench: A Benchmark for Topological Reasoning in MLLMs on Chemical Reaction Diagrams
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at recognizing individual visual elements and reasoning over simple linear diagrams. However, when faced with complex topological structures involving branching paths, converging flows, and cyclic dependencies, their reasoning capabilities degrade sharply, even on tasks as basic as counting endpoints. Existing benchmarks fail to probe this gap, focusing on semantic comprehension rather than structural reasoning. We introduce ReactBench, a benchmark that reveals fundamental limitations in structural reasoning through chemical reaction diagrams. These real-world scientific diagrams offer an ideal testbed because they naturally span diverse structures from linear chains to cyclic graphs, while requiring both precise local recognition and coherent global reasoning. Our benchmark comprises 1,618 expert-annotated QA pairs across four hierarchical task dimensions. Extensive evaluation across 17 MLLMs reveals a significant performance gap exceeding 30% between anchor-based tasks and holistic structural reasoning tasks. Controlled ablations confirm this bottleneck lies in reasoning, not perception. These findings expose a fundamental deficit in structural understanding and establish directions for advancing visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: ReactBench是一个针对多模态大语言模型结构推理能力的基准测试，通过化学反应图揭示模型在处理复杂拓扑结构时的根本性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 当前MLLMs在识别单个视觉元素和简单线性图表方面表现出色，但在处理涉及分支路径、汇聚流和循环依赖的复杂拓扑结构时，推理能力急剧下降。现有基准测试主要关注语义理解而非结构推理，未能揭示这一能力差距。
AI.method: 引入ReactBench基准测试，利用化学反应图作为理想测试平台，这些真实世界的科学图表自然涵盖了从线性链到循环图的各种结构。基准包含1,618个专家标注的QA对，涵盖四个层次化任务维度，对17个MLLMs进行广泛评估。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，基于锚点的任务与整体结构推理任务之间存在超过30%的显著性能差距。受控消融实验证实这一瓶颈在于推理而非感知能力。MLLMs在复杂结构理解方面存在根本性缺陷。
AI.conclusion: ReactBench揭示了MLLMs在结构理解方面的基本缺陷，为推进视觉推理研究指明了方向。化学反应图为评估结构推理能力提供了有效的测试平台。

title: Learning Uncertainty from Sequential Internal Dispersion in Large Language Models
summary: Uncertainty estimation is a promising approach to detect hallucinations in large language models (LLMs). Recent approaches commonly depend on model internal states to estimate uncertainty. However, they suffer from strict assumptions on how hidden states should evolve across layers, and from information loss by solely focusing on last or mean tokens. To address these issues, we present Sequential Internal Variance Representation (SIVR), a supervised hallucination detection framework that leverages token-wise, layer-wise features derived from hidden states. SIVR adopts a more basic assumption that uncertainty manifests in the degree of dispersion or variance of internal representations across layers, rather than relying on specific assumptions, which makes the method model and task agnostic. It additionally aggregates the full sequence of per-token variance features, learning temporal patterns indicative of factual errors and thereby preventing information loss. Experimental results demonstrate SIVR consistently outperforms strong baselines. Most importantly, SIVR enjoys stronger generalisation and avoids relying on large training sets, highlighting the potential for practical deployment. Our code repository is available online at https://github.com/ponhvoan/internal-variance.

AI.tldr: SIVR是一种基于序列内部方差表示的监督幻觉检测框架，通过利用隐藏状态衍生的token-wise、layer-wise特征来检测大语言模型中的幻觉，相比现有方法具有更好的泛化能力和更少的训练数据需求。
AI.motivation: 现有基于模型内部状态的幻觉检测方法存在两个主要问题：1) 对隐藏状态在不同层间的演化有严格假设；2) 仅关注最后或平均token导致信息丢失。需要一种更通用、信息保留更完整的方法。
AI.method: 提出SIVR框架，其核心假设是不确定性表现为内部表示在不同层间的分散程度或方差，而非依赖特定假设。该方法提取token-wise、layer-wise的方差特征，并聚合完整的token序列方差特征，学习指示事实错误的时间模式。
AI.result: 实验结果表明SIVR在幻觉检测任务上持续优于强基线方法。最重要的是，SIVR具有更强的泛化能力，且不需要依赖大规模训练集，显示出实际部署的潜力。
AI.conclusion: SIVR通过基于内部表示方差的监督学习框架，有效解决了现有幻觉检测方法的局限性，实现了模型和任务无关的检测能力，为实际应用提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: LP$^{2}$DH: A Locality-Preserving Pixel-Difference Hashing Framework for Dynamic Texture Recognition
summary: Spatiotemporal Local Binary Pattern (STLBP) is a widely used dynamic texture descriptor, but it suffers from extremely high dimensionality. To tackle this, STLBP features are often extracted on three orthogonal planes, which sacrifice inter-plane correlation. In this work, we propose a Locality-Preserving Pixel-Difference Hashing (LP$^{2}$DH) framework that jointly encodes pixel differences in the full spatiotemporal neighbourhood. LP$^{2}$DH transforms Pixel-Difference Vectors (PDVs) into compact binary codes with maximal discriminative power. Furthermore, we incorporate a locality-preserving embedding to maintain the PDVs' local structure before and after hashing. Then, a curvilinear search strategy is utilized to jointly optimize the hashing matrix and binary codes via gradient descent on the Stiefel manifold. After hashing, dictionary learning is applied to encode the binary vectors into codewords, and the resulting histogram is utilized as the final feature representation. The proposed LP$^{2}$DH achieves state-of-the-art performance on three major dynamic texture recognition benchmarks: 99.80% against DT-GoogleNet's 98.93% on UCLA, 98.52% against HoGF$^{3D}$'s 97.63% on DynTex++, and 96.19% compared to STS's 95.00% on YUPENN. The source code is available at: https://github.com/drx770/LP2DH.

AI.tldr: 提出LP²DH框架，通过局部保持的像素差异哈希将高维STLBP特征转换为紧凑二进制码，在动态纹理识别基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 传统STLBP特征维度极高，且在三正交平面提取时会牺牲平面间相关性，需要更有效的特征编码方法。
AI.method: 提出局部保持像素差异哈希框架，将像素差异向量转换为紧凑二进制码，保持局部结构，在Stiefel流形上优化哈希矩阵和二进制码，最后通过字典学习编码为码字直方图特征。
AI.result: 在三个主要动态纹理识别基准上取得最佳性能：UCLA数据集99.80%（优于DT-GoogleNet的98.93%），DynTex++数据集98.52%（优于HoGF³D的97.63%），YUPENN数据集96.19%（优于STS的95.00%）。
AI.conclusion: LP²DH框架有效解决了STLBP高维问题，通过局部保持哈希和联合优化策略，在动态纹理识别任务中表现出优越性能。

title: MEDLEY-BENCH: Scale Buys Evaluation but Not Control in AI Metacognition
summary: Metacognition, the ability to monitor and regulate one's own reasoning, remains under-evaluated in AI benchmarking. We introduce MEDLEY-BENCH, a benchmark of behavioural metacognition that separates independent reasoning, private self-revision, and socially influenced revision under genuine inter-model disagreement. The benchmark evaluates 35 models from 12 families on 130 ambiguous instances across five domains and reports two complementary scores: the Medley Metacognition Score (MMS), a tier-based aggregate of reflective updating, social robustness, and epistemic articulation, and the Medley Ability Score (MAS), derived from four metacognitive sub-abilities. Results show a robust evaluation/control dissociation: evaluation ability increases with model size within families, whereas control does not. In a follow-up progressive adversarial analysis of 11 models, we observed two behavioural profiles, i.e., models that revise primarily in response to argument quality and models that track consensus statistics. Under within-model relative profiling (ipsative scoring), evaluation was the weakest relative ability in all 35 models, indicating a systematic knowing/doing gap. Smaller and cheaper models often matched or outperformed larger counterparts, suggesting that metacognitive competence is not simply a function of scale. These findings position MEDLEY-BENCH as a tool for measuring belief revision under social pressure and suggest that future training should reward calibrated, proportional updating rather than output quality alone.

AI.tldr: MEDLEY-BENCH是一个评估AI模型元认知能力的基准测试，通过独立推理、私下自我修订和社会影响修订三个维度，在130个模糊实例上评估了35个模型，发现评估能力随模型规模增长而控制能力不增长，且小模型元认知能力可与大模型匹敌。
AI.motivation: 当前AI基准测试中缺乏对元认知能力（监控和调节自身推理过程）的系统评估，需要建立一个能够分离独立推理、自我修订和社会影响修订的基准来全面衡量AI的元认知能力。
AI.method: 开发MEDLEY-BENCH基准，包含130个模糊实例覆盖五个领域，评估35个模型在三个维度上的表现：独立推理、私下自我修订、社会影响修订。使用两种评分系统：Medley元认知分数（MMS）基于反思更新、社会鲁棒性和认知表达，以及Medley能力分数（MAS）基于四个元认知子能力。
AI.result: 发现评估与控制能力分离：评估能力随模型规模增长，控制能力不增长；小模型元认知能力常与大模型相当；所有模型中评估能力都是相对最弱的；模型分为两类：基于论证质量修订和基于共识统计修订。
AI.conclusion: MEDLEY-BENCH可作为测量社会压力下信念修订的工具，未来AI训练应奖励校准的、比例适当的更新，而不仅仅是输出质量。元认知能力不是规模的简单函数，小模型也能表现出色。

title: SocialGrid: A Benchmark for Planning and Social Reasoning in Embodied Multi-Agent Systems
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) transition from text processors to autonomous agents, evaluating their social reasoning in embodied multi-agent settings becomes critical. We introduce SocialGrid, an embodied multi-agent environment inspired by Among Us that evaluates LLM agents on planning, task execution, and social reasoning. Our evaluations reveal that even the strongest open model (GPT-OSS-120B) achieves below 60% accuracy in task completion and planning, with agents getting stuck in repetitive behaviors or failing to navigate basic obstacles. Since poor navigation confounds evaluation of social intelligence, SocialGrid offers an optional Planning Oracle to isolate social reasoning from planning deficits. While planning assistance improves task completion, social reasoning remains a bottleneck: agents fail to detect deception at near-random chance regardless of scale, relying on shallow heuristics rather than accumulating behavioral evidence. SocialGrid provides automatic failure analysis and fine-grained metrics, enabling developers to diagnose and improve their agents. We also establish a competitive leaderboard using Elo ratings from adversarial league play.

AI.tldr: SocialGrid是一个受《Among Us》启发的多智能体环境，用于评估LLM在规划、任务执行和社交推理方面的能力。研究发现即使最强开源模型在任务完成和规划方面准确率低于60%，社交推理能力薄弱，无法有效检测欺骗行为。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM从文本处理器转变为自主智能体，需要在具身多智能体环境中评估其社交推理能力。现有评估方法未能充分测试LLM在复杂社交环境中的表现。
AI.method: 开发了SocialGrid环境，包含可选规划预言机来隔离规划缺陷对社交推理评估的影响。使用自动失败分析和细粒度指标，并通过对抗性联赛建立Elo评分排行榜。
AI.result: 最强开源模型GPT-OSS-120B在任务完成和规划方面准确率低于60%，智能体陷入重复行为或无法导航基本障碍。即使有规划辅助，社交推理仍是瓶颈：智能体检测欺骗的能力接近随机猜测，依赖浅层启发式而非行为证据积累。
AI.conclusion: SocialGrid为开发者提供了诊断和改进智能体的工具，揭示了当前LLM在具身多智能体环境中社交推理能力的严重不足，特别是欺骗检测方面的缺陷。

title: TTL: Test-time Textual Learning for OOD Detection with Pretrained Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP exhibit strong Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection capabilities by aligning visual and textual representations. Recent CLIP-based test-time adaptation methods further improve detection performance by incorporating external OOD labels. However, such labels are finite and fixed, while the real OOD semantic space is inherently open-ended. Consequently, fixed labels fail to represent the diverse and evolving OOD semantics encountered in test streams. To address this limitation, we introduce Test-time Textual Learning (TTL), a framework that dynamically learns OOD textual semantics from unlabeled test streams, without relying on external OOD labels. TTL updates learnable prompts using pseudo-labeled test samples to capture emerging OOD knowledge. To suppress noise introduced by pseudo-labels, we introduce an OOD knowledge purification strategy that selects reliable OOD samples for adaptation while suppressing noise. In addition, TTL maintains an OOD Textual Knowledge Bank that stores high-quality textual features, providing stable score calibration across batches. Extensive experiments on two standard benchmarks with nine OOD datasets demonstrate that TTL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the value of textual adaptation for robust test-time OOD detection. Our code is available at https://github.com/figec/TTL.

AI.tldr: TTL框架通过动态学习未标记测试流中的OOD文本语义，无需外部OOD标签，实现了更强大的测试时OOD检测
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的测试时适应方法依赖有限的外部OOD标签，无法代表测试流中多样且不断演化的OOD语义空间，需要更灵活的适应机制
AI.method: 提出测试时文本学习(TTL)框架：1) 使用伪标记测试样本更新可学习提示以捕获新兴OOD知识；2) OOD知识净化策略选择可靠OOD样本并抑制噪声；3) 维护OOD文本知识库存储高质量文本特征，实现跨批次稳定分数校准
AI.result: 在两个标准基准测试和九个OOD数据集上的广泛实验表明，TTL始终实现最先进的性能，突显了文本适应对鲁棒测试时OOD检测的价值
AI.conclusion: TTL通过动态学习OOD文本语义，无需外部OOD标签，有效解决了固定标签无法适应开放OOD语义空间的问题，为测试时OOD检测提供了更灵活的解决方案

title: Skill-RAG: Failure-State-Aware Retrieval Augmentation via Hidden-State Probing and Skill Routing
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a foundational paradigm for grounding large language models in external knowledge. While adaptive retrieval mechanisms have improved retrieval efficiency, existing approaches treat post-retrieval failure as a signal to retry rather than to diagnose -- leaving the structural causes of query-evidence misalignment unaddressed. We observe that a significant portion of persistent retrieval failures stem not from the absence of relevant evidence but from an alignment gap between the query and the evidence space. We propose Skill-RAG, a failure-aware RAG framework that couples a lightweight hidden-state prober with a prompt-based skill router. The prober gates retrieval at two pipeline stages; upon detecting a failure state, the skill router diagnoses the underlying cause and selects among four retrieval skills -- query rewriting, question decomposition, evidence focusing, and an exit skill for truly irreducible cases -- to correct misalignment before the next generation attempt. Experiments across multiple open-domain QA and complex reasoning benchmarks show that Skill-RAG substantially improves accuracy on hard cases persisting after multi-turn retrieval, with particularly strong gains on out-of-distribution datasets. Representation-space analyses further reveal that the proposed skills occupy structured, separable regions of the failure state space, supporting the view that query-evidence misalignment is a typed rather than monolithic phenomenon.

AI.tldr: Skill-RAG是一个故障感知的RAG框架，通过轻量级隐藏状态探测器和基于提示的技能路由器，诊断查询-证据对齐问题并选择相应检索技能来纠正对齐偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应检索方法将检索后失败视为重试信号而非诊断机会，未能解决查询与证据空间对齐差距的结构性原因。研究发现大量持续检索失败源于查询与证据空间的对齐差距，而非相关证据缺失。
AI.method: 提出Skill-RAG框架：1) 轻量级隐藏状态探测器在两个流水线阶段门控检索；2) 检测到失败状态时，技能路由器诊断根本原因并选择四种检索技能之一：查询重写、问题分解、证据聚焦、以及针对真正不可简化情况的退出技能，以在下次生成尝试前纠正对齐偏差。
AI.result: 在多个开放域QA和复杂推理基准测试中，Skill-RAG显著提高了多轮检索后仍存在的困难案例的准确性，在分布外数据集上表现尤为突出。表示空间分析显示所提技能占据失败状态空间的结构化、可分离区域。
AI.conclusion: 查询-证据对齐偏差是一种类型化而非单一现象，Skill-RAG通过诊断对齐失败的根本原因并应用针对性技能来有效解决这一问题，为RAG系统提供了更精细的故障处理机制。

title: NeuroLip: An Event-driven Spatiotemporal Learning Framework for Cross-Scene Lip-Motion-based Visual Speaker Recognition
summary: Visual speaker recognition based on lip motion offers a silent, hands-free, and behavior-driven biometric solution that remains effective even when acoustic cues are unavailable. Compared to traditional methods that rely heavily on appearance-dependent representations, lip motion encodes subject-specific behavioral dynamics driven by consistent articulation patterns and muscle coordination, offering inherent stability across environmental changes. However, capturing these robust, fine-grained dynamics is challenging for conventional frame-based cameras due to motion blur and low dynamic range. To exploit the intrinsic stability of lip motion and address these sensing limitations, we propose NeuroLip, an event-based framework that captures fine-grained lip dynamics under a strict yet practical cross-scene protocol: training is performed under a single controlled condition, while recognition must generalize to unseen viewing and lighting conditions. NeuroLip features a 1) Temporal-aware Voxel Encoding module with adaptive event weighting, 2) Structure-aware Spatial Enhancer that amplifies discriminative behavioral patterns by suppressing noise while preserving vertically structured motion information, and 3) Polarity Consistency Regularization mechanism to retain motion-direction cues encoded in event polarities. To facilitate systematic evaluation, we introduce DVSpeaker, a comprehensive event-based lip-motion dataset comprising 50 subjects recorded under four distinct viewpoint and illumination scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuroLip achieves near-perfect matched-scene accuracy and robust cross-scene generalization, attaining over 71% accuracy on unseen viewpoints and nearly 76% under low-light conditions, outperforming representative existing methods by at least 8.54%. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/JiuZeongit/NeuroLip.

AI.tldr: NeuroLip是一个基于事件的视觉说话人识别框架，利用事件相机捕捉精细唇部运动，在跨场景协议下实现鲁棒识别，并提出了DVSpeaker数据集。
AI.motivation: 基于唇部运动的视觉说话人识别提供了一种无声、免手、行为驱动的生物识别方案，即使在没有声学线索的情况下也有效。传统方法依赖外观相关表示，而唇部运动编码了由一致发音模式和肌肉协调驱动的特定主体行为动态，具有跨环境变化的固有稳定性。然而，传统基于帧的相机由于运动模糊和低动态范围难以捕捉这些鲁棒的细粒度动态。
AI.method: NeuroLip框架包含三个核心模块：1）具有自适应事件加权的时序感知体素编码模块；2）结构感知空间增强器，通过抑制噪声同时保留垂直结构化运动信息来增强判别性行为模式；3）极性一致性正则化机制，保留事件极性编码的运动方向线索。采用严格的跨场景协议：在单一受控条件下训练，识别必须泛化到未见过的视角和光照条件。
AI.result: NeuroLip在匹配场景下达到接近完美的准确率，并在跨场景泛化方面表现鲁棒：在未见视角上超过71%准确率，在低光条件下接近76%准确率，比现有代表性方法至少高出8.54%。
AI.conclusion: NeuroLip成功利用事件相机捕捉唇部运动的细粒度动态，解决了传统相机在运动模糊和动态范围方面的限制，在跨场景视觉说话人识别中实现了显著性能提升，提出的DVSpeaker数据集为系统评估提供了基础。

title: Characterising LLM-Generated Competency Questions: a Cross-Domain Empirical Study using Open and Closed Models
comment: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2507.02989
summary: Competency Questions (CQs) are a cornerstone of requirement elicitation in ontology engineering. CQs represent requirements as a set of natural language questions that an ontology should satisfy; they are traditionally modelled by ontology engineers together with domain experts as part of a human-centred, manual elicitation process. The use of Generative AI automates CQ creation at scale, therefore democratising the process of generation, widening stakeholder engagement, and ultimately broadening access to ontology engineering. However, given the large and heterogeneous landscape of LLMs, varying in dimensions such as parameter scale, task and domain specialisation, and accessibility, it is crucial to characterise and understand the intrinsic, observable properties of the CQs they produce (e.g., readability, structural complexity) through a systematic, cross-domain analysis. This paper introduces a set of quantitative measures for the systematic comparison of CQs across multiple dimensions. Using CQs generated from well defined use cases and scenarios, we identify their salient properties, including readability, relevance with respect to the input text and structural complexity of the generated questions. We conduct our experiments over a set of use cases and requirements using a range of LLMs, including both open (KimiK2-1T, LLama3.1-8B, LLama3.2-3B) and closed models (Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT 4.1). Our analysis demonstrates that LLM performance reflects distinct generation profiles shaped by the use case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套量化指标来系统比较不同大语言模型生成的胜任力问题，通过多维度分析揭示了LLM在CQ生成上的性能差异和生成特征。
AI.motivation: 传统胜任力问题创建依赖于人工、专家参与的流程，而生成式AI能够大规模自动化生成CQ，使过程民主化并扩大利益相关者参与。然而，由于LLM在参数规模、任务领域专业化等方面的巨大差异，需要通过系统化跨领域分析来理解和表征其生成的CQ的内在可观测特性。
AI.method: 引入一套用于多维度系统比较CQ的量化指标，使用明确定义的使用案例和场景生成CQ，识别其显著特性（包括可读性、与输入文本的相关性、生成问题的结构复杂性）。在多个使用案例和需求上进行实验，涵盖开源模型（KimiK2-1T、LLama3.1-8B、LLama3.2-3B）和闭源模型（Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT 4.1）。
AI.result: 分析表明，大语言模型的性能反映了由使用案例塑造的独特生成特征，不同LLM在CQ生成上表现出不同的性能模式。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统化的量化分析，可以更好地理解和比较不同LLM在胜任力问题生成方面的能力，为选择合适模型提供依据，并促进生成式AI在本体工程中的有效应用。

title: MemEvoBench: Benchmarking Memory MisEvolution in LLM Agents
summary: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with persistent memory enhances interaction continuity and personalization but introduces new safety risks. Specifically, contaminated or biased memory accumulation can trigger abnormal agent behaviors. Existing evaluation methods have not yet established a standardized framework for measuring memory misevolution. This phenomenon refers to the gradual behavioral drift resulting from repeated exposure to misleading information. To address this gap, we introduce MemEvoBench, the first benchmark evaluating long-horizon memory safety in LLM agents against adversarial memory injection, noisy tool outputs, and biased feedback. The framework consists of QA-style tasks across 7 domains and 36 risk types, complemented by workflow-style tasks adapted from 20 Agent-SafetyBench environments with noisy tool returns. Both settings employ mixed benign and misleading memory pools within multi-round interactions to simulate memory evolution. Experiments on representative models reveal substantial safety degradation under biased memory updates. Our analysis suggests that memory evolution is a significant contributor to these failures. Furthermore, static prompt-based defenses prove insufficient, underscoring the urgency of securing memory evolution in LLM agents.

AI.tldr: MemEvoBench：首个评估LLM智能体长期记忆安全性的基准，针对对抗性记忆注入、噪声工具输出和偏见反馈，揭示记忆演化导致的安全退化问题
AI.motivation: 为大型语言模型配备持久性记忆虽能增强交互连续性和个性化，但会引入新的安全风险。现有评估方法尚未建立标准化框架来衡量记忆错误演化现象，即重复接触误导信息导致的渐进性行为漂移。
AI.method: 提出MemEvoBench基准，包含两种任务设置：1）7个领域36种风险类型的问答式任务；2）基于20个Agent-SafetyBench环境的流程式任务（含噪声工具返回）。两种设置都在多轮交互中使用混合良性/误导记忆池来模拟记忆演化。
AI.result: 对代表性模型的实验显示，在偏见记忆更新下出现显著的安全退化。分析表明记忆演化是这些失败的重要贡献因素。静态提示防御被证明不足够。
AI.conclusion: 记忆演化是LLM智能体安全的关键风险，需要专门的安全机制来保护记忆演化过程，现有静态防御方法不足以应对此类威胁。

title: Diffusion Autoencoder for Unsupervised Artifact Restoration in Handheld Fundus Images
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 Table - ISBI IEEE 2025 CONFERENCE
summary: The advent of handheld fundus imaging devices has made ophthalmologic diagnosis and disease screening more accessible, efficient, and cost-effective. However, images captured from these setups often suffer from artifacts such as flash reflections, exposure variations, and motion-induced blur, which degrade image quality and hinder downstream analysis. While generative models have been effective in image restoration, most depend on paired supervision or predefined artifact structures, making them less adaptable to unstructured degradations commonly observed in handheld fundus images. To address this, we propose an unsupervised diffusion autoencoder that integrates a context encoder with the denoising process to learn semantically meaningful representations for artifact restoration. The model is trained only on high-quality table-top fundus images and infers to restore artifact-affected handheld acquisitions. We validate the restorations through quantitative and qualitative evaluations, and have shown that diagnostic accuracy increases to 81.17% on an unseen dataset and multiple artifact conditions

AI.tldr: 提出一种无监督扩散自编码器，用于修复手持式眼底图像中的伪影，无需配对监督或预定义伪影结构，仅使用高质量桌面眼底图像训练即可恢复多种伪影
AI.motivation: 手持式眼底成像设备使眼科诊断和疾病筛查更易获取、高效和经济，但捕获的图像常存在闪光反射、曝光变化和运动模糊等伪影，降低图像质量并阻碍下游分析。现有生成模型大多依赖配对监督或预定义伪影结构，难以适应手持式眼底图像中常见的非结构化退化
AI.method: 提出无监督扩散自编码器，将上下文编码器与去噪过程集成，学习语义上有意义的表示用于伪影修复。模型仅使用高质量桌面眼底图像训练，可推断并恢复受伪影影响的手持采集图像
AI.result: 通过定量和定性评估验证修复效果，在未见数据集和多种伪影条件下，诊断准确率提升至81.17%
AI.conclusion: 该无监督扩散自编码器方法能有效修复手持式眼底图像中的伪影，提高图像质量并增强下游诊断任务的准确性，无需配对监督即可适应非结构化退化

title: Learning to Reason with Insight for Informal Theorem Proving
summary: Although most of the automated theorem-proving approaches depend on formal proof systems, informal theorem proving can align better with large language models' (LLMs) strength in natural language processing. In this work, we identify a primary bottleneck in informal theorem proving as a lack of insight, namely the difficulty of recognizing the core techniques required to solve complex problems. To address this, we propose a novel framework designed to cultivate this essential reasoning skill and enable LLMs to perform insightful reasoning. We propose $\mathtt{DeepInsightTheorem}$, a hierarchical dataset that structures informal proofs by explicitly extracting core techniques and proof sketches alongside the final proof. To fully exploit this dataset, we design a Progressive Multi-Stage SFT strategy that mimics the human learning process, guiding the model from basic proof writing to insightful thinking. Our experiments on challenging mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that this insight-aware generation strategy significantly outperforms baselines. These results demonstrate that teaching models to identify and apply core techniques can substantially improve their mathematical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DeepInsightTheorem框架，通过显式提取核心技术和证明草图来结构化非正式证明，采用渐进式多阶段SFT策略提升LLMs的数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 当前自动定理证明方法大多依赖形式化证明系统，但非正式定理证明能更好利用LLMs在自然语言处理方面的优势。研究发现非正式定理证明的主要瓶颈是缺乏洞察力，即难以识别解决复杂问题所需的核心技术。
AI.method: 提出DeepInsightTheorem分层数据集，显式提取核心技术和证明草图；设计渐进式多阶段SFT策略，模拟人类学习过程，从基础证明写作引导到洞察性思考。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的数学基准测试中，这种洞察感知的生成策略显著优于基线方法，证明教导模型识别和应用核心技术能大幅提升其数学推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过培养LLMs识别和应用核心技术的洞察力，可以有效提升其在非正式定理证明中的表现，为数学推理能力的发展提供了新方向。

title: PIIBench: A Unified Multi-Source Benchmark Corpus for Personally Identifiable Information Detection
summary: We present PIIBench, a unified benchmark corpus for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection in natural language text. Existing resources for PII detection are fragmented across domain-specific corpora with mutually incompatible annotation schemes, preventing systematic comparison of detection systems. We consolidate ten publicly available datasets spanning synthetic PII corpora, multilingual Named Entity Recognition (NER) benchmarks, and financial domain annotated text, yielding a corpus of 2,369,883 annotated sequences and 3.35 million entity mentions across 48 canonical PII entity types. We develop a principled normalization pipeline that maps 80+ source-specific label variants to a standardized BIO tagging scheme, applies frequency-based suppression of near absent entity types, and produces stratified 80/10/10 train/validation/test splits preserving source distribution. To establish baseline difficulty, we evaluate eight published systems spanning rule-based engines (Microsoft Presidio), general purpose NER models (spaCy, BERT-base NER, XLM-RoBERTa NER, SpanMarker mBERT, SpanMarker BERT), a PII-specific model (Piiranha DeBERTa), and a financial NER specialist (XtremeDistil FiNER). All systems achieve span-level F1 below 0.14, with the best system (Presidio, F1=0.1385) still producing zero recall on most entity types. These results directly quantify the domain-silo problem and demonstrate that PIIBench presents a substantially harder and more comprehensive evaluation challenge than any existing single source PII dataset. The dataset construction pipeline and benchmark evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/pritesh-2711/pii-bench.

AI.tldr: PIIBench是一个统一的个人身份信息检测基准语料库，整合了10个公开数据集，包含236万条标注序列和335万个实体提及，涵盖48种PII实体类型，为系统比较提供了标准化评估平台。
AI.motivation: 现有PII检测资源分散在领域特定的语料库中，标注方案互不兼容，无法对检测系统进行系统比较。为了解决这一领域孤岛问题，需要创建一个统一的基准语料库。
AI.method: 整合10个公开数据集，开发原则性归一化流程，将80多个源特定标签变体映射到标准BIO标注方案，应用基于频率的实体类型抑制，并生成保持源分布的分层80/10/10训练/验证/测试分割。
AI.result: 评估了8个已发布系统，所有系统的跨度级F1分数均低于0.14，最佳系统（Presidio，F1=0.1385）对大多数实体类型的召回率为零。这些结果直接量化了领域孤岛问题，表明PIIBench比任何现有单一源PII数据集都更具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: PIIBench为PII检测提供了一个更全面、更困难的评估挑战，解决了现有资源的碎片化问题，为系统比较提供了标准化基准，数据集构建流程和基准评估代码已公开可用。

title: MambaBack: Bridging Local Features and Global Contexts in Whole Slide Image Analysis
summary: Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis is pivotal in computational pathology, enabling cancer diagnosis by integrating morphological and architectural cues across magnifications. Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) serves as the standard framework for WSI analysis. Recently, Mamba has become a promising backbone for MIL, overtaking Transformers due to its efficiency and global context modeling capabilities originating from Natural Language Processing (NLP). However, existing Mamba-based MIL approaches face three critical challenges: (1) disruption of 2D spatial locality during 1D sequence flattening; (2) sub-optimal modeling of fine-grained local cellular structures; and (3) high memory peaks during inference on resource-constrained edge devices. Studies like MambaOut reveal that Mamba's SSM component is redundant for local feature extraction, where Gated CNNs suffice. Recognizing that WSI analysis demands both fine-grained local feature extraction akin to natural images, and global context modeling akin to NLP, we propose MambaBack, a novel hybrid architecture that harmonizes the strengths of Mamba and MambaOut. First, we propose the Hilbert sampling strategy to preserve the 2D spatial locality of tiles within 1D sequences, enhancing the model's spatial perception. Second, we design a hierarchical structure comprising a 1D Gated CNN block based on MambaOut to capture local cellular features, and a BiMamba2 block to aggregate global context, jointly enhancing multi-scale representation. Finally, we implement an asymmetric chunking design, allowing parallel processing during training and chunking-streaming accumulation during inference, minimizing peak memory usage for deployment. Experimental results on five datasets demonstrate that MambaBack outperforms seven state-of-the-art methods. Source code and datasets are publicly available.

AI.tldr: MambaBack：一种结合Mamba和MambaOut优势的混合架构，用于全切片图像分析，通过Hilbert采样、分层结构和非对称分块设计解决现有方法的三个关键挑战
AI.motivation: 现有基于Mamba的多实例学习方法在全切片图像分析中存在三个关键问题：1D序列展平破坏2D空间局部性；细粒度局部细胞结构建模不足；在资源受限的边缘设备上推理时内存峰值过高。研究显示Mamba的SSM组件在局部特征提取中是冗余的，而门控CNN已足够。WSI分析既需要类似自然图像的细粒度局部特征提取，又需要类似NLP的全局上下文建模。
AI.method: 提出MambaBack混合架构：1）Hilbert采样策略，在1D序列中保留瓦片的2D空间局部性；2）分层结构，包含基于MambaOut的1D门控CNN块用于捕获局部细胞特征，以及BiMamba2块用于聚合全局上下文；3）非对称分块设计，训练时并行处理，推理时分块流式累积，最小化内存使用。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上的实验结果表明，MambaBack优于七种最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: MambaBack通过结合Mamba和MambaOut的优势，有效解决了WSI分析中的三个关键挑战，在保持高效性的同时提升了性能，适合在资源受限的边缘设备上部署。

title: Using Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs to Improve the Interpretability of Machine Learning Models in Manufacturing
summary: Explaining Machine Learning (ML) results in a transparent and user-friendly manner remains a challenging task of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI). In this paper, we present a method to enhance the interpretability of ML models by using a Knowledge Graph (KG). We store domain-specific data along with ML results and their corresponding explanations, establishing a structured connection between domain knowledge and ML insights. To make these insights accessible to users, we designed a selective retrieval method in which relevant triplets are extracted from the KG and processed by a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate user-friendly explanations of ML results. We evaluated our method in a manufacturing environment using the XAI Question Bank. Beyond standard questions, we introduce more complex, tailored questions that highlight the strengths of our approach. We evaluated 33 questions, analyzing responses using quantitative metrics such as accuracy and consistency, as well as qualitative ones such as clarity and usefulness. Our contribution is both theoretical and practical: from a theoretical perspective, we present a novel approach for effectively enabling LLMs to dynamically access a KG in order to improve the explainability of ML results. From a practical perspective, we provide empirical evidence showing that such explanations can be successfully applied in real-world manufacturing environments, supporting better decision-making in manufacturing processes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用知识图谱增强机器学习模型可解释性的方法，通过将领域知识、ML结果和解释结构化存储，并使用LLM生成用户友好的解释。
AI.motivation: 机器学习结果的可解释性仍然是XAI领域的挑战，需要以透明和用户友好的方式解释ML结果，特别是在实际应用场景中。
AI.method: 使用知识图谱存储领域特定数据、ML结果及其解释，建立领域知识与ML洞察的结构化连接；设计选择性检索方法从KG中提取相关三元组，通过LLM处理生成用户友好的ML结果解释。
AI.result: 在制造环境中使用XAI问题库进行评估，测试了33个问题，分析了准确性、一致性等定量指标以及清晰度、有用性等定性指标，证明该方法在实际制造环境中能成功应用。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在理论和实践上都有贡献：理论上提出了让LLM动态访问KG以改进ML结果可解释性的新方法；实践上提供了在真实制造环境中成功应用的实证证据，支持制造过程中更好的决策制定。

title: A Systematic Study of Training-Free Methods for Trustworthy Large Language Models
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) receive increasing attention and are being deployed across various domains, their potential risks, including generating harmful or biased content, producing unsupported claims, and exhibiting vulnerabilities to adversarial attacks, have drawn significant attention. To enable quick and low-cost adaptation, training-free methods have recently emerged as cost-effective alternatives to post-training alignment techniques. Despite their promising results, these methods are evaluated inconsistently across the literature, cover limited dimensions of trustworthiness, and can introduce undesirable side effects, such as utility degradation and increased brittleness. To fully assess the impacts of these training-free methods, we take a step back and systematically re-evaluate the effectiveness of existing training-free methods against various trustworthy settings and their influence on utility, robustness, and computational overhead. We also categorize these methods into three levels (input, internal, and output) based on where they intervene in the model's information flow during inference. Using this taxonomy, we conduct a comprehensive analysis of various representative and effective methods from each level across different LLM families and sizes. Our analysis highlights several trade-offs and unresolved challenges in current approaches. We summarize key findings and limitations in the existing literature, and propose practical recommendations for balancing trustworthiness, utility, and robustness in LLMs without the need for additional training.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了无需训练的LLM对齐方法，提出了基于干预位置的三级分类法，分析了这些方法在可信性、实用性、鲁棒性和计算开销方面的权衡，并提出了实用建议。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在各领域部署，其潜在风险（如有害/偏见内容、无依据声明、对抗攻击脆弱性）受到关注。无需训练的方法作为低成本适应方案出现，但现有评估不一致、可信性维度有限，且可能带来实用性下降和脆弱性增加等副作用。
AI.method: 1. 系统重新评估现有无需训练方法在不同可信性设置下的有效性及其对实用性、鲁棒性和计算开销的影响；2. 基于推理过程中干预位置将方法分为三级：输入级、内部级和输出级；3. 使用该分类法对不同LLM家族和规模的各类代表性方法进行全面分析。
AI.result: 分析揭示了当前方法中的多个权衡和未解决的挑战，包括可信性提升与实用性下降之间的平衡、鲁棒性变化、计算开销增加等问题。不同干预级别的方法表现出不同的优势和局限性。
AI.conclusion: 总结了现有文献的关键发现和局限性，提出了在不需额外训练的情况下平衡LLM可信性、实用性和鲁棒性的实用建议，为未来无需训练对齐方法的研究和应用提供了指导框架。

title: Sketch and Text Synergy: Fusing Structural Contours and Descriptive Attributes for Fine-Grained Image Retrieval
comment: Image Retrieval, Hand-drawn Sketch, Multi-stage Cross-modal Feature Alignment
summary: Fine-grained image retrieval via hand-drawn sketches or textual descriptions remains a critical challenge due to inherent modality gaps. While hand-drawn sketches capture complex structural contours, they lack color and texture, which text effectively provides despite omitting spatial contours. Motivated by the complementary nature of these modalities, we propose the Sketch and Text Based Image Retrieval (STBIR) framework. By synergizing the rich color and texture cues from text with the structural outlines provided by sketches, STBIR achieves superior fine-grained retrieval performance. First, a curriculum learning driven robustness enhancement module is proposed to enhance the model's robustness when handling queries of varying quality. Second, we introduce a category-knowledge-based feature space optimization module, thereby significantly boosting the model's representational power. Finally, we design a multi-stage cross-modal feature alignment mechanism to effectively mitigate the challenges of cross modal feature alignment. Furthermore, we curate the fine-grained STBIR benchmark dataset to rigorously validate the efficacy of our proposed framework and to provide data support as a reference for subsequent related research. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed STBIR framework significantly outperforms state of the art methods.

AI.tldr: STBIR框架通过结合手绘草图的轮廓结构和文本的颜色纹理信息，实现了细粒度图像检索，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 手绘草图能捕捉复杂结构轮廓但缺乏颜色纹理，文本能提供颜色纹理信息但缺少空间轮廓，两种模态具有互补性，需要解决模态差异问题以实现更好的细粒度图像检索。
AI.method: 提出STBIR框架：1）课程学习驱动的鲁棒性增强模块处理不同质量查询；2）基于类别知识的特征空间优化模块提升表示能力；3）多阶段跨模态特征对齐机制缓解对齐挑战；4）构建细粒度STBIR基准数据集。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，STBIR框架在细粒度图像检索任务上显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过协同利用草图的轮廓结构和文本的颜色纹理信息，STBIR框架有效解决了跨模态细粒度图像检索的挑战，为后续研究提供了基准数据集和方法参考。

title: ASMR-Bench: Auditing for Sabotage in ML Research
summary: As AI systems are increasingly used to conduct research autonomously, misaligned systems could introduce subtle flaws that produce misleading results while evading detection. We introduce ASMR-Bench (Auditing for Sabotage in ML Research), a benchmark for evaluating the ability of auditors to detect sabotage in ML research codebases. ASMR-Bench consists of 9 ML research codebases with sabotaged variants that produce qualitatively different experimental results. Each sabotage modifies implementation details, such as hyperparameters, training data, or evaluation code, while preserving the high-level methodology described in the paper. We evaluated frontier LLMs and LLM-assisted human auditors on ASMR-Bench and found that both struggled to reliably detect sabotage: the best performance was an AUROC of 0.77 and a top-1 fix rate of 42%, achieved by Gemini 3.1 Pro. We also tested LLMs as red teamers and found that LLM-generated sabotages were weaker than human-generated ones but still sometimes evaded same-capability LLM auditors. We release ASMR-Bench to support research on monitoring and auditing techniques for AI-conducted research.

AI.tldr: ASMR-Bench是一个用于评估审计员检测机器学习研究代码库中蓄意破坏能力的基准测试，包含9个被篡改的ML研究代码库，前沿LLM和LLM辅助人类审计员在检测破坏方面表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统越来越多地用于自主进行研究，未对齐的系统可能会引入难以察觉的缺陷，产生误导性结果却逃避检测。需要开发工具来监控和审计AI进行的研究。
AI.method: 创建ASMR-Bench基准测试，包含9个ML研究代码库及其被蓄意破坏的变体。破坏通过修改实现细节（如超参数、训练数据或评估代码）来实现，同时保持论文中描述的高级方法不变。评估前沿LLM和LLM辅助人类审计员检测破坏的能力，并测试LLM作为红队生成破坏的能力。
AI.result: 前沿LLM和LLM辅助人类审计员在检测破坏方面表现不佳：最佳性能由Gemini 3.1 Pro实现，AUROC为0.77，top-1修复率为42%。LLM生成的破坏比人类生成的弱，但有时仍能逃避同能力LLM审计员的检测。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI系统在检测ML研究代码中的蓄意破坏方面存在显著局限性，需要进一步研究AI进行研究的监控和审计技术。ASMR-Bench的发布旨在支持这一领域的研究。

title: CHOP: Chunkwise Context-Preserving Framework for RAG on Multi Documents
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems lose retrieval accuracy when similar documents coexist in the vector database, causing unnecessary information, hallucinations, and factual errors. To alleviate this issue, we propose CHOP, a framework that iteratively evaluates chunk relevance with Large Language Models (LLMs) and progressively reconstructs documents by determining their association with specific topics or query types. CHOP integrates two key components: the CNM-Extractor, which generates compact per-chunk signatures capturing categories, key nouns, and model names, and the Continuity Decision Module, which preserves contextual coherence by deciding whether consecutive chunks belong to the same document flow. By prefixing each chunk with context-aware metadata, CHOP reduces semantic conflicts among similar documents and enhances retriever discrimination. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that CHOP alleviates retrieval confusion and provides a scalable approach for building high-quality knowledge bases, achieving a Top-1 Hit Rate of 90.77% and notable gains in ranking quality metrics.

AI.tldr: CHOP框架通过迭代评估文档块相关性并渐进重构文档来解决RAG系统中相似文档共存导致的检索准确性问题，提升检索区分度。
AI.motivation: 当向量数据库中存在相似文档时，检索增强生成（RAG）系统会出现检索准确性下降的问题，导致不必要的信息、幻觉和事实错误。
AI.method: 提出CHOP框架，包含两个核心组件：CNM-Extractor（生成包含类别、关键名词和模型名称的紧凑块签名）和Continuity Decision Module（通过判断连续块是否属于同一文档流来保持上下文连贯性）。通过为每个块添加上下文感知的元数据前缀，减少相似文档间的语义冲突。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的实验显示，CHOP缓解了检索混淆，为构建高质量知识库提供了可扩展方法，实现了90.77%的Top-1命中率，并在排名质量指标上取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: CHOP通过迭代评估块相关性和渐进重构文档，有效解决了RAG系统中相似文档共存导致的检索准确性问题，提高了检索器的区分能力。

title: RefereeBench: Are Video MLLMs Ready to be Multi-Sport Referees
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at generic video understanding, their ability to support specialized, rule-grounded decision-making remains insufficiently explored. In this paper, we introduce RefereeBench, the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating MLLMs as automatic sports referees. Spanning 11 sports with 925 curated videos and 6,475 QA pairs, RefereeBench evaluates five core officiating abilities: foul existence, foul and penalty classification, foul and penalty reasoning, entity perception, and temporal grounding. The benchmark is fully human-annotated to ensure high-quality annotations grounded in authentic officiating logic and multimodal evidence. Extensive evaluations of state-of-the-art MLLMs show that even the strongest models, such as Doubao-Seed-1.8 and Gemini-3-Pro, achieve only around 60% accuracy, while the strongest open-source model, Qwen3-VL, reaches only 47%. These results indicate that current models remain far from being reliable sports referees. Further analysis shows that while models can often identify incidents and involved entities, they struggle with rule application and temporal grounding, and frequently over-call fouls on normal clips. Our benchmark highlights the need for future MLLMs that better integrate domain knowledge and multimodal understanding, advancing trustworthy AI-assisted officiating and broader multimodal decision-making.

AI.tldr: RefereeBench是首个用于评估多模态大语言模型作为自动体育裁判能力的大规模基准测试，涵盖11项运动、925个视频和6,475个问答对，结果显示当前最先进模型准确率仅约60%，远未达到可靠裁判水平。
AI.motivation: 虽然多模态大语言模型在通用视频理解方面表现出色，但其在专业、基于规则的决策支持能力方面尚未得到充分探索。研究者希望评估MLLMs在体育裁判这一需要专业规则知识和多模态理解的领域的能力。
AI.method: 研究者创建了RefereeBench基准测试，涵盖11项体育运动，包含925个精心挑选的视频和6,475个问答对。该基准评估五个核心裁判能力：犯规存在性判断、犯规和处罚分类、犯规和处罚推理、实体感知和时间定位。所有标注均由人工完成，确保基于真实裁判逻辑和多模态证据的高质量标注。
AI.result: 对最先进MLLMs的广泛评估显示，即使最强的模型如Doubao-Seed-1.8和Gemini-3-Pro也只能达到约60%的准确率，而最强的开源模型Qwen3-VL仅达到47%。分析表明，模型虽然通常能够识别事件和涉及实体，但在规则应用和时间定位方面存在困难，并且经常在正常片段上过度判罚犯规。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型距离成为可靠的体育裁判还有很大差距。该基准测试强调了未来MLLMs需要更好地整合领域知识和多模态理解，以推进可信的AI辅助裁判和更广泛的多模态决策能力。

title: Seeing the Intangible: Survey of Image Classification into High-Level and Abstract Categories
summary: The field of Computer Vision (CV) is increasingly shifting towards ``high-level'' visual sensemaking tasks, yet the exact nature of these tasks remains unclear and tacit. This survey paper addresses this ambiguity by systematically reviewing research on high-level visual understanding, focusing particularly on Abstract Concepts (ACs) in automatic image classification. Our survey contributes in three main ways: Firstly, it clarifies the tacit understanding of high-level semantics in CV through a multidisciplinary analysis, and categorization into distinct clusters, including commonsense, emotional, aesthetic, and inductive interpretative semantics. Secondly, it identifies and categorizes computer vision tasks associated with high-level visual sensemaking, offering insights into the diverse research areas within this domain. Lastly, it examines how abstract concepts such as values and ideologies are handled in CV, revealing challenges and opportunities in AC-based image classification. Notably, our survey of AC image classification tasks highlights persistent challenges, such as the limited efficacy of massive datasets and the importance of integrating supplementary information and mid-level features. We emphasize the growing relevance of hybrid AI systems in addressing the multifaceted nature of AC image classification tasks. Overall, this survey enhances our understanding of high-level visual reasoning in CV and lays the groundwork for future research endeavors.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了计算机视觉中高级视觉理解研究，特别关注自动图像分类中的抽象概念，通过多学科分析澄清了高级语义的隐性理解，识别了相关任务，并探讨了抽象概念处理的挑战与机遇。
AI.motivation: 计算机视觉领域正逐渐转向"高级"视觉理解任务，但这些任务的确切性质仍不明确且多为隐性知识。本文旨在通过系统综述澄清这种模糊性，特别是针对自动图像分类中的抽象概念。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，对高级视觉理解研究进行多学科分析，将高级语义分类为常识、情感、美学和归纳解释语义等不同聚类，识别并分类相关计算机视觉任务，并特别考察抽象概念在CV中的处理方式。
AI.result: 研究发现：1) 澄清了CV中高级语义的隐性理解并进行了系统分类；2) 识别了高级视觉理解相关的多样化CV任务；3) 揭示了抽象概念图像分类中的挑战，如大规模数据集效果有限、需要补充信息和中层特征整合；4) 强调了混合AI系统在处理复杂AC图像分类任务中的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 本综述增强了对计算机视觉中高级视觉推理的理解，为未来研究奠定了基础，特别指出混合AI系统在处理抽象概念图像分类的多面性方面具有日益增长的相关性。

title: Concept-wise Attention for Fine-grained Concept Bottleneck Models
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, Accepted by CVPR 2026 Fingdings
summary: Recently impressive performance has been achieved in Concept Bottleneck Models (CBM) by utilizing the image-text alignment learned by a large pre-trained vision-language model (i.e. CLIP). However, there exist two key limitations in concept modeling. Existing methods often suffer from pre-training biases, manifested as granularity misalignment or reliance on structural priors. Moreover, fine-tuning with Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) loss treats each concept independently, which ignores mutual exclusivity among concepts, leading to suboptimal alignment. To address these limitations, we propose Concept-wise Attention for Fine-grained Concept Bottleneck Models (CoAt-CBM), a novel framework that achieves adaptive fine-grained image-concept alignment and high interpretability. Specifically, CoAt-CBM employs learnable concept-wise visual queries to adaptively obtain fine-grained concept-wise visual embeddings, which are then used to produce a concept score vector. Then, a novel concept contrastive optimization guides the model to handle the relative importance of the concept scores, enabling concept predictions to faithfully reflect the image content and improved alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoAt-CBM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The codes will be available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: CoAt-CBM提出了一种新的概念瓶颈模型框架，通过概念级注意力机制实现细粒度图像-概念对齐，解决了现有方法中的预训练偏差和概念互斥性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型存在两个关键限制：1) 预训练偏差问题，表现为粒度不对齐或对结构先验的依赖；2) 使用二元交叉熵损失微调时，将每个概念独立处理，忽略了概念间的互斥性，导致对齐效果不理想。
AI.method: 提出CoAt-CBM框架：1) 使用可学习的概念级视觉查询自适应获取细粒度的概念级视觉嵌入；2) 生成概念得分向量；3) 引入新颖的概念对比优化，指导模型处理概念得分的相对重要性，使概念预测能忠实反映图像内容并改善对齐效果。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CoAt-CBM在性能上持续优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: CoAt-CBM通过自适应细粒度图像-概念对齐和高可解释性，有效解决了概念瓶颈模型中的预训练偏差和概念互斥性问题，取得了优越的性能表现。

title: CoEvolve: Training LLM Agents via Agent-Data Mutual Evolution
summary: Reinforcement learning for LLM agents is typically conducted on a static data distribution, which fails to adapt to the agent's evolving behavior and leads to poor coverage of complex environment interactions. To address these challenges, we propose CoEvolve, an agent-data mutual evolution framework that enables LLM agents to improve through closed-loop, interaction-driven training. Specifically, CoEvolve extracts feedback signals such as forgetting and uncertainty from rollout trajectories to identify failure-prone interaction patterns, and utilizes them to guide LLM-based task synthesis. The synthesized tasks are validated through environment interaction and utilized to update the data distribution, enabling joint adaptation of the agent and its data. Extensive experiments on AppWorld and BFCL across Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate consistent and significant improvements over strong base models, yielding absolute gains of 19.43%, 15.58%, and 18.14%, respectively.

AI.tldr: CoEvolve提出了一种智能体-数据协同进化框架，通过从交互轨迹中提取反馈信号指导任务合成，实现智能体与训练数据的闭环共同进化，显著提升LLM智能体在复杂环境中的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习通常在静态数据分布上训练LLM智能体，无法适应智能体行为演变，导致对复杂环境交互的覆盖不足。需要一种能够实现智能体与数据协同进化的框架。
AI.method: CoEvolve框架从交互轨迹中提取遗忘和不确定性等反馈信号，识别易失败交互模式，利用这些信号指导基于LLM的任务合成。合成任务通过环境交互验证后更新数据分布，实现智能体与数据的联合适应。
AI.result: 在AppWorld和BFCL基准测试中，对Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-30B-A3B模型进行实验，相比强基线模型分别获得19.43%、15.58%和18.14%的绝对性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CoEvolve通过智能体与数据的协同进化机制，有效解决了静态数据分布的限制，为LLM智能体的持续改进提供了闭环训练框架，在多个模型和基准上实现了显著性能提升。

title: PLAF: Pixel-wise Language-Aligned Feature Extraction for Efficient 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Accurate open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding requires semantic representations that are both language-aligned and spatially precise at the pixel level, while remaining scalable when lifted to 3D space. However, existing representations struggle to jointly satisfy these requirements, and densely propagating pixel-wise semantics to 3D often results in substantial redundancy, leading to inefficient storage and querying in large-scale scenes. To address these challenges, we present \emph{PLAF}, a Pixel-wise Language-Aligned Feature extraction framework that enables dense and accurate semantic alignment in 2D without sacrificing open-vocabulary expressiveness. Building upon this representation, we further design an efficient semantic storage and querying scheme that significantly reduces redundancy across both 2D and 3D domains. Experimental results show that \emph{PLAF} provides a strong semantic foundation for accurate and efficient open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding. The codes are publicly available at https://github.com/RockWenJJ/PLAF.

AI.tldr: PLAF是一个像素级语言对齐特征提取框架，用于实现准确且高效的开放词汇3D场景理解，通过减少语义冗余来提升存储和查询效率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以同时满足语言对齐、空间精确和可扩展性的要求，且像素级语义传播到3D时会产生大量冗余，导致大规模场景中存储和查询效率低下。
AI.method: 提出了PLAF框架，首先在2D中实现密集准确的语义对齐而不牺牲开放词汇表达能力，然后设计了高效的语义存储和查询方案，显著减少2D和3D领域的冗余。
AI.result: 实验结果表明PLAF为准确高效的开放词汇3D场景理解提供了强大的语义基础。
AI.conclusion: PLAF通过像素级语言对齐特征提取和高效的语义存储方案，解决了现有3D场景理解中语义对齐、空间精确性和可扩展性之间的平衡问题。

title: Exploring the Capability Boundaries of LLMs in Mastering of Chinese Chouxiang Language
summary: While large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in general language tasks, their performance on Chouxiang Language, a representative subcultural language in the Chinese internet context, remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce Mouse, a specialized benchmark designed to evaluate the capabilities of LLMs on NLP tasks involving Chouxiang Language across six tasks. Experimental results show that, current state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs exhibit clear limitations on multiple tasks, while performing well on tasks that involve contextual semantic understanding. In addition, we further discuss the reasons behind the generally low performance of SOTA LLMs on Chouxiang Language, examine whether the LLM-as-a-judge approach adopted for translation tasks aligns with human judgments and values, and analyze the key factors that influence Chouxiang translation. Our study aims to promote further research in the NLP community on multicultural integration and the dynamics of evolving internet languages. Our code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Mouse基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在抽象语言（中国互联网亚文化语言）上的表现，发现现有SOTA模型在多个任务上存在明显局限，但在涉及上下文语义理解的任务上表现良好。
AI.motivation: 虽然大语言模型在通用语言任务上取得了显著成功，但它们在抽象语言（中国互联网亚文化代表性语言）上的表现尚未得到充分探索。需要专门评估LLM在这种特定文化语言上的能力。
AI.method: 开发了Mouse基准测试，包含六个NLP任务来评估LLM在抽象语言上的能力。实验评估了当前SOTA LLM的表现，并进一步分析了LLM在翻译任务中作为评判者的方法是否与人类判断和价值观一致，以及影响抽象翻译的关键因素。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，当前SOTA LLM在多个任务上表现出明显局限性，但在涉及上下文语义理解的任务上表现良好。研究还发现LLM-as-a-judge方法在翻译任务中与人类判断和价值观存在差异，并识别了影响抽象翻译的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 本研究旨在促进NLP社区在多元文化融合和互联网语言动态演化方面的进一步研究。代码和数据已公开可用，为评估LLM在亚文化语言上的能力提供了基准工具。

title: Disentangling Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs: A Methodological Investigation of Internal Mechanisms
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities, yet their internal mechanisms for handling reasoning-intensive tasks remain underexplored. To advance the understanding of model-internal processing mechanisms, we present an investigation of how LLMs perform arithmetic operations by examining internal mechanisms during task execution. Using early decoding, we trace how next-token predictions are constructed across layers. Our experiments reveal that while the models recognize arithmetic tasks early, correct result generation occurs only in the final layers. Notably, models proficient in arithmetic exhibit a clear division of labor between attention and MLP modules, where attention propagates input information and MLP modules aggregate it. This division is absent in less proficient models. Furthermore, successful models appear to process more challenging arithmetic tasks functionally, suggesting reasoning capabilities beyond factual recall.

AI.tldr: 本文通过早期解码技术研究大语言模型执行算术运算的内部机制，发现熟练模型在注意力与MLP模块间存在明确分工，而能力较弱模型则缺乏这种分工。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在推理密集型任务上表现出色，但其内部处理机制仍未被充分理解。为了增进对模型内部处理机制的认识，本文研究LLMs如何执行算术运算，探索任务执行期间的内部工作机制。
AI.method: 使用早期解码技术，追踪模型在不同层中如何构建下一个token的预测。通过实验分析模型在算术任务执行过程中的内部机制。
AI.result: 实验发现：1）模型能早期识别算术任务，但正确结果仅在最后几层生成；2）熟练算术的模型在注意力与MLP模块间存在明确分工（注意力传播输入信息，MLP模块聚合信息）；3）能力较弱模型缺乏这种分工；4）成功模型似乎以功能方式处理更复杂的算术任务，表明其具备超越事实记忆的推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在算术任务上的表现揭示了其内部处理机制的特点：熟练模型具有模块化分工，而能力较弱模型则缺乏这种结构。这为理解LLMs的推理能力提供了新视角，表明成功模型可能具备超越简单模式匹配的认知处理能力。

title: CiPO: Counterfactual Unlearning for Large Reasoning Models through Iterative Preference Optimization
summary: Machine unlearning has gained increasing attention in recent years, as a promising technique to selectively remove unwanted privacy or copyrighted information from Large Language Models that are trained on a massive scale of human data. However, the emergence of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), which emphasize long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to address complex questions, presents a dilemma to unlearning: existing methods either struggle to completely eliminate undesired knowledge from the CoT traces or degrade the reasoning performances due to the interference with the reasoning process. To this end, we introduce Counterfactual Unlearning through iterative Preference Optimization (CiPO), a novel framework that redefines unlearning as the targeted intervention of the CoT reasoning in LRMs. More specifically, given a desired unlearning target answer, CiPO instructs LRMs to generate a logically valid counterfactual reasoning trace for preference tuning. As the LRM adjusts to the counterfactual trace, CiPO iteratively updates the preference learning data to increase the discrepancy from the original model. This iterative loop ensures both desirable unlearning and smooth optimization, effectively mitigating the dilemma. Experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate that CiPO excels at unlearning, completely removing knowledge from both the intermediate CoT steps and the final answer, while preserving the reasoning abilities of LRMs.

AI.tldr: 提出CiPO框架，通过迭代偏好优化实现大推理模型的反事实遗忘，解决现有方法在消除链式思维推理痕迹与保持推理能力之间的困境
AI.motivation: 大推理模型强调长链式思维推理，现有遗忘方法要么难以完全消除链式思维痕迹中的不良知识，要么因干扰推理过程而降低推理性能，需要新的解决方案
AI.method: CiPO框架将遗忘重新定义为对大推理模型链式思维推理的针对性干预，通过生成逻辑有效的反事实推理痕迹进行偏好调优，并迭代更新偏好学习数据以增加与原模型的差异
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的基准测试中，CiPO在遗忘方面表现出色，能够完全消除中间链式思维步骤和最终答案中的知识，同时保持大推理模型的推理能力
AI.conclusion: CiPO通过反事实遗忘和迭代偏好优化有效解决了大推理模型中的遗忘困境，实现了知识完全消除与推理能力保持的平衡

title: DiZiNER: Disagreement-guided Instruction Refinement via Pilot Annotation Simulation for Zero-shot Named Entity Recognition
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures; Accepted to the ACL 2026 Main Conference
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced information extraction (IE) by enabling zero-shot and few-shot named entity recognition (NER), yet their generative outputs still show persistent and systematic errors. Despite progress through instruction fine-tuning, zero-shot NER still lags far behind supervised systems. These recurring errors mirror inconsistencies observed in early-stage human annotation processes that resolve disagreements through pilot annotation. Motivated by this analogy, we introduce DiZiNER (Disagreement-guided Instruction Refinement via Pilot Annotation Simulation for Zero-shot Named Entity Recognition), a framework that simulates the pilot annotation process, employing LLMs to act as both annotators and supervisors. Multiple heterogeneous LLMs annotate shared texts, and a supervisor model analyzes inter-model disagreements to refine task instructions. Across 18 benchmarks, DiZiNER achieves zero-shot SOTA results on 14 datasets, improving prior bests by +8.0 F1 and reducing the zero-shot to supervised gap by over +11 points. It also consistently outperforms its supervisor, GPT-5 mini, indicating that improvements stem from disagreement-guided instruction refinement rather than model capacity. Pairwise agreement between models shows a strong correlation with NER performance, further supporting this finding.

AI.tldr: DiZiNER框架通过模拟人类标注中的分歧解决过程，利用多个LLM作为标注者和监督者，通过分析模型间分歧来优化任务指令，显著提升了零样本命名实体识别性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在零样本和少样本命名实体识别方面取得了进展，但其生成输出仍存在持续性和系统性错误。零样本NER性能仍远落后于监督系统，这些错误类似于人类早期标注过程中的不一致性，需要通过试点标注来解决分歧。
AI.method: DiZiNER框架模拟试点标注过程，使用多个异构LLM作为标注者，让它们对共享文本进行标注，然后由监督模型分析模型间的分歧来优化任务指令。该方法借鉴了人类标注中通过分歧解决改进标注质量的过程。
AI.result: 在18个基准测试中，DiZiNER在14个数据集上实现了零样本SOTA结果，将先前最佳性能提升了+8.0 F1分数，并将零样本与监督系统之间的差距缩小了超过11个百分点。该方法甚至持续优于其监督模型GPT-5 mini。
AI.conclusion: DiZiNER通过分歧引导的指令优化显著提升了零样本NER性能，模型间的一致性程度与NER性能呈强相关，表明改进主要来自指令优化而非模型容量。该方法为改进LLM的零样本信息提取提供了有效途径。

title: Aligning What Vision-Language Models See and Perceive with Adaptive Information Flow
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capability in a wide range of tasks such as visual recognition, document parsing, and visual grounding. Nevertheless, recent work shows that while VLMs often manage to capture the correct image region corresponding to the question, they do not necessarily produce the correct answers. In this work, we demonstrate that this misalignment could be attributed to suboptimal information flow within VLMs, where text tokens distribute too much attention to irrelevant visual tokens, leading to incorrect answers. Based on the observation, we show that modulating the information flow during inference can improve the perception capability of VLMs. The idea is that text tokens should only be associated with important visual tokens during decoding, eliminating the interference of irrelevant regions. To achieve this, we propose a token dynamics-based method to determine the importance of visual tokens, where visual tokens that exhibit distinct activation patterns during different decoding stages are viewed as important. We apply our approach to representative open-source VLMs and evaluate on various datasets, including visual question answering, visual grounding and counting, optical character recognition, and object hallucination. The results show that our approach significantly improves the performance of baselines. Project page: https://cxliu0.github.io/AIF/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于令牌动态的方法来调节视觉语言模型中的信息流，通过识别重要的视觉令牌来改善模型的感知能力，从而提升多项视觉任务的表现。
AI.motivation: 研究发现视觉语言模型虽然能够定位到与问题相关的正确图像区域，但常常给出错误答案。作者认为这种错位是由于信息流不优化导致的，文本令牌对不相关的视觉令牌分配了过多注意力。
AI.method: 提出基于令牌动态的方法来确定视觉令牌的重要性：在不同解码阶段表现出明显激活模式的视觉令牌被视为重要令牌。通过调节推理过程中的信息流，使文本令牌只与重要的视觉令牌关联，消除无关区域的干扰。
AI.result: 该方法在多个代表性开源视觉语言模型上进行了评估，涵盖视觉问答、视觉定位与计数、光学字符识别和对象幻觉等数据集。结果显示该方法显著提升了基线模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过调节视觉语言模型中的信息流，特别是让文本令牌只关注重要的视觉令牌，可以有效改善模型的感知能力，解决定位正确但答案错误的问题。

title: How Hypocritical Is Your LLM judge? Listener-Speaker Asymmetries in the Pragmatic Competence of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly studied as repositories of linguistic knowledge. In this line of work, models are commonly evaluated both as generators of language and as judges of linguistic output, yet these two roles are rarely examined in direct relation to one another. As a result, it remains unclear whether success in one role aligns with success in the other. In this paper, we address this question for pragmatic competence by comparing LLMs' performance as pragmatic listeners, judging the appropriateness of linguistic outputs, and as pragmatic speakers, generating pragmatically appropriate language. We evaluate multiple open-weight and proprietary LLMs across three pragmatic settings. We find a robust asymmetry between pragmatic evaluation and pragmatic generation: many models perform substantially better as listeners than as speakers. Our results suggest that pragmatic judging and pragmatic generation are only weakly aligned in current LLMs, calling for more integrated evaluation practices.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型在语用能力上存在不对称性：作为听者（判断语言适当性）的表现显著优于作为说话者（生成适当语言）的表现
AI.motivation: 当前研究通常将LLMs同时作为语言生成器和语言输出评判者进行评估，但很少直接比较这两种角色之间的关系，不清楚一种角色的成功是否与另一种角色的成功相一致
AI.method: 通过比较多个开源和专有LLMs在三种语用场景中的表现，评估它们作为语用听者（判断语言适当性）和语用说话者（生成适当语言）的能力
AI.result: 发现语用评估和语用生成之间存在显著不对称性：许多模型作为听者的表现明显优于作为说话者的表现
AI.conclusion: 当前LLMs中的语用判断和语用生成能力仅弱相关，需要更综合的评估方法

title: Continual Hand-Eye Calibration for Open-world Robotic Manipulation
summary: Hand-eye calibration through visual localization is a critical capability for robotic manipulation in open-world environments. However, most deep learning-based calibration models suffer from catastrophic forgetting when adapting into unseen data amongst open-world scene changes, while simple rehearsal-based continual learning strategy cannot well mitigate this issue. To overcome this challenge, we propose a continual hand-eye calibration framework, enabling robots to adapt to sequentially encountered open-world manipulation scenes through spatially replay strategy and structure-preserving distillation. Specifically, a Spatial-Aware Replay Strategy (SARS) constructs a geometrically uniform replay buffer that ensures comprehensive coverage of each scene pose space, replacing redundant adjacent frames with maximally informative viewpoints. Meanwhile, a Structure-Preserving Dual Distillation (SPDD) is proposed to decompose localization knowledge into coarse scene layout and fine pose precision, and distills them separately to alleviate both types of forgetting during continual adaptation. As a new manipulation scene arrives, SARS provides geometrically representative replay samples from all prior scenes, and SPDD applies structured distillation on these samples to retain previously learned knowledge. After training on the new scene, SARS incorporates selected samples from the new scene into the replay buffer for future rehearsal, allowing the model to continuously accumulate multi-scene calibration capability. Experiments on multiple public datasets show significant anti scene forgetting performance, maintaining accuracy on past scenes while preserving adaptation to new scenes, confirming the effectiveness of the framework.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种持续手眼标定框架，通过空间感知重放策略和结构保持双重蒸馏，使机器人能够在开放世界环境中持续适应新场景而不遗忘已学知识。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习标定模型在适应开放世界新场景时存在灾难性遗忘问题，而简单的重放策略无法有效缓解这一问题。需要一种能够持续适应多个场景而不遗忘先前知识的标定方法。
AI.method: 提出空间感知重放策略(SARS)构建几何均匀的重放缓冲区，确保每个场景姿态空间的全面覆盖；同时提出结构保持双重蒸馏(SPDD)将定位知识分解为粗粒度场景布局和细粒度姿态精度，分别进行蒸馏以缓解两种类型的遗忘。
AI.result: 在多个公共数据集上的实验显示显著的抗场景遗忘性能，能够在保持对新场景适应能力的同时维持对过去场景的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过空间感知重放和结构保持蒸馏，有效实现了持续手眼标定，使机器人能够在开放世界环境中持续积累多场景标定能力。

title: Watching Movies Like a Human: Egocentric Emotion Understanding for Embodied Companions
summary: Embodied robotic agents often perceive movies through an egocentric screen-view interface rather than native cinematic footage, introducing domain shifts such as viewpoint distortion, scale variation, illumination changes, and environmental interference. However, existing research on movie emotion understanding is almost exclusively conducted on cinematic footage, limiting cross-domain generalization to real-world viewing scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce EgoScreen-Emotion (ESE), the first benchmark dataset for egocentric screen-view movie emotion understanding. ESE contains 224 movie trailers captured under controlled egocentric screen-view conditions, producing 28,667 temporally aligned key-frames annotated by multiple raters with a confidence-aware multi-label protocol to address emotional ambiguity. We further build a multimodal long-context emotion reasoning framework that models temporal visual evidence, narrative summaries, compressed historical context, and audio cues. Cross-domain experiments reveal a severe domain gap: models trained on cinematic footage drop from 27.99 to 16.69 Macro-F1 when evaluated on realistic egocentric screen-view observations. Training on ESE substantially improves robustness under realistic viewing conditions. Our approach achieves competitive performance compared with strong closed-source multimodal models, highlighting the importance of domain-specific data and long-context multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 首个面向具身机器人代理的自我中心屏幕视角电影情感理解基准数据集ESE，解决了传统电影情感分析在真实观看场景中的领域迁移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有电影情感理解研究主要基于电影原片素材，而具身机器人代理通常通过自我中心屏幕视角感知电影，存在视角扭曲、尺度变化、光照变化和环境干扰等域偏移问题，限制了跨域泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建了ESE数据集，包含224个在受控自我中心屏幕视角条件下捕获的电影预告片，生成28,667个时间对齐的关键帧，采用置信度感知的多标签标注协议处理情感模糊性；并建立了多模态长上下文情感推理框架，建模时序视觉证据、叙事摘要、压缩历史上下文和音频线索。
AI.result: 实验揭示了严重的领域差距：在电影原片素材上训练的模型在真实自我中心屏幕视角观察上的Macro-F1从27.99下降到16.69；在ESE上训练显著提高了在真实观看条件下的鲁棒性；该方法与强大的闭源多模态模型相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定数据和长上下文多模态推理对于具身机器人代理在真实世界观看场景中的电影情感理解至关重要，ESE基准为这一研究方向提供了重要基础。

title: RAGognizer: Hallucination-Aware Fine-Tuning via Detection Head Integration
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely used to augment the input to Large Language Models (LLMs) with external information, such as recent or domain-specific knowledge. Nonetheless, current models still produce closed-domain hallucinations and generate content that is unsupported by the retrieved context. Current detection approaches typically treat hallucination as a post-hoc problem, relying on black-box consistency checks or probes over frozen internal representations. In this work, we demonstrate that hallucination detection based on internal state representation can also serve as a direct training signal. We introduce RAGognize, a dataset of naturally occurring closed-domain hallucinations with token-level annotations, and RAGognizer, a hallucination-aware fine-tuning approach that integrates a lightweight detection head into an LLM, allowing for the joint optimization of language modeling and hallucination detection. This joint objective forces the model to improve the separability of its internal states regarding hallucinations while simultaneously learning to generate well-formed and meaningful responses. Across multiple benchmarks, RAGognizer achieves state-of-the-art token-level hallucination detection while substantially reducing hallucination rates during generation, without degrading language quality or relevance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RAGognizer方法，通过联合优化语言建模和幻觉检测，在RAG系统中实现更好的幻觉检测和减少幻觉生成。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG系统仍然产生闭域幻觉（与检索上下文不符的内容），现有检测方法多为后处理方案，依赖黑盒一致性检查或冻结内部表示的探针，缺乏直接利用内部状态表示作为训练信号的方法。
AI.method: 提出RAGognize数据集（包含自然产生的闭域幻觉和token级标注）和RAGognizer方法，将轻量级检测头集成到LLM中，联合优化语言建模和幻觉检测目标，强制模型改善内部状态对幻觉的可分离性。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，RAGognizer实现了最先进的token级幻觉检测，同时显著降低生成过程中的幻觉率，且不损害语言质量或相关性。
AI.conclusion: 基于内部状态表示的幻觉检测可以作为直接训练信号，联合优化方法能同时改善幻觉检测和生成质量，为RAG系统的幻觉问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: SSFT: A Lightweight Spectral-Spatial Fusion Transformer for Generic Hyperspectral Classification
comment: This paper has been accepted at IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops (CVPRW), 2026
summary: Hyperspectral imaging enables fine-grained recognition of materials by capturing rich spectral signatures, but learning robust classifiers is challenging due to high dimensionality, spectral redundancy, limited labeled data, and strong domain shifts. Beyond earth observation, labeled HSI data is often scarce and imbalanced, motivating compact models for generic hyperspectral classification across diverse acquisition regimes. We propose the lightweight Spectral-Spatial Fusion Transformer (SSFT), which factorizes representation learning into spectral and spatial pathways and integrates them via cross-attention to capture complementary wavelength-dependent and structural information. We evaluate our SSFT on the challenging HSI-Benchmark, a heterogeneous multi-dataset benchmark covering earth observation, fruit condition assessment, and fine-grained material recognition. SSFT achieves state-of-the-art overall performance, ranking first while using less than 2% of the parameters of the previous leading method. We further evaluate transfer to the substantially larger SpectralEarth benchmark under the official protocol, where SSFT remains competitive despite its compact size. Ablation studies show that both spectral and spatial pathways are crucial, with spatial modeling contributing most, and that SSFT remains robust without data augmentation.

AI.tldr: SSFT是一个轻量级光谱-空间融合Transformer模型，通过分解光谱和空间表示学习路径并利用交叉注意力融合，在HSI-Benchmark上以不到2%的参数实现SOTA性能，在SpectralEarth基准上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 高光谱成像具有丰富的光谱特征，但由于高维度、光谱冗余、标记数据有限和强域偏移等问题，学习鲁棒分类器具有挑战性。特别是在地球观测之外，标记的HSI数据通常稀缺且不平衡，需要紧凑模型以适应不同采集机制。
AI.method: 提出轻量级光谱-空间融合Transformer（SSFT），将表示学习分解为光谱和空间两条路径，通过交叉注意力整合以捕获互补的波长依赖信息和结构信息。
AI.result: 在异质多数据集基准HSI-Benchmark（涵盖地球观测、水果状况评估和细粒度材料识别）上实现最先进的整体性能，排名第一，且参数少于先前领先方法的2%。在更大的SpectralEarth基准上，SSFT尽管尺寸紧凑但仍保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SSFT通过光谱和空间路径的分解与融合，实现了高效的高光谱分类。消融研究表明两条路径都至关重要，其中空间建模贡献最大，且模型在没有数据增强的情况下仍保持鲁棒性。

title: SCHK-HTC: Sibling Contrastive Learning with Hierarchical Knowledge-Aware Prompt Tuning for Hierarchical Text Classification
summary: Few-shot Hierarchical Text Classification (few-shot HTC) is a challenging task that involves mapping texts to a predefined tree-structured label hierarchy under data-scarce conditions. While current approaches utilize structural constraints from the label hierarchy to maintain parent-child prediction consistency, they face a critical bottleneck, the difficulty in distinguishing semantically similar sibling classes due to insufficient domain knowledge. We introduce an innovative method named Sibling Contrastive Learning with Hierarchical Knowledge-aware Prompt Tuning for few-shot HTC tasks (SCHK-HTC). Our work enhances the model's perception of subtle differences between sibling classes at deeper levels, rather than just enforcing hierarchical rules. Specifically, we propose a novel framework featuring two core components: a hierarchical knowledge extraction module and a sibling contrastive learning mechanism. This design guides model to encode discriminative features at each hierarchy level, thus improving the separability of confusable classes. Our approach achieves superior performance across three benchmark datasets, surpassing existing state-of-the-art methods in most cases. Our code is available at https://github.com/happywinder/SCHK-HTC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCHK-HTC方法，通过层次知识提取和兄弟类对比学习解决少样本层次文本分类中相似兄弟类难以区分的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前少样本层次文本分类方法主要依赖标签层次的结构约束来保持父子预测一致性，但面临一个关键瓶颈：由于领域知识不足，难以区分语义相似的兄弟类。
AI.method: 提出SCHK-HTC方法，包含两个核心组件：1) 层次知识提取模块，从标签层次中提取知识；2) 兄弟类对比学习机制，增强模型对深层兄弟类细微差异的感知能力。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上取得了优越性能，在大多数情况下超越了现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过层次知识提取和兄弟类对比学习，SCHK-HTC方法能够更好地编码每个层次级别的判别特征，提高混淆类的可分性，有效解决少样本层次文本分类中的挑战。

title: Beyond Text Prompts: Precise Concept Erasure through Text-Image Collaboration
summary: Text-to-image generative models have achieved impressive fidelity and diversity, but can inadvertently produce unsafe or undesirable content due to implicit biases embedded in large-scale training datasets. Existing concept erasure methods, whether text-only or image-assisted, face trade-offs: textual approaches often fail to fully suppress concepts, while naive image-guided methods risk over-erasing unrelated content. We propose TICoE, a text-image Collaborative Erasing framework that achieves precise and faithful concept removal through a continuous convex concept manifold and hierarchical visual representation learning. TICoE precisely removes target concepts while preserving unrelated semantic and visual content. To objectively assess the quality of erasure, we further introduce a fidelity-oriented evaluation strategy that measures post-erasure usability. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that TICoE surpasses prior methods in concept removal precision and content fidelity, enabling safer, more controllable text-to-image generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenAscent-L/TICoE.git

AI.tldr: TICoE是一个文本-图像协作的概念擦除框架，通过连续凸概念流形和分层视觉表示学习，实现精确的概念移除，同时保留无关内容。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像生成模型虽然取得了令人印象深刻的保真度和多样性，但由于大规模训练数据集中嵌入的隐含偏见，可能会无意中产生不安全或不理想的内容。现有的概念擦除方法面临权衡：文本方法通常无法完全抑制概念，而简单的图像引导方法可能过度擦除无关内容。
AI.method: TICoE（文本-图像协作擦除框架）采用连续凸概念流形和分层视觉表示学习，通过文本和图像的协作实现精确的概念移除。该方法能够精确移除目标概念，同时保留无关的语义和视觉内容。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的实验表明，TICoE在概念移除精度和内容保真度方面超越了先前的方法，实现了更安全、更可控的文本到图像生成。
AI.conclusion: TICoE通过文本-图像协作框架实现了精确且忠实的概念移除，为更安全、更可控的文本到图像生成提供了有效解决方案。作者还引入了面向保真度的评估策略来客观衡量擦除后的可用性。

title: AgentV-RL: Scaling Reward Modeling with Agentic Verifier
summary: Verifiers have been demonstrated to enhance LLM reasoning via test-time scaling (TTS). Yet, they face significant challenges in complex domains. Error propagation from incorrect intermediate reasoning can lead to false positives for seemingly plausible solutions, while lacking external grounding makes verifiers unreliable on computation or knowledge-intensive tasks. To address these challenges, we propose Agentic Verifier, a framework that transforms reward modeling into a multi-turn, tool-augmented deliberative process. We introduce complementary forward and backward agents: one traces solutions from premises to conclusions, while the other re-checks conclusions against their underlying premises. This bidirectional process enables a comprehensive, reliable, and interpretable assessment of solutions. To facilitate practical deployment, we propose AgentV-RL. Through proactive exploration and reinforcement learning, the verifier autonomously interleaves tool-use with internal reasoning. Extensive experiments show that Agentic Verifier yields consistent performance gains under both parallel and sequential TTS. Notably, our 4B variant surpasses state-of-the-art ORMs by 25.2%, positioning it as a promising paradigm for agentic reward modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic Verifier框架，通过双向代理（前向和后向）和多轮工具增强的审议过程，解决传统验证器在复杂领域中的错误传播和缺乏外部基础问题，显著提升LLM推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有验证器在复杂领域面临两大挑战：1）错误中间推理导致的错误传播，可能对看似合理的解决方案产生误判；2）缺乏外部基础，在计算或知识密集型任务中不可靠。需要更可靠、可解释的验证框架。
AI.method: 提出Agentic Verifier框架，将奖励建模转化为多轮工具增强的审议过程。引入互补的前向和后向代理：前向代理从前提追踪到结论，后向代理从结论反向检查前提。提出AgentV-RL，通过主动探索和强化学习，使验证器自主交替使用工具和内部推理。
AI.result: 实验表明Agentic Verifier在并行和顺序TTS下均获得一致性能提升。4B变体超越最先进ORM 25.2%，成为代理奖励建模的有前景范式。
AI.conclusion: Agentic Verifier通过双向代理审议和工具增强推理，解决了传统验证器的局限性，提供了全面、可靠、可解释的解决方案评估，在复杂推理任务中表现出显著优势。

title: Learning to Look before Learning to Like: Incorporating Human Visual Cognition into Aesthetic Quality Assessment
comment: Accepted for Poster Presentation at CogSci 2026
