title: IA-CLAHE: Image-Adaptive Clip Limit Estimation for CLAHE
comment: Accepted to NTIRE 2026 Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: This paper proposes image-adaptive contrast limited adaptive histogram equalization (IA-CLAHE). Conventional CLAHE is widely used to boost the performance of various computer vision tasks and to improve visual quality for human perception in practical industrial applications. CLAHE applies contrast limited histogram equalization to each local region to enhance local contrast. However, CLAHE often leads to over-enhancement, because the contrast-limiting parameter clip limit is fixed regardless of the histogram distribution of each local region. Our IA-CLAHE addresses this limitation by adaptively estimating tile-wise clip limits from the input image. To achieve this, we train a lightweight clip limits estimator with a differentiable extension of CLAHE, enabling end-to-end optimization. Unlike prior learning-based CLAHE methods, IA-CLAHE does not require pre-searched ground-truth clip limits or task-specific datasets, because it learns to map input image histograms toward a domain-invariant uniform distribution, enabling zero-shot generalization across diverse conditions. Experimental results show that IA-CLAHE consistently improves recognition performance, while simultaneously enhancing visual quality for human perception, without requiring any task-specific training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IA-CLAHE方法，通过自适应估计每个局部区域的对比度限制参数，解决传统CLAHE固定参数导致的过增强问题，无需任务特定训练数据即可提升视觉质量和识别性能。
AI.motivation: 传统CLAHE方法虽然广泛应用于计算机视觉任务和工业应用中提升视觉质量，但其固定的对比度限制参数（clip limit）不考虑每个局部区域的直方图分布，经常导致过增强问题。需要一种能够自适应调整参数的方法来克服这一局限性。
AI.method: 提出图像自适应对比度限制自适应直方图均衡化（IA-CLAHE），通过训练一个轻量级的clip limit估计器，使用CLAHE的可微分扩展实现端到端优化。该方法学习将输入图像直方图映射到领域不变的一致分布，无需预搜索的ground-truth clip limits或任务特定数据集。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，IA-CLAHE能够一致地提高识别性能，同时增强人类感知的视觉质量，且不需要任何任务特定的训练数据，具有零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: IA-CLAHE通过自适应估计局部区域的对比度限制参数，有效解决了传统CLAHE的过增强问题，实现了无需任务特定训练数据的零样本泛化，在提升识别性能的同时改善了视觉质量。

title: Breakout-picker: Reducing false positives in deep learning-based borehole breakout characterization from acoustic image logs
summary: Borehole breakouts are stress-induced spalling on the borehole wall, which are identifiable in acoustic image logs as paired zones with near-symmetry azimuths, low acoustic amplitudes, and increased borehole radius. Accurate breakout characterization is crucial for in-situ stress analysis. In recent years, deep learning has been introduced to automate the time-consuming and labor-intensive breakout picking process. However, existing approaches often suffer from misclassification of non-breakout features, leading to high false positive rates. To address this limitation, this study develops a deep learning framework, termed Breakout-picker, with a specific focus on reducing false positives in automatic breakout characterization. Breakout-picker reduces false positives through two strategies. First, the training of Breakout-picker incorporates negative samples of non-breakout features, including natural fractures, keyseats, and logging artifacts. They share similar characteristics with breakouts, such as low acoustic amplitude or locally enlarged borehole radius. These negative training samples enables Breakout-picker to better discriminate true breakouts and similar non-breakout features. Second, candidate breakouts identified by Breakout-picker are further validated by azimuthal symmetry criteria, whereby detections that do not exhibit the near-symmetry characteristics of breakout azimuth are excluded. The performance of Breakout-picker is evaluated using three acoustic image log datasets from different regions. The results demonstrate that Breakout-picker outperforms other automatic methods with higher accuracy and substantially lower false positive rates. By reducing false positives, Breakout-picker enhances the reliability of automatic breakout characterization from acoustic image logs, which in turn benefits in-situ stress analysis based on borehole breakouts.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个名为Breakout-picker的深度学习框架，通过结合负样本训练和方位对称性验证，显著降低了钻孔崩落自动识别的误报率。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法在自动识别钻孔崩落时经常误判非崩落特征，导致高误报率，这影响了原位应力分析的准确性。
AI.method: 开发Breakout-picker框架，采用两种策略：1）训练时加入自然裂缝、键槽和测井伪影等负样本；2）通过方位对称性标准进一步验证候选崩落。
AI.result: 在三个不同区域的声波图像测井数据集上评估，Breakout-picker比其他自动方法具有更高的准确性和显著更低的误报率。
AI.conclusion: 通过降低误报率，Breakout-picker提高了声波图像测井自动崩落识别的可靠性，从而有利于基于钻孔崩落的原位应力分析。

title: Elucidating the SNR-t Bias of Diffusion Probabilistic Models
summary: Diffusion Probabilistic Models have demonstrated remarkable performance across a wide range of generative tasks. However, we have observed that these models often suffer from a Signal-to-Noise Ratio-timestep (SNR-t) bias. This bias refers to the misalignment between the SNR of the denoising sample and its corresponding timestep during the inference phase. Specifically, during training, the SNR of a sample is strictly coupled with its timestep. However, this correspondence is disrupted during inference, leading to error accumulation and impairing the generation quality. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence and theoretical analysis to substantiate this phenomenon and propose a simple yet effective differential correction method to mitigate the SNR-t bias. Recognizing that diffusion models typically reconstruct low-frequency components before focusing on high-frequency details during the reverse denoising process, we decompose samples into various frequency components and apply differential correction to each component individually. Extensive experiments show that our approach significantly improves the generation quality of various diffusion models (IDDPM, ADM, DDIM, A-DPM, EA-DPM, EDM, PFGM++, and FLUX) on datasets of various resolutions with negligible computational overhead. The code is at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/DCW.

AI.tldr: 论文发现扩散概率模型存在SNR-t偏差问题，即在推理阶段去噪样本的信噪比与其对应时间步长不匹配，导致误差累积和生成质量下降。作者提出了一种简单有效的差分校正方法，通过分解频率分量进行独立校正，显著提升了多种扩散模型的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散概率模型在各种生成任务中表现出色，但作者观察到这些模型普遍存在SNR-t偏差问题。在训练阶段，样本的信噪比与其时间步长严格对应，但在推理阶段这种对应关系被破坏，导致误差累积，损害生成质量。
AI.method: 提出了一种简单有效的差分校正方法来缓解SNR-t偏差。考虑到扩散模型在反向去噪过程中通常先重建低频分量再关注高频细节，作者将样本分解为不同频率分量，并对每个分量分别应用差分校正。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法显著提升了多种扩散模型（包括IDDPM、ADM、DDIM、A-DPM、EA-DPM、EDM、PFGM++和FLUX）在不同分辨率数据集上的生成质量，且计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了扩散模型中存在的SNR-t偏差问题，并提出了一种有效的差分校正解决方案。该方法简单高效，能够显著提升多种扩散模型的生成性能，为扩散模型的改进提供了新思路。

title: Mind's Eye: A Benchmark of Visual Abstraction, Transformation and Composition for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive progress on vision language benchmarks, yet their capacity for visual cognitive and visuospatial reasoning remains less understood. We introduce "Mind's Eye", a multiple-choice benchmark of eight visuo-cognitive tasks inspired by classic human intelligence tests and organized under a novel "A-R-T" taxonomy: Abstraction, Relation, and Transformation. The tasks probe core processes of fluid intelligence such as pattern induction, analogical relation mapping, and mental transformation. We evaluate a diverse suite of closed-source and open-source MLLMs and compare their performance with human participants. Humans achieve 80% accuracy, while top performing MLLMs remain below 50%. Error analysis reveals failures in: (i) visual attention allocation, (ii) internal perceptual manipulation, and (iii) weak abstraction of underlying visual concepts. Our findings suggest that current MLLMs exhibit limited visuospatial reasoning capabilities, when compared with human participants, highlighting the need for more cognitively grounded evaluation frameworks.

AI.tldr: Mind's Eye是一个评估多模态大语言模型视觉认知和空间推理能力的基准测试，包含8个任务，基于A-R-T分类法（抽象、关系、转换）。人类准确率达80%，而最佳MLLMs低于50%，显示当前模型在视觉空间推理方面存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大语言模型在视觉语言基准测试上取得了显著进展，但其视觉认知和空间推理能力仍未被充分理解。研究者希望创建一个系统性的评估框架来深入探究MLLMs在这些核心认知能力上的表现。
AI.method: 研究者开发了"Mind's Eye"基准测试，包含8个视觉认知任务，基于A-R-T分类法（抽象、关系、转换）。这些任务灵感来源于经典的人类智力测试，评估流体智力的核心过程，如模式归纳、类比关系映射和心理转换。评估了多种闭源和开源MLLMs，并与人类参与者进行对比。
AI.result: 人类参与者在基准测试中达到80%的准确率，而表现最佳的MLLMs准确率仍低于50%。错误分析揭示了模型在三个关键方面的失败：(1) 视觉注意力分配不足，(2) 内部感知操作能力有限，(3) 对底层视觉概念的抽象能力薄弱。
AI.conclusion: 当前的多模态大语言模型在视觉空间推理能力上与人类存在显著差距。研究强调了需要更基于认知科学的评估框架来推动MLLMs在视觉认知能力上的发展，而不仅仅是追求基准测试分数。

title: Chain-of-Thought Degrades Visual Spatial Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal Reasoning Models (MRMs) leveraging Chain-of-Thought (CoT) based thinking have revolutionized mathematical and logical problem-solving. However, we show that this paradigm struggles with generalized spatial intelligence. We perform a comprehensive evaluation of seventeen models across thirteen spatial benchmarks and identify a critical gap: CoT prompting consistently degrades performance in visual spatial reasoning. Furthermore, through a novel No-Image++ ablation, we demonstrate that MRMs and CoT prompted MLMs suffer from severe shortcut learning, and hallucinate visual details from textual priors even when the image is absent. These findings challenge the efficacy of text-only CoT for spatial tasks and underscore the need for vision-centric reasoning paradigms.

AI.tldr: 研究发现多模态推理模型在空间推理任务中表现不佳，基于文本的思维链提示反而会降低性能，模型存在严重的捷径学习和视觉幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 虽然基于思维链的多模态推理模型在数学和逻辑问题解决方面取得了革命性进展，但作者发现这种范式在广义空间智能方面存在严重不足，需要进行系统评估。
AI.method: 对17个模型在13个空间基准测试上进行全面评估，使用思维链提示方法，并通过新颖的No-Image++消融实验来验证模型是否存在捷径学习和视觉幻觉问题。
AI.result: 思维链提示在视觉空间推理任务中持续降低模型性能，多模态推理模型和思维链提示的MLMs存在严重的捷径学习问题，即使图像缺失时也会从文本先验中产生视觉细节幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 文本思维链方法在空间任务中效果有限，挑战了当前方法的有效性，强调了需要开发以视觉为中心的新型推理范式。

title: Early Detection of Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) Using YOLOv12 Deep Learning Model
summary: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) is one of the most life-threatening type of blood cancers, and its accurate classification is considered and remains a challenging task due to the visual similarity between various cell types. This study addresses the classification of the multiclasses of AML cells Utilizing YOLOv12 deep learning model. We applied two segmentation approaches based on cell and nucleus features, using Hue channel and Otsu thresholding techniques to preprocess the images prior to classification. Our experiments demonstrate that YOLOv12 with Otsu thresholding on cell-based segmentation achieved the highest level of validation and test accuracy, both reaching 99.3%.

AI.tldr: 使用YOLOv12深度学习模型对急性髓系白血病细胞进行多分类，通过细胞和细胞核特征两种分割方法，结合色调通道和Otsu阈值技术预处理图像，最终细胞分割结合Otsu阈值方法在验证集和测试集上均达到99.3%的最高准确率。
AI.motivation: 急性髓系白血病是最具生命威胁的血液癌症之一，由于不同细胞类型在视觉上相似，其准确分类一直是一个具有挑战性的任务。本研究旨在解决AML细胞的多分类问题。
AI.method: 采用YOLOv12深度学习模型，应用基于细胞和细胞核特征的两种分割方法，使用色调通道和Otsu阈值技术对图像进行预处理，然后进行分类任务。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，基于细胞分割结合Otsu阈值处理的YOLOv12模型在验证集和测试集上均取得了99.3%的最高准确率。
AI.conclusion: YOLOv12模型结合适当的图像预处理技术（特别是细胞分割和Otsu阈值处理）能够有效实现AML细胞的高精度多分类，为白血病诊断提供了有前景的自动化解决方案。

title: TableSeq: Unified Generation of Structure, Content, and Layout
summary: We present TableSeq, an image-only, end-to-end framework for joint table structure recognition, content recognition, and cell localization. The model formulates these tasks as a single sequence-generation problem: one decoder produces an interleaved stream of \texttt{HTML} tags, cell text, and discretized coordinate tokens, thereby aligning logical structure, textual content, and cell geometry within a unified autoregressive sequence. This design avoids external OCR, auxiliary decoders, and complex multi-stage post-processing. TableSeq combines a lightweight high-resolution FCN-H16 encoder with a minimal structure-prior head and a single-layer transformer encoder, yielding a compact architecture that remains effective on challenging layouts. Across standard benchmarks, TableSeq achieves competitive or state-of-the-art results while preserving architectural simplicity. It reaches 95.23 TEDS / 96.83 S-TEDS on PubTabNet, 97.45 TEDS / 98.69 S-TEDS on FinTabNet, and 99.79 / 99.54 / 99.66 precision / recall / F1 on SciTSR under the CAR protocol, while remaining competitive on PubTables-1M under GriTS. Beyond TSR/TCR, the same sequence interface generalizes to index-based table querying without task-specific heads, achieving the best IRDR score and competitive ICDR/ICR performance. We also study multi-token prediction for faster blockwise decoding and show that it reduces inference latency with only limited accuracy degradation. Overall, TableSeq provides a practical and reproducible single-stream baseline for unified table recognition, and the source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/hamdilaziz/TableSeq.

AI.tldr: TableSeq是一个端到端的图像表格识别框架，将表格结构识别、内容识别和单元格定位统一为单一序列生成任务，使用HTML标签、文本内容和坐标标记的混合序列表示。
AI.motivation: 现有表格识别方法通常需要外部OCR、多个解码器或复杂的后处理流程，导致系统复杂且效率低下。TableSeq旨在通过统一的序列生成框架简化这一过程，实现更简洁高效的表格识别。
AI.method: 将表格识别任务转化为单一序列生成问题，使用一个解码器生成包含HTML标签、单元格文本和离散化坐标标记的交错序列。采用轻量级高分辨率FCN-H16编码器、结构先验头和单层Transformer编码器的紧凑架构。
AI.result: 在多个标准基准测试中取得竞争性或最先进的结果：PubTabNet上95.23 TEDS/96.83 S-TEDS，FinTabNet上97.45 TEDS/98.69 S-TEDS，SciTSR上99.79/99.54/99.66精度/召回率/F1分数。同时支持基于索引的表格查询任务。
AI.conclusion: TableSeq提供了一个实用且可复现的单流基线框架，通过统一的序列生成方法简化了表格识别流程，避免了复杂的外部组件和后处理，在保持架构简洁的同时实现了优异的性能。

title: The Amazing Stability of Flow Matching
comment: EurIPS 2025 Workshop on Principles of Generative Modeling (PriGM)
summary:
The success of deep generative models in generating high-quality and diverse samples is often attributed to particular architectures and large training datasets. In this paper, we investigate the impact of these factors on the quality and diversity of samples generated by \emph{flow-matching} models. Surprisingly, in our experiments on CelebA-HQ dataset, flow matching remains stable even when pruning 50\% of the dataset. That is, the quality and diversity of generated samples are preserved. Moreover, pruning impacts the latent representation only slightly, that is, samples generated by models trained on the full and pruned dataset map to visually similar outputs for a given seed. We observe similar stability when changing the architecture or training configuration, such that the latent representation is maintained under these changes as well.
  Our results quantify just how strong this stability can be in practice, and help explain the reliability of flow-matching models under various perturbations.

AI.tldr: 研究发现流匹配模型在数据量减少50%、架构变化等扰动下仍能保持生成质量和多样性，表现出很强的稳定性
AI.motivation: 探究深度生成模型成功的关键因素（特定架构和大规模数据集）对流匹配模型生成质量和多样性的影响
AI.method: 在CelebA-HQ数据集上进行实验，通过剪枝50%数据集、改变架构和训练配置等方式测试流匹配模型的稳定性
AI.result: 流匹配模型在数据剪枝50%后仍能保持生成质量和多样性；潜在表示在完整数据集和剪枝数据集训练下保持视觉相似；架构和训练配置变化下模型同样稳定
AI.conclusion: 流匹配模型在各种扰动下表现出很强的稳定性，这有助于解释其在实际应用中的可靠性

title: Do Vision-Language Models Truly Perform Vision Reasoning? A Rigorous Study of the Modality Gap
summary: Reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) has recently attracted significant attention due to its broad applicability across diverse downstream tasks. However, it remains unclear whether the superior performance of VLMs stems from genuine vision-grounded reasoning or relies predominantly on the reasoning capabilities of their textual backbones. To systematically measure this, we introduce CrossMath, a novel multimodal reasoning benchmark designed for controlled cross-modal comparisons. Specifically, we construct each problem in text-only, image-only, and image+text formats guaranteeing identical task-relevant information, verified by human annotators. This rigorous alignment effectively isolates modality-specific reasoning differences while eliminating confounding factors such as information mismatch. Extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art VLMs reveals a consistent phenomenon: a substantial performance gap between textual and visual reasoning. Notably, VLMs excel with text-only inputs, whereas incorporating visual data (image+text) frequently degrades performance compared to the text-only baseline. These findings indicate that current VLMs conduct reasoning primarily in the textual space, with limited genuine reliance on visual evidence. To mitigate this limitation, we curate a CrossMath training set for VLM fine-tuning. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that fine-tuning on this training set significantly boosts reasoning performance across all individual and joint modalities, while yielding robust gains on two general visual reasoning tasks. Source code is available at https://github.com/xuyige/CrossMath.

AI.tldr: CrossMath是一个多模态推理基准，用于评估视觉语言模型是否真正依赖视觉证据进行推理。研究发现当前VLMs主要在文本空间进行推理，视觉输入反而会降低性能。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型的优异表现究竟源于真正的视觉基础推理，还是主要依赖其文本骨干的推理能力，这一问题尚不明确。需要系统性地测量模型在不同模态下的推理能力差异。
AI.method: 提出了CrossMath基准，将每个问题构建为纯文本、纯图像和图像+文本三种格式，确保任务相关信息完全一致。通过人工验证对齐质量，有效隔离模态特定的推理差异。使用该基准评估了最先进的VLMs，并创建了CrossMath训练集进行微调。
AI.result: 评估发现：1）文本推理和视觉推理之间存在显著性能差距；2）VLMs在纯文本输入下表现优异，但加入视觉数据（图像+文本）后性能经常下降；3）当前VLMs主要在文本空间进行推理，对视觉证据的依赖有限。微调CrossMath训练集显著提升了所有模态的推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型主要依赖文本骨干进行推理，而非真正的视觉基础推理。CrossMath基准能够有效测量模态特定的推理差异，通过针对性微调可以改善模型的多模态推理能力。

title: SWNet: A Cross-Spectral Network for Camouflaged Weed Detection
summary: This paper presents SWNet, a bimodal end-to-end cross-spectral network specifically engineered for the detection of camouflaged weeds in dense agricultural environments. Plant camouflage, characterized by homochromatic blending where invasive species mimic the phenotypic traits of primary crops, poses a significant challenge for traditional computer vision systems. To overcome these limitations, SWNet utilizes a Pyramid Vision Transformer v2 backbone to capture long-range dependencies and a Bimodal Gated Fusion Module to dynamically integrate Visible and Near-Infrared information. By leveraging the physiological differences in chlorophyll reflectance captured in the NIR spectrum, the proposed architecture effectively discriminates targets that are otherwise indistinguishable in the visible range. Furthermore, an Edge-Aware Refinement module is employed to produce sharper object boundaries and reduce structural ambiguity. Experimental results on the Weeds-Banana dataset indicate that SWNet outperforms ten state-of-the-art methods. The study demonstrates that the integration of cross-spectral data and boundary-guided refinement is essential for high segmentation accuracy in complex crop canopies. The code is available on GitHub: https://cod-espol.github.io/SWNet/

AI.tldr: SWNet是一个双模态端到端跨光谱网络，专门用于在密集农业环境中检测伪装杂草，通过整合可见光和近红外信息以及边缘感知细化模块，在Weeds-Banana数据集上优于10种最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 植物伪装（入侵物种模仿主要作物的表型特征）给传统计算机视觉系统带来重大挑战，需要新的方法来在复杂农业环境中准确检测伪装杂草。
AI.method: 使用Pyramid Vision Transformer v2主干网络捕获长距离依赖关系，通过双模态门控融合模块动态整合可见光和近红外信息，利用近红外光谱中捕获的叶绿素反射生理差异，并采用边缘感知细化模块生成更清晰的对象边界。
AI.result: 在Weeds-Banana数据集上的实验结果表明，SWNet在分割精度上优于10种最先进的方法，证明了跨光谱数据和边界引导细化对于复杂作物冠层中高精度分割的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 跨光谱数据整合和边界引导细化对于复杂作物冠层中的高精度分割至关重要，SWNet通过有效利用近红外光谱信息和边缘感知细化，成功解决了伪装杂草检测的挑战。

title: VEFX-Bench: A Holistic Benchmark for Generic Video Editing and Visual Effects
summary: As AI-assisted video creation becomes increasingly practical, instruction-guided video editing has become essential for refining generated or captured footage to meet professional requirements. Yet the field still lacks both a large-scale human-annotated dataset with complete editing examples and a standardized evaluator for comparing editing systems. Existing resources are limited by small scale, missing edited outputs, or the absence of human quality labels, while current evaluation often relies on expensive manual inspection or generic vision-language model judges that are not specialized for editing quality. We introduce VEFX-Dataset, a human-annotated dataset containing 5,049 video editing examples across 9 major editing categories and 32 subcategories, each labeled along three decoupled dimensions: Instruction Following, Rendering Quality, and Edit Exclusivity. Building on VEFX-Dataset, we propose VEFX-Reward, a reward model designed specifically for video editing quality assessment. VEFX-Reward jointly processes the source video, the editing instruction, and the edited video, and predicts per-dimension quality scores via ordinal regression. We further release VEFX-Bench, a benchmark of 300 curated video-prompt pairs for standardized comparison of editing systems. Experiments show that VEFX-Reward aligns more strongly with human judgments than generic VLM judges and prior reward models on both standard IQA/VQA metrics and group-wise preference evaluation. Using VEFX-Reward as an evaluator, we benchmark representative commercial and open-source video editing systems, revealing a persistent gap between visual plausibility, instruction following, and edit locality in current models.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了VEFX-Dataset（包含5,049个视频编辑示例的人类标注数据集）、VEFX-Reward（专门用于视频编辑质量评估的奖励模型）和VEFX-Bench（包含300个视频-提示对的基准测试），以解决AI辅助视频编辑领域缺乏大规模标注数据和标准化评估的问题。
AI.motivation: 随着AI辅助视频创作日益实用，指令引导的视频编辑对于完善生成或拍摄的素材以满足专业需求变得至关重要。然而，该领域仍然缺乏具有完整编辑示例的大规模人类标注数据集，以及用于比较编辑系统的标准化评估器。现有资源受限于规模小、缺少编辑输出或缺乏人类质量标签，而当前评估通常依赖于昂贵的人工检查或未专门针对编辑质量的通用视觉语言模型评估器。
AI.method:
1. 构建VEFX-Dataset：包含5,049个视频编辑示例，涵盖9个主要编辑类别和32个子类别，每个示例在三个解耦维度上进行标注：指令遵循、渲染质量和编辑排他性。
2. 开发VEFX-Reward：专门用于视频编辑质量评估的奖励模型，联合处理源视频、编辑指令和编辑后的视频，通过序数回归预测每个维度的质量分数。
3. 发布VEFX-Bench：包含300个精选视频-提示对的基准测试，用于编辑系统的标准化比较。
AI.result: 实验表明，VEFX-Reward在标准IQA/VQA指标和分组偏好评估方面，比通用VLM评估器和先前的奖励模型更符合人类判断。使用VEFX-Reward作为评估器，对代表性商业和开源视频编辑系统进行基准测试，揭示了当前模型在视觉合理性、指令遵循和编辑局部性方面存在持续差距。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过提供大规模人类标注数据集、专门的质量评估模型和标准化基准测试，为指令引导的视频编辑领域填补了重要空白。VEFX-Reward在评估视频编辑质量方面表现出色，能够更准确地反映人类判断，为未来视频编辑系统的开发和评估提供了有价值的工具和基准。

title: DINOv3 Beats Specialized Detectors: A Simple Foundation Model Baseline for Image Forensics
summary: With the rapid advancement of deep generative models, realistic fake images have become increasingly accessible, yet existing localization methods rely on complex designs and still struggle to generalize across manipulation types and imaging conditions. We present a simple but strong baseline based on DINOv3 with LoRA adaptation and a lightweight convolutional decoder. Under the CAT-Net protocol, our best model improves average pixel-level F1 by 17.0 points over the previous state of the art on four standard benchmarks using only 9.1\,M trainable parameters on top of a frozen ViT-L backbone, and even our smallest variant surpasses all prior specialized methods. LoRA consistently outperforms full fine-tuning across all backbone scales. Under the data-scarce MVSS-Net protocol, LoRA reaches an average F1 of 0.774 versus 0.530 for the strongest prior method, while full fine-tuning becomes highly unstable, suggesting that pre-trained representations encode forensic information that is better preserved than overwritten. The baseline also exhibits strong robustness to Gaussian noise, JPEG re-compression, and Gaussian blur. We hope this work can serve as a reliable baseline for the research community and a practical starting point for future image-forensic applications. Code is available at https://github.com/Irennnne/DINOv3-IML.

AI.tldr: 提出基于DINOv3+LoRA的简单但强大的图像伪造定位基线方法，在多个基准测试中显著超越现有方法，仅需少量可训练参数
AI.motivation: 随着深度生成模型的快速发展，逼真的伪造图像越来越容易获取，但现有的定位方法设计复杂且难以泛化到不同的篡改类型和成像条件
AI.method: 基于DINOv3预训练模型，采用LoRA适配和轻量级卷积解码器，在冻结的ViT-L骨干网络上仅使用910万可训练参数
AI.result: 在CAT-Net协议下，最佳模型在四个标准基准测试中平均像素级F1分数比之前最佳方法提高17.0分；在数据稀缺的MVSS-Net协议下，LoRA达到平均F1 0.774，而之前最强方法仅为0.530；LoRA在所有骨干网络规模上都优于完全微调
AI.conclusion: 该方法可作为研究社区的可靠基线和实际图像取证应用的起点，预训练表示编码的取证信息更适合被保留而非覆盖

title: AIFIND: Artifact-Aware Interpreting Fine-Grained Alignment for Incremental Face Forgery Detection
summary: As forgery types continue to emerge consistently, Incremental Face Forgery Detection (IFFD) has become a crucial paradigm. However, existing methods typically rely on data replay or coarse binary supervision, which fails to explicitly constrain the feature space, leading to severe feature drift and catastrophic forgetting. To address this, we propose AIFIND, Artifact-Aware Interpreting Fine-Grained Alignment for Incremental Face Forgery Detection, which leverages semantic anchors to stabilize incremental learning. We design the Artifact-Driven Semantic Prior Generator to instantiate invariant semantic anchors, establishing a fixed coordinate system from low-level artifact cues. These anchors are injected into the image encoder via Artifact-Probe Attention, which explicitly constrains volatile visual features to align with stable semantic anchors. Adaptive Decision Harmonizer harmonizes the classifiers by preserving angular relationships of semantic anchors, maintaining geometric consistency across tasks. Extensive experiments on multiple incremental protocols validate the superiority of AIFIND.

AI.tldr: AIFIND提出了一种基于语义锚点的增量人脸伪造检测方法，通过稳定的语义锚点约束特征空间，解决现有方法中的特征漂移和灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 随着伪造类型不断涌现，增量人脸伪造检测变得至关重要。现有方法通常依赖数据回放或粗粒度的二元监督，无法显式约束特征空间，导致严重的特征漂移和灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出AIFIND框架：1) 设计基于伪影驱动的语义先验生成器，从低级伪影线索建立不变语义锚点；2) 通过伪影-探针注意力将锚点注入图像编码器，显式约束易变视觉特征与稳定语义锚点对齐；3) 自适应决策协调器通过保持语义锚点的角度关系来协调分类器，维持跨任务的几何一致性。
AI.result: 在多个增量协议上的广泛实验验证了AIFIND的优越性。
AI.conclusion: AIFIND通过语义锚点稳定增量学习，有效解决了特征漂移和灾难性遗忘问题，为增量人脸伪造检测提供了新的解决方案。

title: DenTab: A Dataset for Table Recognition and Visual QA on Real-World Dental Estimates
summary:
Tables condense key transactional and administrative information into compact layouts, but practical extraction requires more than text recognition: systems must also recover structure (rows, columns, merged cells, headers) and interpret roles such as line items, subtotals, and totals under common capture artifacts. Many existing resources for table structure recognition and TableVQA are built from clean digital-born sources or rendered tables, and therefore only partially reflect noisy administrative conditions.
  We introduce DenTab, a dataset of 2{,}000 cropped table images from dental estimates with high-quality HTML annotations, enabling evaluation of table recognition (TR) and table visual question answering (TableVQA) on the same inputs. DenTab includes 2{,}208 questions across eleven categories spanning retrieval, aggregation, and logic/consistency checks. We benchmark 16 systems, including 14 vision--language models (VLMs) and two OCR baselines. Across models, strong structure recovery does not consistently translate into reliable performance on multi-step arithmetic and consistency questions, and these reasoning failures persist even when using ground-truth HTML table inputs.
  To improve arithmetic reliability without training, we propose the Table Router Pipeline, which routes arithmetic questions to deterministic execution. The pipeline combines (i) a VLM that produces a baseline answer, a structured table representation, and a constrained table program with (ii) a rule-based executor that performs exact computation over the parsed table. The source code and dataset will be made publicly available at https://github.com/hamdilaziz/DenTab.

AI.tldr: DenTab是一个包含2000张牙科估算表图像的数据集，带有高质量HTML标注，用于评估表格识别和表格视觉问答。研究显示现有模型在复杂算术和一致性问题上表现不佳，作者提出了Table Router Pipeline来改进算术可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有表格识别和TableVQA数据集主要基于干净的数字原生源或渲染表格，不能充分反映实际行政文档中的噪声条件。需要能够同时评估表格结构恢复和表格视觉问答的数据集，特别是在复杂算术推理任务上。
AI.method: 1) 创建DenTab数据集：包含2000张牙科估算表图像，带有高质量HTML标注和2208个问题，涵盖检索、聚合和逻辑/一致性检查等11个类别；2) 评估16个系统（14个视觉语言模型和2个OCR基线）；3) 提出Table Router Pipeline：结合VLM生成答案、结构化表格表示和约束表格程序，以及基于规则的执行器进行精确计算。
AI.result: 1) 现有模型在表格结构恢复方面表现良好，但在多步算术和一致性问题上表现不可靠；2) 即使使用真实HTML表格输入，推理失败仍然存在；3) Table Router Pipeline能够在不需要训练的情况下提高算术问题的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: DenTab数据集填补了噪声行政表格评估的空白，揭示了现有模型在复杂表格推理任务上的局限性。Table Router Pipeline提供了一种无需训练即可提高算术可靠性的有效方法，为表格理解和推理系统的发展提供了重要基准。

title: Towards In-Context Tone Style Transfer with A Large-Scale Triplet Dataset
summary: Tone style transfer for photo retouching aims to adapt the stylistic tone of the reference image to a given content image. However, the lack of high-quality large-scale triplet datasets with stylized ground truth forces existing methods to rely on self-supervised or proxy objectives, which limits model capability. To mitigate this gap, we design a data construction pipeline to build TST100K, a large-scale dataset of 100,000 content-reference-stylized triplets. At the core of this pipeline, we train a tone style scorer to ensure strict stylistic consistency for each triplet. In addition, existing methods typically extract content and reference features independently and then fuse them in a decoder, which may cause semantic loss and lead to inappropriate color transfer and degraded visual aesthetics. Instead, we propose ICTone, a diffusion-based framework that performs tone transfer in an in-context manner by jointly conditioning on both images, leveraging the semantic priors of generative models for semantic-aware transfer. Reward feedback learning using the tone style scorer is further incorporated to improve stylistic fidelity and visual quality. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of TST100K, and ICTone achieves state-of-the-art performance on both quantitative metrics and human evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICTone框架，通过构建大规模TST100K数据集解决色调风格迁移中数据不足问题，采用扩散模型实现语义感知的上下文色调迁移，结合奖励反馈学习提升风格保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有照片色调风格迁移方法面临两大挑战：1）缺乏高质量大规模内容-参考-风格化三元组数据集，导致依赖自监督或代理目标，限制模型能力；2）现有方法独立提取内容和参考特征再融合，可能导致语义丢失、颜色迁移不当和视觉美学退化。
AI.method: 1）设计数据构建流程创建TST100K数据集（10万个三元组），训练色调风格评分器确保严格风格一致性；2）提出ICTone扩散框架，通过联合条件化两幅图像实现上下文色调迁移，利用生成模型的语义先验进行语义感知迁移；3）结合色调风格评分器进行奖励反馈学习，提升风格保真度和视觉质量。
AI.result: 实验证明TST100K数据集的有效性，ICTone在定量指标和人工评估中均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建大规模高质量数据集和提出上下文扩散框架，成功解决了色调风格迁移中的数据不足和语义丢失问题，实现了更好的语义感知颜色迁移和视觉美学效果。

title: From Articles to Canopies: Knowledge-Driven Pseudo-Labelling for Tree Species Classification using LLM Experts
summary: Hyperspectral tree species classification is challenging due to limited and imbalanced class labels, spectral mixing (overlapping light signatures from multiple species), and ecological heterogeneity (variability among ecological systems). Addressing these challenges requires methods that integrate biological and structural characteristics of vegetation, such as canopy architecture and interspecific interactions, rather than relying solely on spectral signatures. This paper presents a biologically informed, semi-supervised deep learning method that integrates multi-sensor Earth observation data, specifically hyperspectral imaging (HSI) and airborne laser scanning (ALS), with expert, ecological knowledge. The approach relies on biologically inspired pseudo-labelling over a precomputed canopy graph, yielding accurate classification at low training cost. In addition, ecological priors on species cohabitation are automatically derived from reliable sources using large language models (LLMs) and encoded as a cohabitation matrix with likelihoods of species occurring together. These priors are incorporated into the pseudo-labelling strategy, effectively introducing expert knowledge into the model. Experiments on a real-world forest dataset demonstrate 5.6% improvement over the best reference method. Expert evaluation of cohabitation priors reveals high accuracy with differences no larger than 15%.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合生物启发伪标签和生态先验知识的半监督深度学习方法，用于解决高光谱树种分类中的标签稀缺、光谱混合和生态异质性问题，在真实森林数据集上比最佳基准方法提升5.6%。
AI.motivation: 高光谱树种分类面临三大挑战：1）有限且不平衡的类别标签；2）光谱混合（多个物种光谱重叠）；3）生态异质性（生态系统间的变异性）。传统仅依赖光谱特征的方法难以应对这些挑战，需要整合植被的生物和结构特征。
AI.method: 提出生物启发的半监督深度学习方法：1）整合多传感器数据（高光谱成像HSI和机载激光扫描ALS）；2）在预计算的冠层图上进行生物启发伪标签生成；3）使用大语言模型从可靠来源自动推导物种共栖生态先验知识，编码为共栖矩阵；4）将生态先验知识融入伪标签策略，引入专家知识。
AI.result: 在真实森林数据集上的实验表明，该方法比最佳基准方法提升5.6%的分类准确率。专家评估显示，自动生成的共栖先验知识具有高准确性，差异不超过15%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过整合多传感器数据、生物启发伪标签和生态先验知识，有效解决了高光谱树种分类的挑战，以较低训练成本实现了准确分类，为生态遥感提供了新思路。

title: Motion-Adapter: A Diffusion Model Adapter for Text-to-Motion Generation of Compound Actions
comment: 12 pages, 12 figures, Under review for publication in IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
summary: Recent advances in generative motion synthesis have enabled the production of realistic human motions from diverse input modalities. However, synthesizing compound actions from texts, which integrate multiple concurrent actions into coherent full-body sequences, remains a major challenge. We identify two key limitations in current text-to-motion diffusion models: (i) catastrophic neglect, where earlier actions are overwritten by later ones due to improper handling of temporal information, and (ii) attention collapse, which arises from excessive feature fusion in cross-attention mechanisms. As a result, existing approaches often depend on overly detailed textual descriptions (e.g., raising right hand), explicit body-part specifications (e.g., editing the upper body), or the use of large language models (LLMs) for body-part interpretation. These strategies lead to deficient semantic representations of physical structures and kinematic mechanisms, limiting the ability to incorporate natural behaviors such as greeting while walking. To address these issues, we propose the Motion-Adapter, a plug-and-play module that guides text-to-motion diffusion models in generating compound actions by computing decoupled cross-attention maps, which serve as structural masks during the denoising process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently produces more faithful and coherent compound motions across diverse textual prompts, surpassing state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出Motion-Adapter模块解决文本到动作扩散模型中复合动作生成的挑战，通过解耦交叉注意力映射作为结构掩码，改善多并发动作的连贯性生成
AI.motivation: 当前文本到动作扩散模型在生成复合动作（多个并发动作整合为连贯全身序列）时存在两个关键限制：灾难性忽视（早期动作被后期动作覆盖）和注意力崩溃（交叉注意力机制中过度特征融合），导致需要过度详细的文本描述或依赖大型语言模型
AI.method: 提出Motion-Adapter即插即用模块，通过计算解耦的交叉注意力映射，在去噪过程中作为结构掩码，引导文本到动作扩散模型生成复合动作
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在不同文本提示下能一致生成更忠实和连贯的复合动作，超越了现有最先进方法
AI.conclusion: Motion-Adapter有效解决了文本到动作扩散模型中复合动作生成的挑战，通过结构化的注意力机制改善了多并发动作的语义表示和运动连贯性

title: neuralCAD-Edit: An Expert Benchmark for Multimodal-Instructed 3D CAD Model Editing
summary: We introduce neuralCAD-Edit, the first benchmark for editing 3D CAD models collected from expert CAD engineers. Instead of text conditioning as in prior works, we collect realistic CAD editing requests by capturing videos of professional designers, interacting directly with CAD models in CAD software, while talking, pointing and drawing. We recruited ten consenting designers to contribute to this contained study. We benchmark leading foundation models against human CAD experts carrying out edits, and find a large performance gap in both automatic metrics and human evaluations. Even the best foundation model (GPT 5.2) scores 53% lower (absolute) than CAD experts in human acceptance trials, demonstrating the challenge of neuralCAD-Edit. We hope neuralCAD-Edit will provide a solid foundation against which 3D CAD editing approaches and foundation models can be developed. Code/data: https://autodeskailab.github.io/neuralCAD-Edit

AI.tldr: 首个基于专业CAD工程师实际操作的3D CAD模型编辑基准，通过录制设计师在CAD软件中的真实交互过程收集编辑请求，发现现有基础模型与人类专家存在显著性能差距
AI.motivation: 现有3D CAD编辑研究多基于文本条件，缺乏真实设计师在实际工作中的编辑请求和交互模式，需要建立更贴近实际工程实践的基准来评估和推动3D CAD编辑技术的发展
AI.method: 收集10位专业CAD设计师在CAD软件中直接操作模型的视频，记录他们的语音、指向和绘图等交互行为，建立包含真实编辑请求的数据集，并以此为基础对领先的基础模型进行基准测试
AI.result: 在自动指标和人工评估中，现有基础模型与CAD专家存在巨大性能差距，即使最佳的基础模型（GPT 5.2）在人工接受度测试中得分也比CAD专家低53%（绝对值）
AI.conclusion: neuralCAD-Edit基准揭示了3D CAD编辑任务的挑战性，为未来3D CAD编辑方法和基础模型的开发提供了坚实的评估基础，有助于推动该领域的技术进步

title: Saturation-Aware Space-Variant Blind Image Deblurring
summary: This paper presents a novel saturation aware space variant blind image deblurring framework designed to address challenges posed by saturated pixels in deblurring under high dynamic range and low light conditions. The proposed approach effectively segments the image based on blur intensity and proximity to saturation, leveraging a pre estimated Light Spread Function to mitigate stray light effects. By accurately estimating the true radiance of saturated regions using the dark channel prior, our method enhances the deblurring process without introducing artifacts like ringing. Experimental evaluations on both synthetic and real world datasets demonstrate that the framework improves deblurring outcomes across various scenarios showcasing superior performance compared to state of the art saturation-aware and general purpose methods. This adaptability highlights the framework potential integration with existing and emerging blind image deblurring techniques.

AI.tldr: 提出一种饱和感知的空间变异盲图像去模糊框架，专门处理高动态范围和低光照条件下饱和像素带来的挑战
AI.motivation: 在高动态范围和低光照条件下，饱和像素会严重影响图像去模糊效果，现有方法难以有效处理饱和区域，容易产生振铃等伪影
AI.method: 基于模糊强度和接近饱和程度对图像进行分割，利用预估计的光扩散函数减少杂散光影响，使用暗通道先验准确估计饱和区域的真实辐射度
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法在各种场景下都能改善去模糊效果，性能优于现有的饱和感知和通用方法，且不会引入振铃伪影
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效处理饱和像素问题，展示了与现有和新兴盲图像去模糊技术集成的潜力

title: GAViD: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset for Context-Aware Group Affect Recognition from Videos
summary: Understanding affective dynamics in real-world social systems is fundamental to modeling and analyzing human-human interactions in complex environments. Group affect emerges from intertwined human-human interactions, contextual influences, and behavioral cues, making its quantitative modeling a challenging computational social systems problem. However, computational modeling of group affect in in-the-wild scenarios remains challenging due to limited large-scale annotated datasets and the inherent complexity of multimodal social interactions shaped by contextual and behavioral variability. The lack of comprehensive datasets annotated with multimodal and contextual information further limits advances in the field. To address this, we introduce the Group Affect from ViDeos (GAViD) dataset, comprising 5091 video clips with multimodal data (video, audio and context), annotated with ternary valence and discrete emotion labels and enriched with VideoGPT-generated contextual metadata and human-annotated action cues. We also present Context-Aware Group Affect Recognition Network (CAGNet) for multimodal context-aware group affect recognition. CAGNet achieves 63.20\% test accuracy on GAViD, comparable to state-of-the-art performance. The dataset and code are available at github.com/deepakkumar-iitr/GAViD.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了GAViD数据集和CAGNet模型，用于解决真实场景中群体情感识别的挑战，通过多模态数据和上下文信息提升识别性能。
AI.motivation: 真实世界社交系统中群体情感动态的理解对于复杂环境中人机交互建模至关重要，但目前缺乏大规模标注数据集和多模态上下文信息，限制了该领域的发展。
AI.method: 1) 创建GAViD数据集：包含5091个视频片段，带有视频、音频、上下文等多模态数据，标注了三元效价和离散情感标签，并补充了VideoGPT生成的上下文元数据和人工标注的动作线索；2) 提出CAGNet模型：用于多模态上下文感知的群体情感识别。
AI.result: CAGNet在GAViD数据集上达到63.20%的测试准确率，与最先进方法性能相当。数据集和代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: GAViD数据集和CAGNet模型为解决真实场景中群体情感识别问题提供了重要资源和方法，有助于推动计算社交系统领域的发展。

title: CollideNet: Hierarchical Multi-scale Video Representation Learning with Disentanglement for Time-To-Collision Forecasting
summary: Time-to-Collision (TTC) forecasting is a critical task in collision prevention, requiring precise temporal prediction and comprehending both local and global patterns encapsulated in a video, both spatially and temporally. To address the multi-scale nature of video, we introduce a novel spatiotemporal hierarchical transformer-based architecture called CollideNet, specifically catered for effective TTC forecasting. In the spatial stream, CollideNet aggregates information for each video frame simultaneously at multiple resolutions. In the temporal stream, along with multi-scale feature encoding, CollideNet also disentangles the non-stationarity, trend, and seasonality components. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in comparison to prior works on three commonly used public datasets, setting a new state-of-the-art by a considerable margin. We conduct cross-dataset evaluations to analyze the generalization capabilities of our method, and visualize the effects of disentanglement of the trend and seasonality components of the video data. We release our code at https://github.com/DeSinister/CollideNet/.

AI.tldr: CollideNet：一种用于碰撞时间预测的新型时空分层Transformer架构，通过多尺度空间特征聚合和时序分量解耦实现SOTA性能
AI.motivation: 碰撞时间预测需要精确的时间预测和理解视频中的局部和全局时空模式，现有方法难以有效处理视频的多尺度特性
AI.method: 提出CollideNet架构：空间流中同时聚合多分辨率帧信息；时间流中进行多尺度特征编码，并解耦非平稳性、趋势和季节性分量
AI.result: 在三个常用公共数据集上取得SOTA性能，显著超越先前工作；跨数据集评估显示良好泛化能力；可视化验证了分量解耦效果
AI.conclusion: CollideNet通过创新的时空分层Transformer设计，有效解决了碰撞时间预测中的多尺度问题，为碰撞预防提供了更准确的预测工具

title: Find, Fix, Reason: Context Repair for Video Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning has advanced video reasoning in large multi-modal models, yet dominant pipelines either rely on on-policy self-exploration, which plateaus at the model's knowledge boundary, or hybrid replay that mixes policies and demands careful regularization. Dynamic context methods zoom into focused evidence but often require curated pretraining and two-stage tuning, and their context remains bounded by a small model's capability. In contrast, larger models excel at instruction following and multi-modal understanding, can supply richer context to smaller models, and rapidly zoom in on target regions via simple tools. Building on this capability, we introduce an observation-level intervention: a frozen, tool-integrated teacher identifies the missing spatiotemporal dependency and provides a minimal evidence patch (e.g., timestamps, regions etc.) from the original video while the question remains unchanged. The student answers again with the added context, and training updates with a chosen-rollout scheme integrated into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). We further propose a Robust Improvement Reward (RIR) that aligns optimization with two goals: outcome validity through correct answers and dependency alignment through rationales that reflect the cited evidence. Advantages are group-normalized across the batch, preserving on-policy exploration while directing it along causally meaningful directions with minimal changes to the training stack. Experiments on various related benchmarks show consistent accuracy gains and strong generalization. Web page and source code will be available at https://github.com/JethroJames/FFR.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于工具集成教师的观察级干预方法，通过教师模型识别缺失的时空依赖关系并提供最小证据补丁，学生模型在增强上下文下重新回答，结合GRPO和RIR奖励实现更有效的视频推理训练。
AI.motivation: 当前强化学习在视频推理中存在局限性：基于策略的自我探索会受限于模型知识边界，混合重放需要精心正则化，动态上下文方法需要精心设计的预训练和两阶段调优。大型模型在指令跟随和多模态理解方面表现出色，能够为小型模型提供更丰富的上下文，并通过简单工具快速定位目标区域。
AI.method: 提出观察级干预方法：冻结的工具集成教师识别缺失的时空依赖关系，从原始视频中提供最小证据补丁（如时间戳、区域等）；学生在增强上下文下重新回答；训练采用集成到GRPO中的选择-展开方案；进一步提出鲁棒改进奖励（RIR），通过正确答案确保结果有效性，通过反映引用证据的推理确保依赖对齐。
AI.result: 在多个相关基准测试上的实验显示，该方法实现了持续的准确率提升和强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持基于策略探索的同时，通过最小化训练堆栈的改动，沿着因果有意义的方向引导探索，有效提升了视频推理性能。

title: Where Do Vision-Language Models Fail? World Scale Analysis for Image Geolocalization
comment: Accepted to the CVPR EarthVision 2026 Workshop
summary: Image geolocalization has traditionally been addressed through retrieval-based place recognition or geometry-based visual localization pipelines. Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong zero-shot reasoning capabilities across multimodal tasks, yet their performance in geographic inference remains underexplored. In this work, we present a systematic evaluation of multiple state-of-the-art VLMs for country-level image geolocalization using ground-view imagery only. Instead of relying on image matching, GPS metadata, or task-specific training, we evaluate prompt-based country prediction in a zero-shot setting. The selected models are tested on three geographically diverse datasets to assess their robustness and generalization ability. Our results reveal substantial variation across models, highlighting the potential of semantic reasoning for coarse geolocalization and the limitations of current VLMs in capturing fine-grained geographic cues. This study provides the first focused comparison of modern VLMs for country-level geolocalization and establishes a foundation for future research at the intersection of multimodal reasoning and geographic understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了多种最先进的视觉语言模型在仅使用地面视图图像进行国家级别地理定位的能力，发现模型间存在显著差异，揭示了语义推理在粗粒度地理定位中的潜力以及当前模型在捕捉细粒度地理线索方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 传统图像地理定位主要依赖基于检索的地点识别或基于几何的视觉定位方法。虽然视觉语言模型在多模态任务中展现出强大的零样本推理能力，但其在地理推断方面的性能尚未得到充分探索。本研究旨在填补这一空白，评估VLMs在国家级别图像地理定位中的表现。
AI.method: 采用零样本设置下的提示式国家预测方法，不依赖图像匹配、GPS元数据或任务特定训练。在三个地理多样性数据集上测试多个最先进的视觉语言模型，评估其鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.result: 结果显示不同模型之间存在显著差异，表明语义推理在粗粒度地理定位中具有潜力，但当前VLMs在捕捉细粒度地理线索方面存在局限性。这是首次针对现代VLMs在国家级别地理定位的集中比较研究。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为多模态推理与地理理解交叉领域的未来研究奠定了基础，揭示了视觉语言模型在地理定位任务中的当前能力和局限性，为进一步改进提供了方向。

title: Information Router for Mitigating Modality Dominance in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision Language models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of benchmarks, yet they often suffer from modality dominance, where predictions rely disproportionately on a single modality. Prior approaches primarily address this issue by steering model's attention allocation, implicitly assuming that all modalities provide sufficient information. However, attention only determines where the model focuses, and cannot enrich information that is missing or ambiguous. In the real world, input modalities often differ in information density and their signal-to-noise ratios. In such cases, simply adjusting model's attention does not resolve the underlying lack of information. In this paper, we propose \textsc{MoIR}: \textit{Multi-modal Information Router}, an information-level fusion method that explicitly reduces information disparity prior to fusion. \textsc{MoIR} identifies less informative tokens and routes complementary information from a stronger modality, constructing information-dense token representations before they are processed by a large language model. By modifying information availability, \textsc{MoIR} enables reliable shifts in modality dominance, even when one modality is degraded. We evaluate \textsc{MoIR} on three widely used multi-modal benchmarks across multiple model backbones. Experimental results show that \textsc{MoIR} consistently demonstrates more balanced modality contribution, and improves robustness and downstream performance, particularly even under modality degradation. These findings demonstrate that explicitly modifying cross-modal information is an effective and complementary strategy for mitigating modality dominance in multi-modal reasoning models.

AI.tldr: MoIR是一种多模态信息路由器，通过识别信息不足的token并从强模态路由补充信息，在融合前显式减少模态间信息差异，解决传统注意力方法无法处理信息缺失的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型存在模态主导问题，传统方法主要通过调整注意力分配来解决，但注意力只能决定模型关注哪里，无法丰富缺失或模糊的信息。现实世界中不同模态的信息密度和信噪比存在差异，单纯调整注意力无法解决信息不足的根本问题。
AI.method: 提出MoIR（多模态信息路由器），这是一种信息层面的融合方法。它识别信息不足的token，从信息更强的模态路由补充信息，在大型语言模型处理前构建信息密集的token表示。通过修改信息可用性，MoIR能够实现可靠的模态主导转移，即使在某个模态退化的情况下也能工作。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的多模态基准测试和多个模型骨干上评估MoIR。实验结果表明，MoIR始终展现出更平衡的模态贡献，提高了鲁棒性和下游性能，特别是在模态退化情况下表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 显式修改跨模态信息是缓解多模态推理模型中模态主导问题的有效补充策略。MoIR通过信息层面的路由机制，解决了传统注意力方法无法处理信息缺失的局限性。

title: Hero-Mamba: Mamba-based Dual Domain Learning for Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: Underwater images often suffer from severe degradation, such as color distortion, low contrast, and blurred details, due to light absorption and scattering in water. While learning-based methods like CNNs and Transformers have shown promise, they face critical limitations: CNNs struggle to model the long-range dependencies needed for non-uniform degradation, and Transformers incur quadratic computational complexity, making them inefficient for high-resolution images. To address these challenges, we propose Hero-Mamba, a novel Mamba-based network that achieves efficient dual-domain learning for underwater image enhancement. Our approach uniquely processes information from both the spatial domain (RGB image) and the spectral domain (FFT components) in parallel. This dual-domain input allows the network to decouple degradation factors, separating color/brightness information from texture/noise. The core of our network utilizes Mamba-based SS2D blocks to capture global receptive fields and long-range dependencies with linear complexity, overcoming the limitations of both CNNs and Transformers. Furthermore, we introduce a ColorFusion block, guided by a background light prior, to restore color information with high fidelity. Extensive experiments on the LSUI and UIEB benchmark datasets demonstrate that Hero-Mamba outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our model achieves a PSNR of 25.802 and an SSIM of 0.913 on LSUI, validating its superior performance and generalization capabilities.

AI.tldr: Hero-Mamba：基于Mamba的双域学习网络，用于高效水下图像增强，通过并行处理空间域和频域信息，在保持线性复杂度的同时实现全局感受野
AI.motivation: 水下图像因光线吸收和散射而存在严重退化（颜色失真、低对比度、细节模糊）。现有基于CNN的方法难以建模非均匀退化所需的长距离依赖，而Transformer具有二次计算复杂度，对高分辨率图像效率低下。
AI.method: 提出Hero-Mamba网络，采用Mamba-based SS2D块实现线性复杂度的全局感受野。创新性地并行处理空间域（RGB图像）和频域（FFT分量）信息，通过双域输入解耦退化因子（颜色/亮度与纹理/噪声分离）。引入ColorFusion块，基于背景光先验指导恢复高保真颜色信息。
AI.result: 在LSUI和UIEB基准数据集上的实验表明，Hero-Mamba优于现有最先进方法。在LSUI数据集上达到PSNR 25.802和SSIM 0.913，验证了其优越性能和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Hero-Mamba通过Mamba-based架构和双域学习策略，有效解决了水下图像增强中CNN和Transformer的局限性，在保持计算效率的同时实现了优异的增强效果。

title: Enhancing Hazy Wildlife Imagery: AnimalHaze3k and IncepDehazeGan
summary: Atmospheric haze significantly degrades wildlife imagery, impeding computer vision applications critical for conservation, such as animal detection, tracking, and behavior analysis. To address this challenge, we introduce AnimalHaze3k a synthetic dataset comprising of 3,477 hazy images generated from 1,159 clear wildlife photographs through a physics-based pipeline. Our novel IncepDehazeGan architecture combines inception blocks with residual skip connections in a GAN framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance (SSIM: 0.8914, PSNR: 20.54, and LPIPS: 0.1104), delivering 6.27% higher SSIM and 10.2% better PSNR than competing approaches. When applied to downstream detection tasks, dehazed images improved YOLOv11 detection mAP by 112% and IoU by 67%. These advances can provide ecologists with reliable tools for population monitoring and surveillance in challenging environmental conditions, demonstrating significant potential for enhancing wildlife conservation efforts through robust visual analytics.

AI.tldr: 提出AnimalHaze3k合成数据集和IncepDehazeGan架构，用于野生动物图像去雾，显著提升下游检测任务性能
AI.motivation: 大气雾霾严重影响野生动物图像质量，阻碍了用于动物检测、追踪和行为分析等保护工作的计算机视觉应用
AI.method: 1) 创建AnimalHaze3k合成数据集：包含3,477张雾霾图像，基于1,159张清晰野生动物照片通过物理模拟管道生成；2) 提出IncepDehazeGan架构：在GAN框架中结合inception模块和残差跳跃连接
AI.result: 1) 在去雾任务上达到SOTA性能：SSIM 0.8914，PSNR 20.54，LPIPS 0.1104，比竞争方法SSIM高6.27%，PSNR高10.2%；2) 在下游检测任务中：去雾图像使YOLOv11检测mAP提升112%，IoU提升67%
AI.conclusion: 该方法为生态学家在恶劣环境条件下进行种群监测和监视提供了可靠工具，展示了通过鲁棒视觉分析增强野生动物保护工作的巨大潜力

title: FineCog-Nav: Integrating Fine-grained Cognitive Modules for Zero-shot Multimodal UAV Navigation
summary: UAV vision-language navigation (VLN) requires an agent to navigate complex 3D environments from an egocentric perspective while following ambiguous multi-step instructions over long horizons. Existing zero-shot methods remain limited, as they often rely on large base models, generic prompts, and loosely coordinated modules. In this work, we propose FineCog-Nav, a top-down framework inspired by human cognition that organizes navigation into fine-grained modules for language processing, perception, attention, memory, imagination, reasoning, and decision-making. Each module is driven by a moderate-sized foundation model with role-specific prompts and structured input-output protocols, enabling effective collaboration and improved interpretability. To support fine-grained evaluation, we construct AerialVLN-Fine, a curated benchmark of 300 trajectories derived from AerialVLN, with sentence-level instruction-trajectory alignment and refined instructions containing explicit visual endpoints and landmark references. Experiments show that FineCog-Nav consistently outperforms zero-shot baselines in instruction adherence, long-horizon planning, and generalization to unseen environments. These results suggest the effectiveness of fine-grained cognitive modularization for zero-shot aerial navigation. Project page: https://smartdianlab.github.io/projects-FineCogNav.

AI.tldr: FineCog-Nav：受人类认知启发的无人机视觉语言导航框架，通过细粒度模块化方法提升零样本导航性能
AI.motivation: 现有零样本无人机视觉语言导航方法依赖大型基础模型、通用提示和松散协调的模块，在复杂3D环境中执行多步模糊指令时存在局限性
AI.method: 提出FineCog-Nav框架，将导航分解为语言处理、感知、注意力、记忆、想象、推理和决策等细粒度认知模块，每个模块由中等规模的基础模型驱动，配备角色特定提示和结构化输入输出协议
AI.result: FineCog-Nav在指令遵循、长时程规划和未见环境泛化方面持续优于零样本基线方法
AI.conclusion: 细粒度认知模块化对零样本空中导航是有效的，该方法提高了协作效率和可解释性

title: Repurposing 3D Generative Model for Autoregressive Layout Generation
summary: We introduce LaviGen, a framework that repurposes 3D generative models for 3D layout generation. Unlike previous methods that infer object layouts from textual descriptions, LaviGen operates directly in the native 3D space, formulating layout generation as an autoregressive process that explicitly models geometric relations and physical constraints among objects, producing coherent and physically plausible 3D scenes. To further enhance this process, we propose an adapted 3D diffusion model that integrates scene, object, and instruction information and employs a dual-guidance self-rollout distillation mechanism to improve efficiency and spatial accuracy. Extensive experiments on the LayoutVLM benchmark show LaviGen achieves superior 3D layout generation performance, with 19% higher physical plausibility than the state of the art and 65% faster computation. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/fenghora/LaviGen.

AI.method: 1) 将布局生成建模为自回归过程，在原生3D空间中显式建模对象间的几何关系和物理约束；2) 提出改进的3D扩散模型，整合场景、对象和指令信息；3) 采用双引导自展开蒸馏机制提高效率和空间准确性。
AI.result: 在LayoutVLM基准测试中，LaviGen实现了优越的3D布局生成性能：物理合理性比现有最佳方法提高19%，计算速度加快65%。
AI.conclusion: LaviGen通过重新利用3D生成模型，在原生3D空间中直接进行布局生成，能够有效建模几何关系和物理约束，生成高质量、物理合理的3D场景布局，在性能和效率方面均优于现有方法。
